comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Presented at the Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology (ARVO) Annual Meeting, Denver, Colorado, May 4, 2026
summary: Objective: To assess the accuracy and efficiency of a large language model (LLM) using two prompt strategies to extract structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDF reports. Methods: Twenty deidentified reports across four types (Visual Field, OCT Glaucoma Overview, OCT retinal nerve fiber layer Single Exam, and OCT Thickness Map; n = 5 each) were processed using two GPT-4o-assisted pipelines and compared with a reconciled manual ground truth. Schema-Constrained used Structured Output mode with a predefined JSON Schema; Prompt-Only used a detailed instruction prompt followed by Python conversion to JSON. Outcomes were value accuracy, formatting accuracy, and extraction time. Results: Schema-Constrained value accuracy was 100.00% for Visual Field and RNFL Single Exam, 97.45% for Glaucoma Overview, and 98.00% for Thickness Map; Prompt-Only achieved 100.00% across all four report types. Formatting accuracy was 100.00% for Schema-Constrained across all report types and 100.00% for Prompt-Only except RNFL Single Exam (90.14%). Mean extraction time was 56.51 s per report for manual review versus 5.04 s for Schema-Constrained and 4.70 s for Prompt-Only, an approximately 92% reduction. Conclusions: In this small proof-of-concept dataset, general-purpose LLM-assisted pipelines extracted structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDFs with high accuracy and substantially reduced processing time. Prompt-Only achieved the highest value accuracy, while Schema-Constrained produced schema-compliant output with 100% formatting accuracy. These complementary strengths support further evaluation of hybrid, validation-aware workflows for research and clinical data abstraction.

AI.tldr: 比较两种提示策略（Schema-Constrained 与 Prompt-Only）驱动 GPT-4o 从眼科诊断 PDF 报告中提取结构化数据的准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 人工从眼科诊断 PDF 报告中抽取结构化数据耗时且易错，需评估大语言模型辅助流程能否在保证准确率的同时提升效率，并比较不同提示策略的适用性。
AI.method: 对 4 类共 20 份去标识化报告（视野、OCT 青光眼概览、OCT 视网膜神经纤维层单次检查、OCT 厚度图，各 5 份），采用两条 GPT-4o 流程：Schema-Constrained 使用预定义 JSON Schema 的 Structured Output 模式；Prompt-Only 使用详细指令提示后由 Python 转换为 JSON。以人工复核的基准真值对照，比较取值准确率、格式准确率与提取耗时。
AI.result: 取值准确率：Schema-Constrained 在视野与 RNFL 单次检查为 100.00%，青光眼概览 97.45%，厚度图 98.00%；Prompt-Only 四类报告均为 100.00%。格式准确率：Schema-Constrained 全部报告为 100.00%；Prompt-Only 除 RNFL 单次检查为 90.14% 外均为 100.00%。平均提取时间：人工复核 56.51 s/份，Schema-Constrained 5.04 s，Prompt-Only 4.70 s，约降低 92%。
AI.conclusion: 在该小样本概念验证数据集中，通用型 LLM 辅助流程从眼科诊断 PDF 中提取结构化数据具有高准确率并显著缩短处理时间。Prompt-Only 取值准确率最高，Schema-Constrained 输出符合 Schema 且格式准确率达 100%，二者优势互补，支持进一步评估面向研究与临床数据抽取的混合式、验证感知工作流。

title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality
comment: To be published in VRST 2026. Main Manuscript: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Materials: 7 pages, 10 figures. The accompanying public repository can be accessed by visiting https://github.com/Duke-I3T-Lab/RateAR
summary: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动化AR内容评估与优化框架，并构建RateAR基准，验证VLM预测与人类主观评分高度相关，进而实现自动AR内容调整系统。
AI.motivation: AR头显受限于场景几何约束、空间抖动和时间不稳定性，影响用户沉浸感与舒适度；传统用户研究是AR视觉质量评估的标准方法，但成本高、可扩展性差、灵活性不足，成为迭代设计中的瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 构建RateAR基准，涵盖多样场景与环境条件下的AR图像和视频，针对物体放置、尺度、阴影一致性等感知因素具有良好至优秀信度（ICC(2,5) ≥ .90）；2) 在基准上评估11个商业VLM；3) 进行消融研究，比较不同提示策略；4) 基于发现构建自动化AR内容调整系统，并开展21名参与者的用户研究。
AI.result: VLM质量预测与人类主观判断强相关，Spearman秩相关最高达0.8695；消融研究表明上下文提示在与人评分对齐和复杂度线索平衡方面优于其他提示策略；用户研究中超过90%的参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的自动化框架可有效预测AR视觉保真度并优化AR内容，为替代或补充高成本用户研究提供了可行路径，有助于提升AR应用迭代设计效率与用户体验。

title: Agent Evaluation Reliability: More Tasks Won't (Always) Fix An Agent Leaderboard
summary: Agent evaluations are increasingly used to compare LLMs and inform deployment decisions, yet ranks can reflect not only the model but also the effects of the evaluation conditions such as the scaffolds or tasks. This makes reliability claim-dependent: an evaluation that reliably ranks deployed systems may not reliably rank underlying models. We ask which conclusions current agent evaluations reliably support and what additional evaluation would improve them. We develop a Bayesian variance-decomposition framework for sparse, imbalanced agent leaderboards and apply it to 22 benchmarks from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard and Harbor Index. The framework separates signal, performance differences relevant to the intended claim, from noise, irrelevant variation that can still change rankings. We find: (1) Reliability depends on the measurement goal. Fixed model-scaffold systems are ranked reliably (0.935-0.994), while underlying-model reliability is substantially lower (0.148-0.841). (2) Scaffold choice can change conclusions. Inter-scaffold reliability measures whether scaffolds preserve model rankings, showing that scaffold effects vary substantially across evaluations. (3) More tasks cannot resolve all uncertainty. Even infinitely many similarly constructed tasks improve model-ranking reliability of a benchmark by at most 0.097 when uncertainty is dominated by limited scaffold coverage. (4) Pooling diverse benchmarks can improve cross-task rankings at lower cost. For rankings across diverse agentic tasks, pooling benchmarks raises projected reliability from 0.44 to 0.75 at the same task budget and can reduce projected cost by up to 83\%. Evaluation design should follow the intended claim: identify what a score or ranking should mean, diagnose what limits its reliability, and spend evaluation budget on the sources of uncertainty that matter.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出贝叶斯方差分解框架，将性能差异（信号）与无关变异（噪声）分离，用于分析稀疏、不平衡的智能体排行榜，并据此评估现有智能体评测对"部署系统排名"与"底层模型排名"两类结论的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 智能体评测越来越多地用于比较LLM并指导部署决策，但排名不仅反映模型本身，还受评测条件（如脚手架scaffold、任务）影响。因此可靠性是"依赖特定结论"的：一个能可靠排序部署系统的评测，未必能可靠排序底层模型。作者希望回答现有智能体评测究竟能可靠支撑哪些结论，以及需要什么样的额外评测来改进它们。
AI.method: 提出面向稀疏、不平衡智能体排行榜的贝叶斯方差分解框架，应用于Holistic Agent Leaderboard和Harbor Index中的22个基准。框架将信号（与目标结论相关的性能差异）与噪声（仍可能改变排名但无关的变异）分离，并定义多种可靠性指标：固定模型-脚手架系统的可靠性、底层模型可靠性，以及衡量脚手架是否保持模型排名的脚手架间可靠性（inter-scaffold reliability）。
AI.result: (1) 可靠性取决于测量目标：固定模型-脚手架系统排名可靠（0.935-0.994），而底层模型可靠性显著更低（0.148-0.841）。(2) 脚手架选择可改变结论：脚手架效应在不同评测间差异较大。(3) 增加任务无法解决全部不确定性：当不确定性主要由有限的脚手架覆盖度主导时，即使任务数无穷多，基准的模型排名可靠性最多提升0.097。(4) 在相同任务预算下，跨多样智能体任务汇总多个基准可将投影可靠性从0.44提升至0.75，并最多降低83%的投影成本。
AI.conclusion: 评测设计应遵循其意图结论：先明确分数或排名应当代表什么，再诊断限制其可靠性的因素，最后将评测预算投入到真正重要的不确定性来源上（如脚手架覆盖度），而非单纯增加任务数量；跨多样任务汇总基准是一种更高效的可靠性提升途径。

title: Verbalized and Internal Probabilities Are Coupled in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models carry an internal notion of uncertainty in their sampling distribution, i.e., the probabilities they place on generating one answer rather than another. They can also be asked to state a confidence, in words or as a number: a verbalized uncertainty. Prior work suggests that internal probabilities track relative frequencies in the training data, and that verbalized probabilities track explicit probabilistic assertions in the training data. However, we do not know whether these two readouts are aligned, except when frequencies and probabilistic assertions in the training data happen to align. This limits our understanding of when we can use verbalized uncertainties as a proxy for either training data frequencies, or a model's internal distribution. We resolve this gap by systematically exploring how LLMs probability readouts are impacted by training and in-context data, via intervening on the underlying uncertainty sources in the data. We find that both internal and verbalized probability readouts are impacted by both distributional and asserted uncertainty in the training data. Further, we find that verbalized and internal probabilities are aligned beyond what would be expected by independently tracking the same uncertainty sources, suggesting that verbalized probabilities can be used to probe a model's internal distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文系统探究大语言模型内部采样概率与言语化置信度两类不确定性读数是否对齐，通过干预训练与上下文数据中的不确定性来源，发现二者均受分布性不确定性与断言性不确定性影响，且对齐程度超出独立追踪同一来源的预期，表明言语化概率可用于探测模型内部分布。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型具有两类不确定性读数：内部采样分布概率与言语化置信度。已有研究表明内部概率追踪训练数据中的相对频率，言语化概率追踪训练数据中的显式概率断言，但除二者恰好对齐的情形外，尚不清楚这两类读数是否一致。这限制了对言语化不确定性能否作为训练数据频率或模型内部分布代理的理解。
AI.method: 通过干预数据中的底层不确定性来源，系统探究训练数据与上下文数据如何影响大语言模型的概率读数，分别考察分布性不确定性与断言性不确定性对内部概率与言语化概率的作用。
AI.result: 内部概率与言语化概率读数均同时受到训练数据中分布性不确定性与断言性不确定性的影响；且两类概率的对齐程度超出了仅由独立追踪同一不确定性来源所预期的水平。
AI.conclusion: 言语化概率与内部概率的对齐超出预期，说明言语化概率可用于探测模型的内部分布，从而为将言语化不确定性作为模型内部不确定性的代理提供了依据。

title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
comment: 29 pages, 22 figures, including references and appendix; 9 pages of main text
summary: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出 SemanTok，一种灵活长度视频分词器，通过将冻结 DINO 特征输入编码器并用轻量头从各前缀重建，实现高语义对齐与视频保真度，201M AR 模型可媲美或超越 3.4 倍大的 VideoFlexTok。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型需兼顾 AR 的可扩展性与扩散的画质，分词器在保真度与语义上均关键。灵活长度粗到细分词器天然适配：早期粗 token 承载全局语义，后期 token 补足细节。但现有灵活分词器仅在早期解码器隐状态上加 REPA 损失，而该目标可由含噪输入部分满足，导致语义对齐不足。
AI.method: SemanTok 将冻结的 DINO 特征输入编码器，并添加轻量预测头，使每个被保留的 token 前缀都能独立重建这些 DINO 特征，从而对每个前缀施加语义对齐约束，而非仅监督早期隐状态。
AI.result: 在每种 AR 模型规模下均取得高语义对齐与视频保真：201M SemanTok AR 模型匹配或超越 3.4 倍大的 VideoFlexTok AR 模型，更大模型进一步提升保真度。在分布外类别上保持语义对齐；在每个噪声水平（含纯噪声）下解码器都有更高语义对齐。重建与生成均表现良好；短 token 前缀预测成本更低且生成保真度更好，像素细节留给后续 token。
AI.conclusion: 通过对冻结 DINO 特征的前缀级重建监督，SemanTok 在语义对齐与视觉保真间取得更好平衡，提升 AR 视频世界模型的效率与泛化能力。

title: When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization
comment: PREPRINT - SUBMITTED TO JOURNAL OF SERVICE RESEARCH (JSR)
summary: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"上下文充分性"理论，指出生成式AI个性化中情境信息并非越多越好，关键在于与顾客当前意图的相关性，并识别出不足、充分、饱和、干扰四种状态。
AI.motivation: 个性化长期依赖"顾客证据"（历史行为与偏好）推断顾客价值。生成式AI使提供方可即时供给情境信息，无需预先编码所有条件。但这种便利带来新问题：上下文供给变得容易后，更多并不一定更好，需要理论来解释何时上下文足够。
AI.method: 作者构建"上下文充分性"理论，以上下文与顾客当前意图的相关性为核心，划分四种状态（不足、充分、饱和、干扰），并提出"上下文充分性前沿"来定位最小相关集合。随后在某大型家居零售商处，使用生成式推荐系统开展全因子实验加以验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，相关上下文提升了推荐的适当性，而无关上下文降低了适当性并破坏了检索稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将个性化从"提供更多上下文"转向"识别当前交互真正需要什么"，并在整个服务过程中执行约束。

title: VERITYGATE: A Four-Gate Schema-Level Faithfulness Framework and Paired Benchmark for Grounded LLM Narrations over Structured Evidence
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/sachinkg12/yukti/releases/tag/veritygate-groundlm-2026-v1.0.0 Supplementary artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22668710
summary: Fluent LLM explanations may not follow the evidence from a structured system. We present VERITYGATE, a four-gate checker for declared evidence IDs, entities, numbers, and claim types. It checks a fixed schema; it does not verify every fact in the prose. At r=0 and r=1, we test 900 instances per setting (450 grounded-ungrounded pairs) with GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Under this schema-level contract and before repair, 80.3% of mini claims and 47.9% of Sonnet claims fail. These are verifier rejection rates, not prose-hallucination rates. One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. Verified claims per example change by +0.14 for mini, -0.71 for Llama, and -0.47 for Sonnet, so survival and output volume must be reported together. A second Sonnet pass gives no clear gain. At r=1, Gate 4 covers 97.0%, 98.7%, and 100% of failing claims for mini, Llama, and Sonnet. Small human studies support the rules but show gaps between schema checks and correct prose. A domain-specific GPT-4o judge test shows an order effect, so it is only a usefulness check. We release the code and data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VERITYGATE——一个针对结构化系统声明的四门校验器，通过证据ID、实体、数字和声明类型四个门控检查LLM解释是否符合固定schema，并报告了多种模型下的拒绝率与修复效果。
AI.motivation: 流畅的LLM解释可能并不遵循结构化系统的证据。作者希望提供一种在不逐句验证全部事实的前提下，对LLM解释进行schema级合约校验的方法，以揭示解释与证据脱节的问题。
AI.method: 提出VERITYGATE，一个四门校验器，分别检查声明的证据ID、实体、数字和声明类型，遵循固定schema，而非验证散文中的每个事实。在r=0和r=1两种设置下，使用GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B和Claude Sonnet 4.6，每种设置测试900个实例（450对grounded-ungrounded配对）。此外还进行了一轮修复、第二次连笔，以及小规模人工研究和领域特定GPT-4o裁判测试。
AI.result: 在修复前，80.3%的mini声明和47.9%的Sonnet声明未通过校验（为校验器拒绝率，非散文幻觉率）。一轮修复将声明存活率从19.7%提升至28.0%（mini），从52.1%提升至54.3%（Sonnet）。每示例已验证声明数变化为+0.14（mini）、-0.71（Llama）、-0.47（Sonnet），说明存活率与输出量需同时报告。第二次Sonnet修复无明显增益。在r=1时，Gate 4覆盖了mini、Llama、Sonnet失败声明的97.0%、98.7%和100%。小规模人工研究支持规则，但显示schema检查与正确散文之间存在差距。GPT-4o裁判测试存在顺序效应，仅作为有用性检验。
AI.conclusion: Schema级契约检查能有效识别LLM解释中与结构化证据不符的声明，但校验通过不等于散文正确；存活率与输出量须一起报告，且修复增益有限、模型间差异显著。作者公开代码与数据。

title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
summary: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

AI.tldr: 提出Soundwich，一个免训练框架，将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型改造为可生成多个同步且可独立编辑音频轨（stems）的生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型只能生成单一混合音轨，缺乏源级控制，与实际工作流中语音、音乐、音效、环境声分离、可编辑的需求不符。
AI.method: 免训练改造冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型；生成多个音频轨并显式控制其时间活动；引入共享场景表示在保留源级分离的同时跨轨传递全局音视频上下文；为每个音频轨与其对应视觉源之间路由跨模态交互，提升一致性。
AI.result: 生成的音频轨与视频保持同步，并可独立重定时、静音、替换或重新混音；实验与人工评估显示时间控制、源分离和自然度均有提升。
AI.conclusion: Soundwich在实现连贯音视频生成的同时，支持灵活的源级编辑，为多轨可编辑音视频生成提供了可行方案。

title: Backdoor Containment via Expert Quarantine and Shutdown in LLMs
summary: Backdoored large language models (LLMs) can behave normally on benign inputs while producing attacker-specified outputs under hidden triggers. Existing defenses span four stages--prior-training, in-training, post-training, and inference-time--and share one of two underlying strategies: either suppress backdoor learning (by filtering poisoned data or interrupting its acquisition during optimization) or learn, then purify (by repairing model weights or gating inputs after a fully backdoored model has formed). We propose a third strategy, learn, but channel: allow backdoor formation during training but route it into a designated, quarantined component that can be disabled at deployment. To this end, we propose Quarantined Expert Shutdown QES, a computationally efficient containment strategy built in a regularization-steered MoE-like setting. Specifically, given a poisoned dataset, QES augments a Transformer-based language model with routed expert-specific LoRA branches and lightweight routers, and uses auxiliary routing objectives to attract trigger-conditioned behavior into a designated expert while preserving benign capability elsewhere. At deployment, mitigation reduces to a single constant-time operation: zeroing the quarantined expert's routing weight, without trigger screening or further updating model weights. Empirically, our methods reduce the attack success rate ASR from 100% to 0-10% on most settings across two tasks, three attacks, and four model families, while downstream utility is often preserved or only modestly affected. These results establish learn, but channel as a previously unexplored regime for backdoor containment in generative LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"学习但引导"（learn, but channel）新范式及QES方法，将后门行为在训练中引流至可隔离的专用专家，部署时通过置零该专家路由权重即可实现常数时间后门抑制，ASR从100%降至0-10%。
AI.motivation: 现有后门防御分四个阶段（训练前、训练中、训练后、推理时），但底层策略仅两类：一是抑制后门学习（过滤投毒数据或中断其优化获取），二是先学习后净化（修复权重或对输入门控）。两者都需要付出较大代价——要么在训练中排除后门，要么在模型已完全植入后门后修复。作者希望探索第三种策略：允许后门在训练中形成，但将其引导至一个可隔离、可在部署时禁用的专用组件。
AI.method: 提出Quarantined Expert Shutdown（QES），一种计算高效的后门隔离策略，构建于正则化引导的类MoE（Mixture-of-Experts）设定中。具体而言：在给定投毒数据集上，为基于Transformer的语言模型添加按路由分配的专家专用LoRA分支和轻量级路由器；通过辅助路由目标（auxiliary routing objectives）将触发条件行为吸引到指定专家，同时在其他部分保留正常能力。部署时，防御仅需一个常数时间操作：将被隔离专家的路由权重置零，无需触发器筛查或进一步更新模型权重。
AI.result: 在两类任务、三种攻击、四个模型族的多组设定上，方法将攻击成功率（ASR）从100%降至大多数设定下的0-10%，同时下游任务效用往往保持或仅受轻微影响。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了"学习但引导"（learn, but channel）作为生成式LLM后门隔离的一个此前未被探索的新范式，证明可通过将后门行为引导至可隔离组件并在部署时禁用它，实现高效且低代价的后门防护。

title: Contextual trajectory and incremental contextual displacement: Towards using LLMs to understand dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as RoBERTa represent text using contextual word embeddings (CWEs), which alter the embeddings associated with each token based on surrounding context. We construct token-wise incremental trajectories by repeatedly recomputing a token's CWE as successive words are added to a sentence, yielding a representation of how contextualized embeddings evolve as the utterance unfolds. We evaluate this approach using garden-path sentences as a test case with characteristic features. Token-wise trajectories reproduce known features of garden-path processing, including disruption around the critical region, and reliably distinguish garden-path sentences from matched disambiguated controls. We introduce several metrics for quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments and show that trajectory information can be highly predictive of sentence type. We find that ambiguity-related information is recoverable not only from the sentence-level CLS representation but also from ordinary vocabulary tokens, suggesting that utterance-level information is distributed across multiple representational scales. In exploratory analyses, we find qualitatively similar trajectory structures in other ambiguity- and misdirection-related linguistic phenomena. Together, these results establish token-wise incremental trajectories as a promising framework for studying utterance-specific meaning construction using LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"词元级增量轨迹"方法：随句子逐词增加，反复重算某词元的上下文词嵌入，从而刻画嵌入随话语展开的演化过程，并以花园小径句为用例验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 上下文词嵌入（CWE）会随语境变化，但静态表示难以揭示嵌入在句子展开过程中如何逐步演化；作者希望建立一种能刻画话语特定意义构建过程的分析框架。
AI.method: 对每个词元，随句子中后续词逐步加入，反复重新计算其CWE，构造词元级增量轨迹；以花园小径句及其匹配的无歧义对照句为测试用例，并设计多种度量来量化跨语境增量的表示位移，进而用轨迹信息预测句子类型。
AI.result: 词元轨迹重现了花园小径加工的特征（临界区域附近出现扰动），能可靠区分花园小径句与匹配对照句；轨迹信息对句子类型具有高度预测力；歧义相关信息不仅可从句子级CLS表示中恢复，也可从普通词汇词元中恢复，说明话语级信息分布于多个表示尺度；在其他歧义与误导相关语言现象中观察到性质相似的轨迹结构。
AI.conclusion: 词元级增量轨迹可作为利用LLM研究话语特定意义构建的有效框架。

title: FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. However, FL performance significantly degrades when the data distributions between clients are heterogeneous, which often occurs due to geographical differences, seasonal changes, and varying image acquisition and atmospheric conditions. To address this challenge, in this letter, we propose a novel personalized FL framework (denoted as FedMAD) for RS image classification problems. The proposed framework separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters to preserve client-specific features while maintaining globally transferable representations. This is achieved by integrating lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers into the backbone network. Although globally shared parameters are collaboratively optimized between clients, client-specific parameters remain local to preserve domain-specific feature characteristics. In addition, FedMAD introduces a modulation-aware directional aggregation strategy that dynamically adjusts the importance of aggregation for each client according to the alignment of local modulation updates. This allows the global optimization process to suppress conflicting client updates originating from heterogeneous data distributions while enhancing the contribution of clients with consistent adaptation behaviors. The experimental results obtained on the BigEarthNet-S2 and EuroSAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedMAD compared to state-of-the-art FL algorithms under heterogeneous RS data distributions. The code of the proposed framework will be publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/fedmad.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化联邦学习框架FedMAD，通过分离全局共享表征参数与客户端特定适配参数，并结合调制感知方向聚合策略，缓解遥感图像分类中客户端数据异构导致的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽能在不直接访问本地数据的前提下实现遥感图像档案的协同训练，但当客户端间数据分布异构（源于地理差异、季节变化、成像与大气条件不同）时性能显著下降，因此需要解决遥感场景下的数据异构问题。
AI.method: 提出个性化联邦学习框架FedMAD：将全局共享表征参数与客户端特定适配参数分离，以在保留客户端特有特征的同时维持全局可迁移表征；具体通过在骨干网络中集成轻量调制模块与本地批归一化层实现。全局共享参数在客户端间协同优化，客户端特定参数保留在本地。此外引入调制感知方向聚合策略，依据本地调制更新的对齐程度动态调整各客户端的聚合重要性。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet-S2和EuroSAT数据集上的实验结果表明，在异构遥感数据分布下，FedMAD相较于当前最先进的联邦学习算法具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: FedMAD能够在异构遥感数据分布下有效提升联邦学习的图像分类性能，代码将在指定网址公开。

title: A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making
comment: Manuscript accepted at PRIMA 2026. Includes an additional appendix with proofs
summary: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种信念道义逻辑（doxastic deontic logic），用于在规范冲突和信息不完全/不可靠情形下的自主决策，并将信念规范合规优化问题归约为加权部分MaxSAT。
AI.motivation: 自主系统常需在规范和事实都存在冲突、信息不完全或不可靠的条件下做决策，现有逻辑工具难以同时刻画主体信念与条件性规范，因此需要一个能处理"关于事实与规范的信念"的统一形式框架。
AI.method: 构建一个简单的信念道义逻辑：取Chellas极小道义逻辑（Minimal Deontic Logic）的一个可经典归约片段，扩展以显式条件规范，并与多主体KD45信念逻辑组合，使规范可依赖于主体对事实和规范的信念。在此逻辑上定义"信念规范合规优化问题"，即主体选择使加权规范违反最小化的决策，并区分主观优化（相对于主体信念）与客观优化（相对于实际事实）。
AI.result: 给出了两个条件：（i）主观优化与客观优化相一致的条件；（ii）最优决策可在多项式时间内归约为加权部分MaxSAT的条件。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为含冲突规范与不可靠信息的多主体决策提供了形式化基础，并在特定条件下实现主客观优化的一致性与可计算的高效求解。

title: Child-Adapted Structured Phonological Representations for Interpretable Speech Sound Analysis
summary: Structured phonological representations provide an interpretable alternative to generic speech embeddings, but existing models are largely trained on adult speech. We adapt PhonoQ-2.0 to child speech using CHILDES-Aligned data and compare three alignment-supervision conditions (Adult, Adult+Child, and Child-only) across two initialization strategies (Adult PhonoQ and scratch). Generalization is evaluated against manual child-speech annotations. On 1,352 consonant targets from 58 typically developing children, child-speech adaptation improves voicing recognition across all supervision conditions, from 0.922 macro-F1 for Adult PhonoQ to 0.972--0.987 after adaptation. Manner is more sensitive to alignment supervision: Adult+Child MFA reaches 0.804 and 0.796, compared to approximately 0.70 under Adult MFA supervision. Place remains comparatively strong across systems (0.871--0.902), although per-class performance varies substantially. The velar-fronting contrast is preserved across all seven model variants. Longitudinal UltraPhonix analysis further reveals speaker-specific velar and post-alveolar changes that are largely preserved across models and broadly consistent with reported clinical progress.

AI.tldr: 本文将结构化音系表征模型 PhonoQ-2.0 适配到儿童语音，通过 CHILDES-Aligned 数据与三种对齐监督条件、两种初始化策略，在 1,352 个辅音目标上验证了适配可显著提升发音特征识别，并保持音系对比的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 结构化音系表征比通用语音嵌入更具可解释性，但现有模型多基于成人语音训练，缺乏对儿童语音的适配与验证。
AI.method: 将 PhonoQ-2.0 适配至儿童语音，使用 CHILDES-Aligned 数据，比较三种对齐监督条件（Adult、Adult+Child、Child-only）与两种初始化策略（Adult PhonoQ 与 scratch），并以人工儿童语音标注进行泛化评估；另开展 UltraPhonix 纵向分析。
AI.result: 在 58 名典型发育儿童的 1,352 个辅音目标上，儿童语音适配在所有监督条件下均提升清浊识别（宏 F1 从 0.922 提升至 0.972--0.987）；方式特征对对齐监督更敏感，Adult+Child MFA 达 0.804 与 0.796，而 Adult MFA 约为 0.70；部位特征整体较强（0.871--0.902），但各类别表现差异明显；软腭前化对比在全部七种模型变体中均得到保留。
AI.conclusion: 儿童语音适配可有效提升音系特征识别，方式特征依赖对齐监督质量，部位特征相对稳定，音系对比在模型间保持一致；纵向分析揭示的说话人特异性软腭与齿龈后变化与临床进展基本吻合。

title: Personalized Image Generation with Reasoning and Reflection
summary: Personalized image generation has remained narrowly focused on conditional synthesis from curated visual exemplars, rather than capturing who a user is. In practice, however, a user's personal context is much richer, comprising reviews, posts, images, captions, and metadata accumulated over time. A truly personalized generator should leverage this history to produce images aligned with the user's lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. To this end, we introduce the first unified benchmark for personalized image generation from user histories. The benchmark comprises two complementary tasks and a multi-axis evaluation protocol that assesses target fidelity, visual quality, user distinguishability, semantic alignment with the user's history, and task-specific utility. Grounded in real-world e-commerce and social media settings, the benchmark includes: (1) Personalized Scene Generation, which places a given object in a scene that reflects a user's preferences and lifestyle, motivated by personalized product presentation; and (2) Personalized Creative Generation, which generates a novel image on a specified topic that is faithful to a user's aesthetic and visual identity, motivated by social media content creation. We further propose PEARL, which couples a multimodal reasoner with a frozen image generator in an interleaved reason-reflect loop optimized with differential data reward. Across both tasks, PEARL outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average improvement of 15% across personalization metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于用户历史记录的个性化图像生成统一基准，含两个任务与多维评估协议，并提出PEARL方法，在个性化指标上平均提升15%。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将个性化图像生成局限于基于精选视觉样例的条件合成，未能刻画"用户是谁"。真实场景中用户个人语境更丰富，包含长期积累的评论、帖子、图像、字幕与元数据，真正的个性化生成器应利用这些历史来生成符合用户生活方式与审美的图像。
AI.method: 构建统一基准：包含两个互补任务（个性化场景生成，将给定物体置于反映用户偏好的场景中，面向个性化商品展示；个性化创意生成，按指定主题生成符合用户审美与视觉身份的新图像，面向社交媒体创作），以及涵盖目标保真度、视觉质量、用户可区分性、与用户历史的语义对齐、任务特定效用的多轴评估协议，均基于真实电商与社交媒体场景。方法层面提出PEARL，将多模态推理器与冻结的图像生成器耦合，构成交错的"推理—反思"循环，并以差分数据奖励进行优化。
AI.result: 在两个任务上，PEARL均优于强基线，个性化指标平均提升15%。
AI.conclusion: 用户历史可作为个性化图像生成的有效条件来源；统一基准与多轴评估协议为该方向提供了可比较的评测基础，PEARL验证了"推理器+冻结生成器"范式的有效性。

title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery (AIDaR) Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Paris
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics. However, their logical reasoning often falls short, producing factual inaccuracies unacceptable in these settings. Reliable evaluation remains challenging: manual dataset construction scales poorly, and LLM-based generation risks embedding the very flaws it aims to measure. High-quality benchmarks must ground both correct and incorrect labelled examples in explicit background knowledge, formally verifiable by a standard reasoner. We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design. Distractors are generated by perturbing the right-hand-side class expressions of class definition axioms, and their incorrectness is formally verified by an OWL reasoner via entailment checks. We evaluate the pipeline on three ontologies: Pizza (small, academic), PMDco (complex, materials science), and DOID (large, biomedical), generating 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs respectively. Distractors span four semantic categories from class unsatisfiability to weakened subsumptions, enabling diagnostic evaluation of specific reasoning failures. Items meet natural language quality standards: mean LLM judge scores of 4.02, 4.36, and 3.36 out of 5 confirm fluency, and correct-answer-to-distractor similarity above 0.8 shows that wrong options cannot be dismissed on surface form alone. Six LLMs evaluated zero-shot achieve 41.1-76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random-guessing baseline, indicating the benchmarks are challenging and discriminative. This work is a step towards more reliable benchmarks for assessing logical reasoning in scientific AI.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从OWL 2本体自动生成多选题基准的流水线，干扰项经语义扰动并由推理机形式化验证，在三个本体上生成1.7万余题，用于评估LLM的逻辑推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛支撑科学AI中的结构化知识推理，但逻辑推理常有缺陷，易产生事实性错误。现有评估手段存在瓶颈：人工构建数据集难以规模化，而LLM生成的题目可能引入其本身所要检测的缺陷。高质量基准需将正误样本都锚定在显式背景知识上，并可由标准推理机形式化验证。
AI.method: 构建自动生成流水线：从任意具备充分公理的OWL 2本体生成多选题，正确答案由设计保证被本体蕴含。干扰项通过扰动类定义公理的右侧类表达式生成，其错误性由OWL推理机通过蕴含检查形式化验证。干扰项覆盖从类不可满足到弱化包含关系的四类语义类别。
AI.result: 在Pizza（小型学术）、PMDco（复杂材料科学）、DOID（大型生物医学）三个本体上分别生成112、2491、15216道多选题。语言质量方面，LLM评判平均得分分别为4.02、4.36、3.36（满分5），正确答案与干扰项相似度超过0.8。六个LLM零样本准确率41.1%–76.8%，显著高于25%的随机基线。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线可生成具有本体依据、形式化可验证的诊断性基准，题目兼具语言质量与区分度，是迈向更可靠的科学AI逻辑推理评测的一步。

title: DeBERTa-ConPara: Attack-Aware and Deployment-Realistic Detection of AI-Generated Text
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (main conference). 9 pages plus appendix. Code and checkpoint: https://github.com/MohamedMady19/deberta-conpara, https://huggingface.co/mohamedmady/deberta-conpara
summary: Robust detection of AI-generated text under deployment conditions is challenging: distribution shifts across domains and generators, adversarial perturbations of the input surface, and the absence of target-domain labels for threshold calibration all degrade detectors that perform well in-domain. We present DeBERTa-ConPara, a deployment-oriented detector combining attack-aware Unicode preprocessing with a contextual transformer encoder trained over HC3 Plus, M4, MAGE and RAID. Our central finding is that preprocessing acts in opposite directions depending on where it is applied: normalising the training corpus deduplicates it, collapsing 35.4% of RAID rows into copies of their clean siblings and deleting the adversarial supervision, whereas normalising at inference is an effective defence. A factorial varying the two placements independently identifies raw training with normalised inference as the best configuration, reaching 99.61% AUROC, 99.01% TPR@5% FPR and 96.57% TPR@1% FPR on the official RAID hidden test, alongside 93.14% average balanced accuracy across HC3 Plus and MAGE under a fixed threshold. The gain is confined to two of twelve attack classes: homoglyph and zero-width-space insertion rise from 11.05% and 1.12% to 96.98%. The same signature reproduces in a zero-shot detector of different architecture, showing the effect belongs to the attacks rather than to our model. We additionally report two negative results: semantic-invariance augmentation through paraphrasing and supervised contrastive learning (ConPara) does not improve the best configuration, and the handcrafted feature-fusion branch is inert in distribution and harmful outside it.

AI.tldr: 提出面向部署的AI生成文本检测器DeBERTa-ConPara：推理端Unicode归一化是关键防御，训练端归一化反而破坏对抗监督；因子实验确定"原始训练+归一化推理"为最优配置，在RAID隐藏测试上取得99.61% AUROC。
AI.motivation: 部署条件下面临域与生成器分布漂移、输入层对抗扰动、缺少目标域标签等挑战，使在域内表现良好的检测器性能显著下降；需要一种在真实部署条件下仍鲁棒的检测方案，并厘清预处理对鲁棒性的真实作用位置。
AI.method: 构建DeBERTa-ConPara检测器：攻击感知的Unicode预处理 + 上下文Transformer编码器，训练语料为HC3 Plus、M4、MAGE与RAID。设计因子实验，独立变化预处理施加位置（训练语料归一化 vs 推理归一化），并从攻击类别层面消融归因；另做零样本异架构检测器复现验证；同时检验语义不变性增强（复述、监督对比学习ConPara）与手工特征融合分支的有效性。
AI.result: 最优配置为原始训练+归一化推理：官方RAID隐藏测试上99.61% AUROC、99.01% TPR@5% FPR、96.57% TPR@1% FPR；固定阈值下HC3 Plus与MAGE平均平衡准确率93.14%。增益集中于12类攻击中的2类：同形字与零宽空格插入由11.05%、1.12%提升至96.98%。该特征在异架构零样本检测器中同样复现。负面结果：训练语料归一化将35.4%的RAID样本去重为干净样本副本，删除对抗监督；复述增强与监督对比学习未带来提升；手工特征融合分支在分布内无效、分布外有害。
AI.conclusion: 预处理的鲁棒性收益具有位置依赖性：推理端归一化是有效防御，训练端归一化则因去重而抹除对抗信号，二者效果相反。鲁棒性提升主要由特定攻击类别（同形字、零宽空格）驱动，而非模型架构，说明该效应归属于攻击本身；语义不变性增强与手工特征融合均无正收益，提示面向部署的检测器应优先保证推理端输入规范化而非复杂训练策略。

title: What Builds the Scene? Luminance Dominates Geometry Formation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learns geometry and appearance jointly from RGB supervision, making it difficult to isolate how luminance and chroma contribute to the learned representation. We study this by training models under different channel supervision, freezing their non-appearance parameters (position, scale, rotation, and opacity), and re-estimating appearance with the same solver before comparing held-out reconstruction. Across eleven benchmark scenes with four independent runs each, geometry learned from luminance alone supports held-out reconstruction 0.085 dB below RGB-trained geometry on average. If chroma is deleted from a trained model, a sufficiently expressive solver can re-fit it on the frozen geometry to the original quality or slightly better. Higher-order spherical harmonics contribute much more reconstruction quality to luminance than to chroma, improving PSNR by 1.44 dB versus 0.19 dB on average, although on mirror-like surfaces hue does still change with viewpoint. The luminance advantage is even larger when geometry is being formed. Chroma-only supervision produces geometry 3.9-5.5 dB worse than luminance-only supervision after the same appearance solve; densification explains part of this gap. Overall, geometry formation in standard 3DGS is strongly luminance-dominated but not luminance-exclusive, and much of the chromatic appearance can be recovered after spatial support has formed.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过在不同通道监督下训练3DGS并冻结几何参数重新估计外观，研究亮度与色度对3DGS几何和外观学习的贡献。结果显示几何形成主要由亮度主导但并非排他，大部分色度外观可在空间支撑形成后恢复。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS从RGB监督中联合学习几何与外观，难以分离亮度和色度对所学表示的贡献。作者希望厘清二者在几何形成和外观重建中的各自作用。
AI.method: 在不同通道监督（亮度、色度等）下训练模型，冻结非外观参数（位置、尺度、旋转、不透明度），用同一求解器重新估计外观，再比较留出集重建结果。实验覆盖11个基准场景，每个4次独立运行。
AI.result: 仅用亮度学习的几何平均比RGB训练几何低0.085 dB；从训练模型中删除色度后，足够强的求解器可在冻结几何上重新拟合至原质量或略优。高阶球谐对亮度的重建贡献远大于色度（平均+1.44 dB vs +0.19 dB），但镜面表面色调仍随视角变化。仅色度监督的几何比仅亮度监督差3.9-5.5 dB，密度化解释了部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 标准3DGS的几何形成强烈由亮度主导但并非仅由亮度决定，大部分色度外观可在空间支撑形成后恢复。

title: Backdoor Purification for LoRA-Tuned LLMs via Null-Space Projection
summary: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, the risk of backdoor attacks has become more severe. Existing backdoor purification methods typically rely on at least one of the strong assumptions, such as prior knowledge of triggers, access to clean references, or aggressive retraining, and they often lack comprehensive evaluations. These constraints substantially limit their practical applicability. To overcome these challenges, our work proposes purifying LoRA-tuned LLMs without these assumptions and even without post-hoc retraining of the suspect parameters. Our objective is to significantly reduce the attack success rates (ASR) while preserving both (i) the base model's general capabilities and (ii) the new downstream skills learned through the adapter. Through a series of ablation studies, we progressively scale our approach from a single layer in a text classification setting to a full-parameter LLM in the generative task. Through careful data curation and feature approximation, we extract high-fidelity backdoor directions and, for each layer or head, construct orthogonal null spaces in both the input and output channels, onto which the LoRA updates are projected. Empirically, our null-space projection method reduces the ASR from nearly 100% to less than 10%, while preserving the base model's benign performance and the adapter's learned abilities during downstream task adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需触发知识、干净参考或重训练的后门净化方法，通过在输入/输出通道构造正交零空间并投影LoRA更新，将攻击成功率从近100%降至10%以下，同时保留基座模型通用能力与下游适配技能。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM与PEFT（如LoRA）的广泛应用，后门攻击风险加剧。现有后门净化方法普遍依赖至少一项强假设——已知触发器、可访问干净参考数据或需要激进重训练，且缺乏全面评估，导致实际适用性受限。因此需要一种在无这些假设、且无需对可疑参数进行事后重训练的前提下净化LoRA微调LLM的方案。
AI.method: 通过一系列消融实验，从文本分类场景的单层逐步扩展到生成任务的全参数LLM。借助精细的数据筛选与特征近似，提取高保真后门方向；对每一层或每个注意力头，在输入与输出通道中构造正交零空间，并将LoRA更新投影到该零空间上以实现净化。
AI.result: 零空间投影方法将攻击成功率（ASR）从接近100%降到10%以下，同时保持基座模型的良性性能以及适配器在下游任务适配中学到的新能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在不依赖触发器先验、干净参考或事后重训练的条件下，通过零空间投影即可有效净化LoRA调优的LLM，实现攻击抑制与能力保留的兼顾。

title: The Geometry of Contextual Relations: Language Models Address Facts by Order of Mention
summary: Human reasoning depends on how objects are related within propositions. \textit{How do relations organize the language representations of contextual contents?} We give an LLM a list of facts in its context (e.g., \emph{Alice eats an apple. Bob eats a pear.}) and measure how its hidden state changes when the question switches from what Alice eats to what Bob eats. Averaged over many lists, this change is a steering vector, which we call the \emph{ordinal vector}. It points to a fact by its \emph{order of mention}, the order in which the facts were stated in the context. We find that LLMs represent the fact a question asks about by its order of mention, not by the name the question contains. We state this as the \textit{ordinal addressing hypothesis}: each order of mention has a \emph{fact address} in the model's state, shared by all contexts, and a question moves the state to the fact address of the fact it asks about, while the context supplies what that fact says. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Llama, fact addresses are (1) \emph{ordered by mention}: query states are organized by the order of facts, not of names, even when one fact has multiple subjects; (2) \emph{steerable}: added to a question about the first fact of a new list, the ordinal vector makes the model answer with the second fact of that list; (3) \emph{low-rank}: they span a low-rank subspace in which the first-mentioned fact is the easiest to reach, surprisingly similar to human recall; and (4) \emph{emergent}: they are shared in late-middle layers, hold from 1.5B to 32B parameters, and form early in pretraining. Language models reach a stated fact by where it was mentioned, deepening our understanding of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"序数寻址假说"：大语言模型通过事实在上下文中被提及的顺序（而非名称）来定位所需事实，模型状态中存在共享的"事实地址"。
AI.motivation: 人类推理依赖于命题内部对象间的关系，但尚不清楚语言模型如何组织上下文内容的表征。作者欲探究模型在回答关于上下文中某事实的问题时，究竟依据名称还是依据提及顺序来定位该事实。
AI.method: 向LLM提供上下文事实列表（如"Alice吃苹果，Bob吃梨"），测量问题从"Alice吃什么"切换为"Bob吃什么"时隐藏状态的变化。对大量列表取平均得到"序数向量"（steering vector）。在Qwen、Gemma、Llama上验证该向量的性质，并通过注入向量进行操控实验。
AI.result: 事实地址具有四个性质：(1)按提及顺序排序——查询状态依事实顺序而非名称顺序组织，即使某事实有多个主语；(2)可操控——将序数向量加到关于新列表第一个事实的问题上，模型会回答该列表的第二个事实；(3)低秩——事实地址张成低秩子空间，首个提及的事实最易到达，与人类回忆相似；(4)涌现性——在中间偏后层共享，从1.5B到32B参数均成立，并在预训练早期形成。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型通过事实被提及的位置来定位陈述的事实，即采用序数寻址而非名称寻址，这深化了对LLM推理机制的理解。

title: Video Evidence Indexing: Learning Where to Look from Video Previews for Token-Budgeted Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering is limited by the high cost of visual tokens and by the fixed context width of current VLMs. A long-video question may require broad temporal coverage, but the answer is often supported by only a compact set of moments. To locate these moments efficiently, we propose token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI): given a dense low-resolution Video Preview, the model constructs a compact high-resolution Evidence Set for final reasoning. We treat VEI as a policy that must jointly solve \textit{evidence localization}, which finds question-relevant moments, and \textit{budget planning}, which decides where to spend the limited high-resolution frame budget. We implement this idea with an inference pipeline: the Video Preview provides cheap global coverage, Video Evidence Indexing constructs the Evidence Set, and Answer Generation combines both inputs for final VQA. To address missing frame-level supervision, we adopt privileged self-distillation, where an answer-aware teacher guides the normal test-time policy on student-generated indexing traces. We explore previews at 1, 6, 12, and 24 visual tokens per frame, training a single policy that supports all four resolutions. Experiments show that Video Evidence Indexing improves accuracy under limited visual budgets, and self-distillation further improves both QA accuracy and temporal evidence localization.

AI.tldr: 提出 Token-Budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI)，将长视频问答建模为"证据定位+预算规划"策略，用低分辨率预览+高分辨率证据集实现高效推理，并通过特权自蒸馏缓解帧级监督缺失。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答受限于视觉 token 成本高和 VLM 固定上下文宽度；但长视频问题虽需广泛时间覆盖，答案往往只依赖少量关键时刻，因此需要高效定位这些时刻。
AI.method: 给定密集低分辨率 Video Preview，构建紧凑高分辨率 Evidence Set。将 VEI 视为一个策略，联合求解证据定位（找问题相关时刻）与预算规划（分配有限高分辨率帧预算）。实现为推理流水线：Video Preview 提供廉价全局覆盖 → Video Evidence Indexing 构建 Evidence Set → Answer Generation 结合两者输出答案。针对帧级监督缺失，采用特权自蒸馏：由答案感知教师指导测试时策略，在 student 生成的 indexing traces 上学习。探索每帧 1/6/12/24 个视觉 token 的预览，训练单一策略支持四种分辨率。
AI.result: 在有限视觉预算下，VEI 提升准确率；自蒸馏进一步提升 QA 准确率与时间证据定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将长视频证据选择显式建模为 token 预算下的策略问题，并借助特权自蒸馏替代帧级监督，可在有限视觉 token 预算下同时改善长视频问答准确率与关键时刻定位能力，且单一策略可覆盖多种预览分辨率。

title: R-GroundBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for R-Group Groundingin Markush Molecular Editing
summary: Recent advances in AI for scientific discovery enable molecular understandingand design, yet reasoning over incomplete chemical representations remainsunclear.Markush structures, which encode molecular families through variable R-groupplaceholders (\textit{R\textsubscript{1}}, \textit{R\textsubscript{2}}, \textit{X}, etc.), are ubiquitous in pharmaceutical patents and requiregrounding across molecular, textual, and chemical information.However, existing molecule-language benchmarks focus on fully specifiedmolecules, leaving R-group grounding largely unevaluated.We introduce R-GroundBench:, a diagnostic benchmark built from real patent Markushstructures, featuring a Multiple-Choice (VQA) track with controlled difficultyand modality splits, and an open-ended Generation track.Our results reveal a substantial gap between recognition andmolecular grounding.While models achieve over 90\% accuracy on Easy VQA, performance drops to56--66\% on Hard VQA when shortcuts are controlled.Chemical-domain VLMs also remain unreliable, achieving only 25.7--46.2\% on HardVQA despite domain-specific pretraining.Moreover, Generation Exact Match remains below 20\% for most models and below8\% when visual input is required.These findings reveal that current AI systems lack reliable grounding andexecution for Markush editing, highlighting challenges for AI-drivenscientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 R-GroundBench，一个基于真实专利 Markush 结构的诊断性基准，用于评估模型对 R 基团（可变取代基）的跨模态 grounding 能力，揭示现有模型在化学结构理解上存在显著的识别与 grounding 差距。
AI.motivation: Markush 结构通过可变 R 基团占位符（R1、R2、X 等）编码分子家族，广泛存在于药物专利中，需要对分子、文本和化学信息进行联合 grounding。然而现有 molecule-language 基准主要针对完全指定的分子，R 基团 grounding 能力基本未被评估，导致 AI 在化学表示推理上的能力边界不明。
AI.method: 构建 R-GroundBench 诊断基准，来源于真实专利 Markush 结构，包含两个 track：(1) Multiple-Choice (VQA) track，设置了可控的难度分级与模态划分（modality splits）；(2) 开放式 Generation track。
AI.result: 模型在 Easy VQA 上准确率超 90%，但在控制捷径后，Hard VQA 上准确率降至 56–66%。化学领域 VLM 即便经过领域预训练，在 Hard VQA 上仍仅达 25.7–46.2%。Generation 的 Exact Match 对多数模型低于 20%，当需要视觉输入时低于 8%。
AI.conclusion: 当前 AI 系统在 Markush 编辑任务上缺乏可靠的 grounding 与执行能力，识别与分子 grounding 之间存在显著鸿沟，为 AI 驱动的科学发现提出了重要挑战。

title: Efficient Task Adaptation in Large Language Models: A Survey of Weight-Based, Prompt-Based, and Embedding-Based Adaptations
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed across diverse downstream tasks, efficient task adaptation has emerged as a central challenge. In response, a wide range of task adaptation methods have been proposed, spanning parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in-context learning, and embedding-injection approaches. However, these lines of work have largely evolved within individual paradigms, leaving their cross-paradigm relationships and trade-offs underexplored, especially for recently emerging embedding-based adaptations. This survey presents a unified framework that categorizes task adaptation methods by where and how task information is encoded: model weights, input prompts, or injected task embeddings. We provide a comprehensive taxonomy that integrates these paradigms, analyze their key strengths and limitations to explain how different adaptation paradigms have evolved, clarify relationships across paradigms, and highlight open problems for future research.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出统一框架，按任务信息编码位置（模型权重、输入提示、注入的任务嵌入）对任务适应方法进行分类，整合了参数高效微调、上下文学习与嵌入注入三大范式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型下游任务部署日益广泛，任务适应成为核心挑战。现有方法（参数高效微调、上下文学习、嵌入注入）多在各自范式内独立发展，跨范式关系与权衡缺乏探索，尤其是新近的基于嵌入的适应方法。
AI.method: 提出统一分析框架，以“任务信息在何处、以何种方式编码”为维度，将任务适应方法归为三类：模型权重、输入提示、注入的任务嵌入；并据此构建综合分类体系。
AI.result: 给出整合三大范式的综合分类法，分析各范式的关键优势与局限，解释不同适应范式的演化路径，厘清范式之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 跨范式关系得以澄清，并指出未来研究的开放性问题。

title: VTV-FM: Flow Matching through Variational Terminal-Velocity Closure
summary: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Most existing methods use first-order bridges: once a source and a target sample are paired, the path is a straight motion with constant velocity. FM with optimal transport (OT) improves the pairing, but the bridge itself remains linear, limiting its ability to model curved motion, acceleration, and changing directions. A natural remedy is to use second-order phase-space dynamics; however, learning the bridge requires target-side terminal-velocity information that static datasets do not provide. We propose Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM), a second-order FM framework that derives the missing velocity by minimizing acceleration energy, yielding a closed-form closure for static data. The same minimum-acceleration variational construction also defines the OT pairing cost and the acceleration targets used for training. Experiments on low-dimensional datasets, PDE-governed physical fields, and CIFAR-10 show that VTV-FM improves transport geometry and generation quality over first-order and high-order FM baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出VTV-FM，一种二阶流匹配框架，通过对加速度能量最小化求解静态数据缺失的终端速度，实现闭式闭合，并统一用于OT配对与训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配（FM）多采用一阶桥：源-目标配对后路径为匀速直线运动。即使结合最优传输（OT）改进配对，桥仍是线性的，难以建模曲线运动、加速度与方向变化。改用二阶相空间动力学是自然思路，但学习该桥需要目标侧终端速度信息，而静态数据集无法提供。
AI.method: 提出二阶FM框架VTV-FM：将缺失的终端速度通过最小化加速度能量导出，得到面向静态数据的闭式闭合解；同一最小加速度变分构造同时定义了OT配对代价与训练所用的加速度目标。
AI.result: 在低维数据集、PDE控制的物理场以及CIFAR-10上实验，VTV-FM在一阶与高阶FM基线之上改善了传输几何与生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 最小加速度变分构造可自洽地为静态数据补全终端速度，使二阶相空间桥可学习，并统一OT配对与训练目标，为超越线性桥的曲线传输建模提供可行方案。

title: Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 meta-MARL 框架，将 MARL 建模为马尔可夫博弈，定义 meta-NE 并建立其与梯度博弈算法稳定点的等价条件，实现多智能体交互策略的快速适应。
AI.motivation: 现有 meta-RL 主要针对单智能体系统，直接扩展到多智能体系统存在困难：多智能体任务不仅由环境决定，还取决于智能体之间的策略交互，因此需要专门的多智能体元学习框架。
AI.method: 将 MARL 问题建模为马尔可夫博弈（MG），提出跨 MG 分布进行交互策略快速适应的 meta-MARL 框架；定义 meta-NE 以刻画元 MARL 问题的目标解概念，并推导 meta-NE 与基于 gradient-play 的 meta-MARL 算法稳定点之间的等价充分条件。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶任务上的评估表明，所提 meta-MARL 方法相比预训练的 MARL 基线实现了更快的适应速度，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: meta-MARL 能够有效应对多智能体策略交互带来的挑战，实现交互策略的快速适应，meta-NE 与梯度博弈稳定点的等价性为算法提供了理论支撑。

title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
summary: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ReHoPER，一种仅推理、零样本的通用方法，通过在多条路径上生成并回答中间问题来提升大语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 提升大语言模型的推理能力通常依赖标注数据或任务专用提示设计，缺乏任务无关的通用方案。
AI.method: ReHoPER迭代地规划一组候选中间问题，从中选择一个进行回答，并基于更新后的历史重新规划；该方法任务无关，在不同数据集和模型上使用同一套通用指令，无需标注数据和任务特定提示设计。
AI.result: 在多个数据集（包括新提出的组合推理受控基准iLLC）上，ReHoPER优于强基线，且在组合性最强的设置中提升最大。
AI.conclusion: ReHoPER是一种有效的零样本、任务无关推理增强方法；其实现及iLLC生成器已公开，以支持后续研究。

title: Paying for Too Many Tokens? Valid and Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Annotation with Simple Heuristics
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable video annotation at scale, but costs accumulate quickly: processing a typical 60-second short-form video at one frame per second requires millions of tokens. To reduce costs, researchers rely on heuristics such as sampling a subset of frames, compressing videos into image grids, or using only a single modality. However, it remains unclear which heuristics save cost, and whether they preserve the downstream conclusions these annotations enable. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic evaluation of these heuristics using short-form videos, on two computational social science (CSS) tasks: sentiment and topic classification. We evaluate each configuration along three axes the literature typically treats separately: classification accuracy, validity of downstream inference, and per-video token cost. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. Based on these findings, we derive guidelines that can enable cost-aware VLM annotation in CSS.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了短格式视频在视觉语言模型（VLM）标注中的各类降本启发式策略，发现准确率与下游推断有效性会背离、模态增益并不必然存在，并给出在约15%token成本下逼近全视频理解的效果与成本感知标注指南。
AI.motivation: VLM使大规模视频标注成为可能，但成本随帧数迅速累积（60秒视频按1帧/秒需数百万token）。研究者常用抽帧、图像网格压缩、单模态等启发式降本，但尚不清楚哪些策略真能省钱、又是否保持下游结论有效。论文旨在填补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 在短格式视频上，针对两个计算社会科学（CSS）任务——情感分类与主题分类，对上述启发式配置进行系统评估；每条配置沿三个文献中常被分开处理的维度衡量：分类准确率、下游推断有效性（如κ一致性）与每视频token成本。
AI.result: （1）准确率与有效性背离：准确率最高的配置可能得出错误结论；（2）模态价值无保证：仅文本即可获得强表现，增加模态可能只增成本不增信号；（3）成本可与视频长度解耦：基于简单镜头切换检测构建的单个2×8图像网格，即可在约15%token成本下达到接近全视频理解的效果（κ差异在约0.05以内）。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述发现，论文提炼出可用于CSS中成本感知VLM标注的实践指南，强调应同时报告准确率、下游推断有效性与token成本，避免仅以准确率选择标注配置。

title: ReLiveGym: Evaluating Long-Lived Agents over Weeks of Replayed Reality
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents become widely adopted, they are increasingly deployed for tasks that require persistent monitoring or recurring actions (e.g., market analysis). These agents are expected to operate unattended for days or weeks, act at the right timing, and adapt to the dynamic environment over time. These challenges are not fully captured in the existing long-horizon agent work, as they often consider a static environment that is not temporally changing. We introduce ReLiveGym, a diagnostic evaluation environment of long-lived tasks in which agents act sparsely over simulated weeks of chronologically replayed real-world news, market, and social-media streams. The tasks span diverse levels of time sensitivity, reasoning intensity, and recurrence. Across eight base language models, we investigate how model choice and harness design affect agent performance on such long-lived tasks. Our results show that how agents determine when to act arises as an important harness-design axis for long-lived tasks; and that the optimal design varies across tasks and sometimes model choices as well. We also evaluate how continuous learning from hindsight feedback affects performance and addresses failure modes observed in these long-lived tasks. These findings indicate model choice, action timing mechanism, and use of feedback as important considerations in the design of long-lived agents. Code: https://github.com/SaharaLabsAI/ReLiveGym

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReLiveGym——一个用于长生命周期任务诊断评估的环境，让智能体在按时间顺序回放的数周真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流上稀疏地采取行动；基于八个基座语言模型，研究模型选择与 harness 设计（尤其是"何时行动"的决定机制）以及事后反馈持续学习对性能的影响。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体被广泛用于需要持续监控或周期性执行的任务（如市场分析），需在无人值守下运行数天至数周，把握正确时机并随时间适应动态环境。现有长时程（long-horizon）智能体研究多假设静态、不随时间变化的环境，未能充分刻画上述挑战。
AI.method: 构建 ReLiveGym：一个长生命周期任务的诊断式评估环境，智能体在模拟的数周内、按时间顺序回放的真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流上稀疏地采取行动。任务覆盖不同的时间敏感性、推理强度与重复频率。在八个基座语言模型上，系统考察模型选择与 harness 设计对性能的影响，并评估基于事后（hindsight）反馈的持续学习效果。
AI.result: "如何决定何时行动"成为长生命周期任务 harness 设计的重要维度；其最优设计随任务而变化，有时甚至随模型选择而变化。此外，持续从事后反馈中学习会影响性能，并缓解在长生命周期任务中观察到的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择、行动时机机制与反馈利用是设计长生命周期智能体时需重点考虑的要素。代码见 https://github.com/SaharaLabsAI/ReLiveGym。

title: Beyond Leaderboards: Tokenomics of Agentic Small Language Model Ensembles
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, Presented at ACM CAIS 2026 Workshop RLEval: Methods and Reinforcement Learning Environments for Evaluating AI Agents. Resubmission of permitted appeal, Ticket #MOD-104177
summary: As large language models (LLMs) move from standalone assistants into agentic workflows, evaluation must extend beyond scalar leaderboard accuracy to account for operational reliability, cost, latency, and token efficiency. We use an agentic ensemble of small language models (SLMs) with an SLM-judge-mediated feedback loop as a case study for such beyond-leaderboard evaluation. On the 541-prompt IFEval benchmark, the best ensemble achieves 97.34% strict prompt accuracy, exceeding the strongest standalone LLM baseline, gpt-5.4, by 5.81 percentage points while operating in a lower-cost regime. We then analyze the tokenomics and operational behavior behind this gain, including cost per sample, token composition, useful-output goodput, feedback-loop recovery, latency decomposition, and performance across instruction categories and constraint counts. Our results show that agentic SLM ensembles can trade additional test-time tokens and orchestration overhead for improved instruction-following fidelity, motivating multi-dimensional evaluation protocols for future agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文以小语言模型（SLM）智能体集成系统为案例，提出超越排行榜准确率的多维评估范式，在IFEval基准上以更低成本超越强基线LLM，并系统分析其token经济性与运行行为。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从独立助手演变为智能体工作流，单一准确率指标已不足以刻画系统表现，需将运行可靠性、成本、延迟与token效率纳入评估。
AI.method: 构建由小语言模型组成的智能体集成框架，并引入SLM-judge作为中介的反馈回路；在541条提示的IFEval基准上进行评测，并开展tokenomics与运行行为分析。
AI.result: 最佳集成达到97.34%严格提示准确率，比最强独立LLM基线gpt-5.4高出5.81个百分点，且处于更低成本区间；分析涵盖每样本成本、token构成、有效输出goodput、反馈回路恢复、延迟分解及不同指令类别与约束数量下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 智能体SLM集成可通过消耗额外测试时token与编排开销换取更高的指令遵循保真度，说明未来智能体AI系统需要多维评估协议。

title: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Project page: https://github.com/people-robots/Awesome-Video-Generation-Post-Training
summary: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. We frame post-training as a unifying framework and distinguish between implicit alignment and explicit alignment based on how alignment signals are enforced. From this perspective, we organize existing approaches into four broad categories: supervised fine-tuning methods, self-training and distillation methods, preference- and reward-based methods, and inference-time methods. This taxonomy provides a coherent view of how alignment signals shape model behavior across both training and deployment. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. This survey aims to provide a structured conceptual foundation and practical guidance for advancing controllable and reliable video generation models.

AI.tldr: 该综述首次系统梳理视频生成模型的"后训练与对齐"研究，以后训练为统一框架，按对齐信号施加方式区分隐式与显式对齐，将方法归为监督微调、自训练与蒸馏、偏好与奖励、推理时方法四类，并总结数据集、基准与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视频生成已从短时长低质量片段发展到高分辨率、长时长、复杂时空动态的序列，但预训练模型仍难以可靠遵循人类意图、保持时序一致性并满足物理与安全约束。相比图像和文本生成，视频对齐面临误差随时间累积、运动与外观耦合、多目标权衡、时序属性监督稀缺等独特挑战，因此需要系统的后训练策略在不从头重训的前提下适配预训练模型。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述性工作，采用文献梳理与分类学构建的方法。核心是将后训练视为统一框架，依据对齐信号如何被施加来区分"隐式对齐"与"显式对齐"，并据此把现有方法归纳为四类：监督微调、自训练与蒸馏、偏好与奖励驱动方法、推理时方法。同时梳理常用数据集、基准与评测实践。
AI.result: 论文并未报告实验数值结果，其产出为分类体系与综述性总结：一是提出隐式/显式对齐的划分视角；二是建立四类方法的统一分类学，呈现对齐信号在训练与部署两个阶段如何塑造模型行为；三是汇总数据集、基准与评测实践；四是提炼可扩展奖励设计、长时程时序一致性、稳定性与表现力权衡、安全感知生成等开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为可控且可靠的视频生成模型研究提供了结构化的概念基础与实践指引，将后训练与对齐确立为统一分析框架，明确了方法分类、评测现状与未来方向，有助于推动视频生成对齐领域的系统化发展。

title: Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty
comment: 38 pages, accepted at 2026 40th Advances in Neural Information Processing System (NeurIPS)
summary: Preference-based alignment methods typically optimize against a single preference model, and can therefore be brittle when pairwise preferences are uncertain: noisy, heterogeneous, or shift after deployment. To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable, and develop a single-loop optimistic mirror descent-ascent algorithm for it. We show that the proxy always lower-bounds the truncated hard-constrained objective, quantify the proxy-to-hard gap, and characterize an exactness condition under which the proxy recovers the robust objective. We then prove an \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})\) average-iteration convergence for the proxy-game duality gap, which implies a near-optimal robust policy for the original robust objective. Experiments on controlled tabular games and LLM alignment with uncertain preference further validate the convergence theory and show improved performance over nominal baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出鲁棒纳什对齐（Robust Nash Alignment），一个针对不确定成对偏好的博弈论对齐框架，通过四玩家原始-对偶代理博弈与单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法求解，并给出收敛性与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有基于偏好的对齐方法通常只针对单一偏好模型进行优化，当成对偏好存在噪声、异质性或部署后发生偏移而不确定时，性能会变得脆弱。因此需要一个能应对不确定成对偏好的鲁棒对齐方法。
AI.method: 将问题建模为博弈论框架：主学习者（leader）在对抗性竞争者与位于名义偏好周围模糊集内的任意偏好核下，寻求具有大最坏情况胜率的策略，该鲁棒目标可给出最坏情况性能的认证下界。针对其计算困难，引入含leader策略、follower策略、对抗核与对偶变量的四玩家原始-对偶代理博弈，并设计单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法求解。理论上证明代理始终下界于截断的硬约束目标，量化代理与硬目标之间的差距，刻画代理精确恢复鲁棒目标的精确性条件，并证明代理博弈对偶间隙的O(1/√T)平均迭代收敛。
AI.result: 理论上得到代理博弈对偶间隙的O(1/√T)平均迭代收敛率，并据此推出原鲁棒目标的近最优鲁棒策略。在受控表格博弈与不确定偏好下的LLM对齐实验验证了收敛理论，并相较名义基线取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为不确定成对偏好下的对齐提供了一种具有最坏情况性能认证的鲁棒博弈论方案，代理博弈在精确性条件下可恢复鲁棒目标，且具备可证明的收敛保证，实验表明其优于名义基线。

title: Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention for Conversational LLMs
summary: Large language models often lose track of persistent instructions and relevant information as multi-turn conversations grow. We study this cumulative contextual decay through three related failure modes: attention pollution, dilution, and drift. We propose REA (Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention), a context-management framework that assigns different persistence and representation policies to instructions and episodic interactions. Instructional Memory retains identified global constraints in a dedicated prefix. Episodic Memory preserves user inputs and compresses model replies, while heuristic retrieval selects raw text, compressed representations, or omission for each historical turn. On Long-MT-Bench+, REA improves the judge score from 6.32 to 7.36 on a 10-point scale, a 16.5% relative gain over the Vanilla baseline, and reduces average latency by 2.91$\times$. Additional evaluations show aggregate gains on three backbones spanning 1.7B-7B parameters and on Chinese and English role-playing tasks. These results support role-aware context management as a practical approach to maintaining conversational continuity and instruction adherence.

AI.tldr: 提出REA框架，通过对指令与情景交互实施差异化持久化与表示策略，缓解多轮对话中的累积语境衰减。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多轮对话增长过程中，会逐渐丢失持续指令与相关信息，即累积语境衰减，表现为注意力污染、稀释与漂移三种失效模式。
AI.method: REA（Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention）上下文管理框架：为指令与情景交互分配不同的持久性与表示策略。Instructional Memory将识别出的全局约束保存在专用前缀；Episodic Memory保留用户输入并压缩模型回复，并通过启发式检索为每轮历史选择原始文本、压缩表示或省略。
AI.result: 在Long-MT-Bench+上，REA将评判分数从6.32提升至7.36（10分制），相对Vanilla基线提升16.5%，并将平均时延降低2.91倍。在1.7B-7B参数的三个骨干模型及中英文角色扮演任务上均取得总体增益。
AI.conclusion: 角色感知的上下文管理是维持对话连贯性与指令遵循的有效可行方案。

title: Align Then Reason: A Multimodal Lip-Sync Judge for Dubbing
summary: Dubbing quality control requires a reference-free judge that can determine whether a candidate text line matches a speaker's visible articulation in both content and timing, using only silent video and text because dubbed audio may not yet exist. Existing visual speech recognizers and video-language models are poorly suited to this setting: even when fine-tuned to recover spoken content from lip motion, they remain largely insensitive to temporal errors. We introduce $\textit{Align Then Reason}$ (ATR), a multilingual lip-sync judge that first establishes a monotonic alignment between frame-level lip representations and the phonetic units of the candidate line, then reasons over this alignment to make the final judgment. An alignment scorer provides the LLM with both local evidence for each phonetic unit and a calibrated global alignment score, enabling it to reason jointly about content and timing. On a seven-language benchmark, our method improves mean AUC over the corresponding Qwen3.5 SFT baselines by 59.4%, 50.2%, and 50.8% with 2B, 4B, and 9B reasoners, respectively. The gains generalize across LLM families, reaching mean AUC improvements of 45.9% and 46.6% over the best baseline for LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, respectively. They also transfer across datasets to three unseen MuAViC languages. Furthermore, we evaluate on two downstream tasks built from real dubbing lines. On dub-line reranking, ATR-9B outperforms the best lip-reading baseline by 52.0%, while on script-to-clip assignment, ATR-9B improves over the best lip-reading baseline by 17.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Align Then Reason (ATR)，一种多语言唇音同步评判器，先对齐唇部表征与候选文本音素单元，再推理判断内容与时间一致性，在七语言基准及下游配音任务上大幅超越基线。
AI.motivation: 配音质量控制需要无参考的评判器，仅凭无声视频与文本判断候选台词是否在内容与时序上与说话者可见口型匹配（因为配音音频可能尚不存在）。现有视觉语音识别器和视频-语言模型不适用：即便微调以从唇动恢复语音内容，仍对时序错误基本不敏感。
AI.method: ATR 先建立帧级唇部表征与候选台词音素单元之间的单调对齐，再基于该对齐进行推理得出最终判断。对齐评分器向 LLM 提供每个音素单元的局部证据以及校准后的全局对齐分数，使其能内容与时序联合推理。
AI.result: 在七语言基准上，相较于对应的 Qwen3.5 SFT 基线，2B、4B、9B 推理器平均 AUC 分别提升 59.4%、50.2%、50.8%；跨 LLM 家族可泛化，LLaMA-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 较最佳基线平均 AUC 分别提升 45.9% 与 46.6%；并可迁移至三个未见过的 MuAViC 语言。下游任务中，配音台词重排序上 ATR-9B 领先最佳唇读基线 52.0%，脚本-片段匹配上领先 17.7%。
AI.conclusion: ATR 通过"先对齐、后推理"的范式有效融合内容与时序证据，在多语言、跨模型、跨数据集及实际配音下游任务上均显著优于现有基线，验证了无参考唇音同步评判的可行性。

title: Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI
summary:
Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业表示简化（ERS）与企业表示复杂度（ERC）模型，以四个维度刻画表示复杂度，并给出生命周期经济模型与AI推理性能两方面的推论。
AI.motivation: 企业信息由应用、项目、技术、组织边界与本地需求所塑造的制品承载，这些结构随时间累积，形成表示复杂度，需要企业维护、信息消费者与AI系统解读，因此有必要界定并度量这种复杂度以实现简化。
AI.method: 将ERS定义为在给定范围内降低不必要表示复杂度同时保留所需信息；提出表示中立的ERC模型，从表示对象、交互、行为、支撑来源四个维度刻画表示范围，其中前三者构成依赖类别，支撑来源刻画表示暴露；在表示层与任务层定义ERC，以支持比较并区分架构简化与检索优化。
AI.result: 给出ERS的两项推论：一是表示结构产生维护、治理、依赖、变更、增强与运行等生命周期义务，经济模型区分全局性经常成本、任务级经常成本与一次性转换成本，可在给定时间范围内评估；二是任务级ERC降低减少AI系统需识别、关联与解读的表示范围，Text-to-SQL研究表明降低模式与推理复杂度可提升推理准确率。
AI.conclusion: ERC并非通用的复杂度、性能或成本指标，而是提供可度量的架构变量，用于比较不同表示方案、转换效果、经济结果与AI推理性能。

title: A Citation-Grounded Benchmark for Trustworthy Earnings Call Transcript Analysis with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used for financial document analysis, including earnings call transcripts (ECTs). Beyond generating standalone claims, users increasingly prefer grounded analyses that pair claims with verifiable citations from source documents to enable independent validation. However, evaluating such analytical claims typically requires extensive expert annotation, which is costly and difficult to scale, and real-world financial analysis commonly involves long context-question-answer triplets, further increasing task complexity. To address these challenges and benchmark the current landscape of grounded analysis by LLMs, we propose a numeric evidence evaluation method that enables groundedness assessment without reliance on expert annotation. We also introduce an automated dataset construction pipeline and construct ECTs-100 from the top 100 constituents of the S&P 500 to support benchmark of both groundedness and correctness. In addition, we examine conscious incompetence, a practical failure mode in financial analysis in which LLMs must detect when available evidence is insufficient and refrain from producing unsupported hallucinations. Empirical results show that LLMs perform well in groundedness but face notable limitations in correctness, with informational insufficiency presenting an additional challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LLM财务文档分析中的"有据可依"（groundedness）评估难题，提出无需专家标注的数值证据评估方法，并构建ECTs-100基准数据集，同时考察模型识别证据不足的能力。实验表明LLM在有据性上表现良好，但在正确性上存在明显不足，信息不充分构成额外挑战。
AI.motivation: LLM已广泛用于财报电话会议记录（ECTs）等财务文档分析，用户日益偏好将论断与源文档中可核实的引文配对，以实现独立验证。然而，评估此类分析论断通常需要大量专家标注，成本高昂且难以规模化；同时真实财务分析往往涉及长上下文-问题-答案三元组，进一步增加了任务复杂度。因此亟需可扩展的评估方法与基准。
AI.method: 提出一种数值证据评估方法，使有据性评估不依赖专家标注；设计自动化数据集构建流水线，从标普500前100大成份公司构建ECTs-100数据集，以支持有据性与正确性的双重基准测试；并考察"有意识的无能"（conscious incompetence）这一失败模式，即LLM需识别已有证据不足并拒绝生成无支撑的幻觉内容。
AI.result: 实证结果显示：LLM在有据性（groundedness）方面表现良好，但在正确性（correctness）方面存在显著局限；此外，信息不充分（informational insufficiency）为模型带来了额外的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM财务文档的有据分析提供了可扩展的评估方法与基准资源（ECTs-100），揭示了当前模型"有据但未必正确"的短板，并指出证据不足场景是需重点改进的方向。

title: Geometric Similarity in VLM Low-Level Vision Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as powerful candidates for universal vision backbones, with representative architectures including autoregressive (AR) models and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Yet, adapting them efficiently for all-in-one low-level image restoration remains a challenge. Crucially, the field lacks an understanding of how VLMs organize hidden-layer representations and whether these structurally distinct paradigms share a common geometric organization for pixel-level perception. Such shared organization is a prerequisite for building highly transferable, unified restoration VLMs and adapters. In this paper, we systematically investigate representational similarity across 24 low-level tasks spanning 5 categories. We propose GeoSim, a unified four-level framework that analyzes task-conditioned representations from global similarity, local geometry, sparse feature decomposition, and topological verification perspectives. Our formulation applies to the analysis of hidden states in AR models and feature maps in DiTs across same- and cross-task/model settings. Our results reveal the organizing principles of low-level visual representations while exposing their limits in cross-task and cross-model agreement. Ultimately, GeoSim provides an interpretability lens for probing latent transferability in low-level vision and diagnosing model limitations in task- or model-specific scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GeoSim框架，系统分析视觉语言模型（VLMs）在24个底层视觉任务中的隐层表征组织方式，揭示自回归模型与扩散Transformer在像素级感知上的表示相似性与几何结构。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型被视为通用视觉骨干的候选，但如何高效地将其适配到"一体化"底层图像修复仍是难题。核心障碍在于领域内缺乏对VLM隐层表征组织方式的理解，也不清楚结构迥异的自回归模型与DiT是否共享统一的几何组织——而这是构建高可迁移、统一修复VLM与适配器的前提。
AI.method: 提出GeoSim，一个统一的四级分析框架，从全局相似性、局部几何、稀疏特征分解与拓扑验证四个视角分析任务条件化表征。该框架适用于自回归模型的隐状态与DiT的特征图，覆盖同任务与跨任务、同模型与跨模型多种设置。实验覆盖5大类共24个底层视觉任务。
AI.result: 揭示了底层视觉表征的组织原则，同时暴露了其在跨任务与跨模型一致性方面的局限。
AI.conclusion: GeoSim为探测底层视觉中的潜在可迁移性提供了可解释性视角，并可用于诊断任务特定或模型特定场景下的模型局限性。

title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

AI.tldr: Sapien 是一种用于执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎，通过带状态谓词的正则表达式、延迟策略生成与作用域语义检查，约束多步任务中 AI 代理的工具调用。
AI.motivation: 现有多步任务中，工具调用的有效性依赖代理已完成和已学习的内容，而传统上下文安全防御难以表达这种状态依赖，导致策略表达能力不足、防护效果有限。
AI.method: 提出 Sapien 策略引擎，用扩展正则表达式指定允许的工具调用序列，支持有状态谓词、延迟策略生成和作用域语义检查。
AI.result: Sapien 的效用与无约束代理相差仅几个百分点；即使代理被完全劫持，Sapien 策略在 AgentDojo 上排除 93–95% 攻击，在 Toolathlon 上排除 62–85%，长时任务中防护数量是工具允许列表的两倍。
AI.conclusion: Sapien 能有效执行有状态上下文策略，在保持代理效用的同时显著提升多步任务的安全性，优于工具允许列表等基线方法。

title: The Devil Is in the Reconstruction Loss Scale: Rethinking Optimization in LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods typically use sequential quantization that partitions a pre-trained LLM into a series of units (e.g., transformer blocks), with one unit quantized at each stage. State-of-the-art PTQ methods are predominantly learning-based, optimizing auxiliary quantization parameters (e.g., scaling factors, rotation matrices, clipping thresholds, and adapters) via gradient descent to minimize a reconstruction loss. A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. Through extensive empirical studies spanning representative learning-based PTQ methods, LLM families, model scales, architectures, quantization settings and various tasks, we consistently uncover Optimization Imbalance: reconstruction loss magnitudes vary dramatically across stages, accompanied by highly uneven gradient magnitudes and parameter updates under MSE. We term the cross-stage range of loss magnitudes the reconstruction loss scale, and reveal that MSE translates the unexpectedly large reconstruction loss scale into highly uneven gradient magnitudes, which in turn lead to uneven optimization strength across quantization stages. This finding suggests a general principle for improving learning-based PTQ: optimization strength across stages should be decoupled from the reconstruction loss scale.
