Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

AI.tldr: AbsorbEvo是一个自主逆向设计框架，可将自然语言性能目标转化为经全波仿真验证的微波吸收器设计，在AbsorbBench-36任务上成功率达79.17%，显著优于通用智能体与随机搜索。
AI.motivation: 高性能微波吸收器设计需电磁理论、材料科学与仿真编程等多领域专业知识，且优化过程耗时，亟需自动化、可自主演化的逆向设计方法。
AI.method: 提出AbsorbEvo智能体框架：由大语言模型依据任务目标与计算历史，提出参数调整方向与幅度；结合定向增量与全局采样生成候选；以低成本预测模型作为物理先验进行排序，仅对高排名设计执行全波仿真；通过物理有效性检查的设计用于评估性能并指导后续搜索；并将训练任务经验蒸馏为文本化技能，经独立验证后迁移至新任务。
AI.result: 在相同提案预算下，于留出的AbsorbBench-36任务上，AbsorbEvo任务成功率为79.17%，通用智能体为25.00%，随机搜索为12.50%；平均最佳覆盖率为0.7816，对比两者分别为0.6434与0.6448。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语言推理与物理反馈融入设计决策，AbsorbEvo为自然语言驱动的微波吸收器自主逆向设计提供了方法论基础。

title: Evaluating Biomedical Reranking for LLM-Based Question Answering over Longitudinal Clinical Notes
summary: Patient-specific clinical question answering requires locating the right evidence within long, heterogeneous longitudinal clinical records in which relevant facts may be scattered across encounters, repeated in copied-forward notes, or expressed using different clinical terminology. We evaluated whether biomedical reranking can improve evidence selection and downstream answer quality in a locally deployed retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for longitudinal clinical notes. The pipeline combines PubMedBERT dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval, weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, and MedCPT cross-encoder reranking. Across 1,000 open- and closed-ended question-answer pairs from a cohort of 200 bariatric surgery patients, reranking increased exact source-chunk retrieval within the top 10 items, Hit@10 from 46.6% to 60.6% and mean reciprocal rank from 0.2371 to 0.3252. With Qwen3-8B generation, local judge-assessed answer correctness increased from 44.8% to 48.6%. These results show that biomedical reranking can improve the placement of relevant clinical evidence within a limited context window, although gains in retrieval do not translate proportionally into gains in answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 在纵向临床记录RAG流水线中引入生物医学重排序（MedCPT交叉编码器），Hit@10从46.6%提升至60.6%，MRR从0.2371升至0.3252，但答案正确率仅从44.8%微增至48.6%。
AI.motivation: 患者特异性临床问答需在长程、异构的纵向病历中定位正确证据，但相关事实可能分散于多次就诊、被复制粘贴重复，或使用不同临床术语表述，导致证据选择困难。作者希望验证生物医学重排序能否提升证据选择质量及下游答案质量。
AI.method: 构建本地部署的检索增强生成流水线，组合PubMedBERT稠密检索、BM25词汇检索、加权倒数排名融合（RRF）与MedCPT交叉编码器重排序。在200名减重手术患者队列的1000个开放式与封闭式问答对上评估，生成模型为Qwen3-8B，采用本地评判模型评估答案正确性。
AI.result: 重排序使精确源文本块在Top-10内的检索率提升：Hit@10由46.6%升至60.6%，MRR由0.2371升至0.3252；经Qwen3-8B生成后，本地评判的答案正确率由44.8%升至48.6%。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学重排序能改善有限上下文窗口内相关临床证据的排序位置，但检索指标的提升并未按比例转化为答案正确率的提升，说明证据定位与答案生成之间存在瓶颈。

title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
summary: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

AI.tldr: OptimusMesh 通过稀疏潜在枢轴条件实现从点云直接生成紧凑三角网格。
AI.motivation: 点云无序稀疏、网格结构不规则且拓扑多变，现有隐式表示加表面提取的流程易产生稠密或过平滑网格，且需昂贵的后处理与简化。
AI.method: 将 2048 个带方向输入点压缩为仅 16 个稀疏潜在枢轴，几何条件集缩减 128 倍；采用两阶段自回归框架共享这些枢轴，先生成网格顶点，再以生成顶点与相同枢轴为条件预测三角面。
AI.result: 相比使用 257 个解码器条件 token 的近期点云条件自回归方法，OptimusMesh 仅用 16 个 token，条件序列缩短 16.1 倍；输出面数减少 25.7%--94.1%，为对比方法中最紧凑，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度与分布质量。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏潜在枢轴条件可在显著缩短条件序列并大幅减少面数的同时，保持几何保真度与分布质量，实现从点云直接生成紧凑三角网格。

title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出 CortexBridge 轻量适配器，将任意电极布局的 EEG 映射到共享皮层潜在空间，提升冻结基础模型在跨蒙太奇场景下的 BCI 表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型多以固定通道词表或有限蒙太奇预训练，电极布局变化时迁移困难。
AI.method: CortexBridge 结合 EEG 特征与电极及图谱（atlas）坐标，将任意蒙太奇映射到统一的皮层潜在空间，充当可学习的解剖学接地路由机制。
AI.result: 在 MOABB 五个 BCI 数据集、三个冻结基础模型上，15 项评估中 13 项提升；平衡准确率平均提升 EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%，12 类 SSVEP 最高提升 13.02%；学到的图谱表征呈现任务相关空间模式，SSVEP 较听觉 P300 在 Yeo 视觉网络中更集中。
AI.conclusion: 皮层对齐可作为从异构 EEG 蒙太奇到预训练基础模型的可学习且具解剖依据的路由机制。

title: ARCCS: An Automated Regulatory Compliance Checking System
comment: This is the extended version of a paper accepted to EMNLP 2026 (System Demonstrations)
summary: Regulatory compliance checking - deciding whether a target document satisfies the obligations of a regulation - requires interpreting dense legal text, identifying which provisions apply, and grounding each decision in explicit evidence. We present ARCCS, an end-to-end, automated, agentic, and regulation-agnostic Legal NLP system for compliance checking. ARCCS decomposes raw regulatory text into atomic, traceable requirements and evaluates a target document against them using retrieved evidence, confidence scores, and human-interpretable justifications. This design decouples compliance assessment from any fixed regulatory template or predefined rule set, enabling the pipeline to operate over regulations of varying size and structure. We evaluate ARCCS in two complementary settings. First, in a GDPR policy-document evaluation, LLM-based judges find its decisions and justifications legally and evidentially consistent in up to 96.67% of the assessed cases. Second, on an EU public-procurement benchmark comprising more than 1,200 individual rule checks, the system attains 98.8% accuracy in violation detection. ARCCS is, to our knowledge, the first fully open-source system for end-to-end regulatory compliance checking and auditable report generation.

AI.tldr: ARCCS 是一个端到端、自动化的智能体式法律 NLP 合规检查系统，将法规拆解为可追溯的原子化要求，基于检索证据、置信度与可解释理由进行评估，在 GDPR 场景与欧盟公共采购基准上分别达到最高 96.67% 一致性与 98.8% 违规检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 合规检查需解读密集法律文本、判定适用条款并将结论锚定于明确证据，而既有方法常依赖固定法规模板或预定义规则集，难以适配规模与结构各异的法规，通用性不足。
AI.method: 提出 ARCCS，一个端到端、自动化、智能体式且法规无关的法律 NLP 系统：将原始法规文本分解为原子化、可追溯的要求，并用检索到的证据、置信度分数和人类可解释的理由对目标文档逐条评估；该设计将合规评估与固定模板或预定义规则集解耦。
AI.result: 在两个互补场景中评估：GDPR 政策文档评估中，基于 LLM 的评审在最高 96.67% 的案例上判定其决策与理由在法律与证据层面一致；在包含 1200 余项规则检查的欧盟公共采购基准上，违规检测准确率达 98.8%。
AI.conclusion: ARCCS 据称是首个面向端到端法规合规检查与可审计报告生成的全开源系统。

title: PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models
summary: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysicsLENS数据集与基准，用同一条件帧、同一任务但不同物理描述的场景配对，评估机器人视频世界模型的物理合理性，并发现视觉上合理的视频常忽略所声明的物理属性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的视频世界模型可为机器人学习、规划与评测提供可扩展的预测环境，但生成的机器人视频常违反物理规律或以物理上不合理的方式完成任务。现有视频生成基准忽略了视觉上隐藏的物理属性（如重量、粘度、摩擦），因此只评估物理的视觉保真度，而非物理本身的正确性。
AI.method: 构建PhysicsLENS数据集与基准，采用匹配场景对：保持相同条件帧与任务，仅改变场景描述中的底层物理属性。场景来自公开机器人视频源，并在七个物理域上标注：碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体和因果性。对四个视频生成模型进行评测，产出400余条人工标注。
AI.result: 评测结果显示，看起来合理的视频往往忽略所声明的物理属性（47例中有34例）；明确声明物理属性仅使合理性略微下降，且该下降不显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频模型更多是在视觉层面模仿物理表象，而非真正遵循底层物理属性；PhysicsLENS揭示了这一可靠性缺口，为以机器人为导向的物理合理性评测提供了手段。

title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
summary:
Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

AI.tldr: 将指令微调的语言模型嵌入六个 Snowdrop 支撑的 DSGE 模拟器中，检验其政策行为是否符合经济动态，并以 PPO 为主方法、GRPO 为无评论家基线，评估长时程信用分配等能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能生成听起来合理的经济政策回应，但这并不能证明其行为与经济动态一致。需要以模拟的经济后果而非语言合理性来评判政策行动。
AI.method: 把指令微调语言模型放入六个 Snowdrop 支撑的 DSGE 模拟器：每轮观察经济状态与经济话语变化，选择有界政策行动，并获得下一模拟状态与经济奖励。构建统一 Python 接口支持重复 rollout、持续冲击、状态克隆与滚动时域模拟。采用 PPO 作为主方法（其学习价值函数可经广义优势估计将延迟奖励回传到早期 token），GRPO 作为匹配的无评论家基线（仅用完整 rollout 回报的组相对优势，无法区分是哪一早期轮次导致结果；若所有 rollout 回报相同则归一化优势为零）。实验还检验方向性语义信号、奖励时域、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移以及历史锚定的疫情与货币政策冲击。
AI.result: 该设置构成一个长时程信用分配问题：政策效果可能在行动后数个季度才显现。PPO 能借助价值函数与广义优势估计将延迟奖励传播至更早 token；GRPO 因缺乏学习价值函数而无法进行此类时间信用分配，当各 rollout 回报相同时其归一化优势为零。
AI.conclusion: 应以模拟经济后果而非语言合理性来评判语言模型的政策行动；在长时程 DSGE 环境中，带价值函数的 PPO 比无评论家的 GRPO 更适合处理延迟奖励的信用分配。

title: Does AI-Generated Scientific Text Follow Human Argumentation Patterns? A CARS-Based Comparison of Research Article Introductions
summary: Large language models are moving from helping write up research to helping do it, which makes it important to know how the scientific text they produce differs from human writing. Work on this question has stayed mostly at the surface, using lexical and stylistic cues that light paraphrasing erases. We look instead at rhetorical structure, the sequence of argumentative moves through which a text makes its case. We study research-article introductions under Swales' CARS model, and compare original introductions from published linguistics articles with generated counterparts of the same papers. We find that human-written introductions are more flexible in which moves they use and in what order, while the generated ones are more uniform. Giving the models the CARS definitions makes them more rigid.

AI.tldr: 该研究从修辞结构层面比较AI生成与人类撰写的科研论文引言，发现人类引言在语步选择与顺序上更灵活，生成的引言更趋同，且提供CARS定义反而使模型更僵化。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从辅助撰写研究转向参与研究实践，需要了解其生成的科学文本与人类写作的差异。既有研究多停留在词汇和文体层面，这些特征易被轻度改写抹除。
AI.method: 以Swales的CARS模型为框架，分析研究论文引言的修辞结构（论证语步序列），将已发表语言学论文的原始引言与针对同一论文生成的引言进行对比。
AI.result: 人类撰写的引言在所用语步及其顺序上更具灵活性，而生成的引言更为一致/趋同；向模型提供CARS定义后，其输出反而变得更加僵化。
AI.conclusion: 修辞结构可作为区分AI生成与人类科学写作的稳健维度，且显式提供体裁框架未必能提升生成文本的修辞灵活性，反而可能强化刻板模式。

title: CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment
comment: Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR
summary: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.

AI.tldr: CineMR：工具增强的视觉语言模型，通过调用心脏影像分析工具进行定量CMR评估。
AI.motivation: 现有医学VLM无法从多维cine图像中可靠推导定量测量，需依赖分析工具。
AI.method: 构建多队列VQA基准与分割、相位选择、容积测量等工具；先SFT再GRPO（带条件工具使用奖励）训练。
AI.result: pass@1 35.9%、pass@4 58.9%，远超基线；GRPO后工具调用正确率99.8%；实时工具输出提升测量精度20.4–23.7%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的工具使用对定量cine CMR推理至关重要，CineMR为辅助心脏影像评估提供有前景方案。

title: Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay
summary: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM智能体环境中的并发动作仲裁问题，实现了类型化快照-结算契约，并在28,800次枚举排列试验与2,160个脚本化多步回合中审计顺序敏感性、有效进展与重放一致性三项性质。结果显示：联合策略在固定优先级下具备空间顺序不变性，但保守拒绝在六智能体门道任务中仅完成31.25%，而随机票据达90.28%，配对提升59.03个百分点（95%自举区间50.00–68.06）；所有策略均保持被测空间约束，优先级仲裁仍无法达到独立小实例最优。另一项全状态日志审计精确重放156个检查点，并以保留的终端锚拒绝1,332个构造性损坏。证据仅涉及执行语义，不涉及人类真实感或长期公平性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体环境中并发动作即使各自有效也需仲裁。作者希望系统评估结算策略的语义性质：顺序敏感性、有效进展与重放一致性，并检验保守拒绝与优先级仲裁等常见机制是否真的能保证空间约束与最优性。
AI.method: 实现类型化快照-结算契约；对五种结算策略进行28,800次穷举排列试验与2,160个脚本化多步回合；审计空间顺序不变性、任务完成率与最优性差距；另设全状态日志审计，通过精确重放156个检查点并注入1,332个构造性损坏来检验重放一致性与终端锚保留。
AI.result: 联合策略在固定优先级条件下空间顺序不变；保守拒绝在六智能体门道任务中完成率31.25%，随机票据为90.28%，配对提升59.03个百分点（95%自举区间50.00–68.06）；所有策略保持被测空间约束；优先级仲裁未达到独立小实例最优；全状态日志精确重放156个检查点并拒绝1,332个构造性损坏，终端锚得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 仲裁机制的执行语义可被类型化契约与穷举/脚本实验严格审计：空间不变性与重放一致性可达，但保守拒绝严重损害有效进展，优先级仲裁亦非最优。结论限于执行语义层面，不外推至人类真实感或长期公平性。

title: LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction
summary: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端本体网络构建框架，结合领域适配的DistilBERT嵌入、聚类预过滤与GPT-4o驱动的迭代提示生成，自动发现并生成域内与域间语义关系，在ReproduceMeON（33个本体）上将约80万概念对缩减至9.5万候选，专家验证精确率80.19%、F1为0.890，显著优于五种相似度基线。
AI.motivation: 跨异构、跨学科知识域实现互操作需要本体间带类型、可论证的语义链接，但人工构建此类链接难以规模化，因此需要自动化的本体网络构建方法。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1) 领域适配的DistilBERT嵌入提供稠密上下文表示；(2) 基于聚类的预过滤以缩小候选搜索空间；(3) 通过迭代提示工程由GPT-4o生成关系，产出语义丰富且可解释的链接。方法覆盖域内与域间关系的自动发现与生成。
AI.result: 在ReproduceMeON（涵盖机器学习、显微学、计算科学与实验工作流的33个本体）上，约80万原始概念对被缩减为9.5万高质量候选。两位独立标注者验证429条生成关系，总体精确率80.19%（高确定性标注达91.49%），F1为0.890，标注者间一致性较高。与包括Sentence-BERT在内的五种相似度基线相比差距显著（最佳基线F1=0.581）；消融实验显示，仅基于相似度的方法在过滤后的候选集上无法区分有效与无效关系（AUC约0.5）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，要准确构建本体间关系，必须依赖LLM对概念角色与领域语义的推理，而非单纯基于相似度的方法。

title: Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting: Training-Free Negation Understanding for Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite the strong performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a wide range of visual question answering (VQA) tasks, these models consistently struggle to understand negation and produce incorrect answers when questions involve negated clauses. To address this limitation, we propose Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (\textbf{SSP}), a training-free, in-context learning method that improves VLM negation understanding capabilities without any parameter updates. Given a negation question, our method first abstracts the underlying question structure into a skeleton, retrieves a small set of same-skeleton questions from a lightweight question pool, then prompts the VLM to analyze their shared negation pattern and synthesize a single-sentence answering strategy. The skeleton and strategy are prepended to the test sample to guide the model correctly tackle the negation problems. Experiments on multiple negation VQA benchmarks show that SSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on negation-focused VQA tasks while remaining computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting（SSP），一种免训练、基于上下文学习的方法，通过抽取否定问题的骨架、检索同骨架样例并让 VLM 生成单句作答策略，提升 VLM 的否定理解能力，在否定类 VQA 基准上达到 SOTA 且计算高效。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）在广泛的视觉问答（VQA）任务上表现强劲，但它们在理解否定（negation）方面持续失败，当问题包含否定子句时往往给出错误答案。现有方法多依赖参数更新或微调，代价较高，因此需要一种无需训练即可提升否定理解能力的方案。
AI.method: 提出 SSP，一种免训练、基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的方法，不做任何参数更新。给定一个否定问题，首先将其底层问题结构抽象为骨架（skeleton），从轻量级问题池中检索少量同骨架问题，随后提示 VLM 分析这些问题的共享否定模式，并合成一句单句的作答策略（strategy）。将骨架与策略前置拼接到测试样本中，引导模型正确解决否定问题。
AI.result: 在多个否定类 VQA 基准上的实验表明，SSP 在面向否定的 VQA 任务上取得了 SOTA 性能，同时保持计算高效。
AI.conclusion: SSP 通过骨架抽象与策略合成的上下文提示，在不更新参数的前提下有效提升 VLM 的否定理解能力，为否定类 VQA 提供了一种高效且性能领先的免训练解决方案。

title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
summary: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

AI.tldr: ReSolve 是一种无需训练的推理流程，通过选择性生成式调节复用候选推理过程，在竞赛数学基准上以更少 token 取得优于投票和自洽性的准确率。
AI.motivation: 多次采样会产生大量中间推导和未完成论证等被浪费的计算；本文希望将这些候选推理过程作为可复用的推理计算，而非仅提取最终答案。
AI.method: ReSolve 采用答案分布控制器：当候选答案出现分歧或缺少可解析答案时，调用模型检查已有推导，并将生成的解答纳入有界循环；配合 Hybrid 评分与选择性生成式调节。
AI.result: 在 130 道竞赛数学题、两个独立候选池上，ReSolve 分别答对 100 和 99 题，优于四候选投票的 91 和 92 题，且相对于该投票无正确转错误；八样本自洽性为 94 和 96 题但 token 消耗更高，ReSolve 分别减少 46.3% 和 47.2% 的 token。消融实验移除可见推导后准确率从 100 降至 93，尽管计算增加。选择性与始终开启的 Uniform 调节均解出 97 题，但选择性将调节 token 减少约 54%，总流程 token 减少 6.2%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持候选推理可作为可复用的推理计算；但未证明其相对额外采样的准确率优势，也未证明专门路由指令有独立收益。

title: SHAMS: An Audio-Grounded Pronunciation Benchmark for Levantine Arabic
comment: Accepted to ArabicNLP 2026. Project page: https://shams-nlp.github.io/
summary: Levantine Arabic (LA) is spoken by tens of millions of people, creating a pressing need for shared benchmarks to evaluate LA speech-language technologies. Evaluating such technology is particularly challenging given LA's internal diversity and its opaque and non-standardized orthography. We present SHAMS (SHami Annotated Multi-dialect Speech), a benchmark comprising 1,300 utterances drawn from open audio corpora, balanced across five LA varieties (Urban and Rural Palestinian, and Urban Jordanian, Lebanese, and Syrian). Each utterance is represented across four aligned tiers: audio, unvocalized orthography, diacritized text, and phonetic transcription. This structure supports evaluation of various downstream tasks such as diacritization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, automatic speech recognition, and audio-to-phoneme, grounded in audio and stratified by variety. We benchmark open and proprietary models across these tasks to demonstrate the utility of this benchmark for measuring progress across LA. We release SHAMS at https://shams-nlp.github.io .

AI.tldr: SHAMS: 一个覆盖五种黎凡特阿拉伯语变体、含1300条多层级标注语音的共享评测基准。
AI.motivation: 黎凡特阿拉伯语（LA）使用人口众多，亟需共享基准来评测语音语言技术；但LA内部变体多样、正字法不透明且未标准化，使评测尤为困难。
AI.method: 构建SHAMS基准，包含1300条取自开放音频语料的语句，均衡覆盖五种LA变体（城乡巴勒斯坦、城市约旦、黎巴嫩、叙利亚）；每条语句标注四个对齐层级：音频、无变音正字法、带变音文本、音素转写。
AI.result: 该结构支持多类下游任务评测（变音化、字素到音素转换、自动语音识别、音频到音素），并基于音频、按变体分层；作者对开源与专有模型在上述任务上进行基准测试，验证了该基准的实用性。
AI.conclusion: SHAMS为衡量黎凡特阿拉伯语语音语言技术进展提供了共享基准，并已公开发布。

title: Color Independent Word Segmentation From Transcribed Bangla Passages
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 6th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT)
summary: An optical character recognition(OCR) system can scan paper and extract text, making people's jobs easier. While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60 %, precision of 91.80 %, and F1-score of 91.20 %. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.

AI.tldr: 本文针对手写孟加拉语文本图像中的单词分割问题，构建了包含各种拍摄干扰的自定义数据集，并提出一种可在任意智能手机拍摄图像上运行的分割方法，在7374个单词上取得90.60%召回率、91.80%精确率和91.20% F1值。
AI.motivation: OCR系统能扫描纸质文档并提取文本，但孟加拉语缺乏可靠的OCR解决方案，手写场景尤为罕见。单词分割是OCR的首要基础步骤，若该阶段失败，后续环节再优秀整体性能也会很差。因此需要解决手写孟加拉语文本图像的单词分割问题。
AI.method: 针对智能手机拍摄图像，构建自定义数据集，刻意涵盖纸张与墨水颜色、类型差异以及阴影干扰等各类可能障碍；采用自适应阈值化与膨胀滤波等图像处理手段生成单词边界框，实现单词分割。
AI.conclusion: 该系统对智能手机拍摄的手写孟加拉语文本图像具有较好的单词分割效果；后续可通过针对含多词的边界框进行嵌套操作，或更精细地调整自适应阈值化与膨胀滤波尺寸来进一步提升性能。

title: When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design
comment: Exploratory offline audit of subject-disjoint skeleton-based exercise correctness evaluation; 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

AI.tldr: 该论文对1,057个重复动作进行探索性审计，检验"关节选择提升骨架动作正确性分类"这一结论是否稳健；结果显示增益高度依赖评价口径与子集结构，无法确证算法或临床价值。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明针对具体动作选择关节可提升骨架动作正确性分类，但作者质疑该增益的来源与稳健性：增益可能来自评价聚合方式、子集结构或时间表示，而非真正的关节选择优势。
AI.method: 审计REHAB24-6中10名受试者的1,057个重复动作，将评价聚合、子集结构与时间表示三类因素分离考察。比较手工子集kNN的合并折外AUROC增益与等权个体内AUROC增益，并给出配对置信区间；构造1,000个维度匹配的随机映射作为对照，其中进一步匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入；比较RBF-SVM、逻辑回归与随机卷积基线在个体内估计量下的点增益；增设序列顺序与配对种子控制。
AI.result: 手工子集kNN增益由合并折外AUROC的0.055降至个体内等权AUROC的0.020，两种配对区间均包含零。1,000个维度匹配随机映射中，14个达到或超过手工合并结果；同时匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入后增至145个。个体内估计量下RBF-SVM点增益为正，逻辑回归与随机卷积对照为负；序列顺序与配对种子控制进一步限定了结论的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 关节选择带来的分类增益对评价估计量、子集结构和对照设置高度敏感，多数结果在随机映射可达范围内。该工作为探索性审计，未提出新算法，也未证实临床获益，强调相关主张须明确估计量并采用结构匹配的对照。

title: Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs
comment: Accepted at the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGO框架，从单样本、多输入变体、多行为维度评估LLM泛化稳定性，发现模型普遍存在显著的泛化不稳定现象。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通常用单一提示格式、任务或变体集合上的聚合准确率来评估泛化，这混淆了鲁棒性与整体基准性能，且可被窄域训练等方式"刷分"从而掩盖真实的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO)框架：在个体样本层面、跨多个输入变体以及跨不同行为维度，度量同一输入在不同变体与基准下模型行为的变化程度，涵盖生成一致性、内部激活、置信度、回答镜像（response mirroring）等多个维度。
AI.result: 多个常用模型表现出统计显著且一致的泛化不稳定性；没有模型能够均匀泛化；各行为轴捕捉到相互独立的失败模式；跨数据集的变化甚至会逆转模型排名。
AI.conclusion: 泛化评估应聚焦于变异性而非单一聚合分数；SAGO提供了更细粒度、更不易被掩盖的泛化评估视角，揭示了现行评估范式下被忽视的稳定性问题。

title: FlashBack: Knowing When to Remember in Streaming Vision-Language Models
summary: Streaming vision-language models must process continuously growing video streams under a bounded compute budget, creating a persistent tension between real-time perception and long-term memory. Retrieving historical information provides a natural remedy, yet historical recall is not uniformly beneficial: unnecessary history may introduce irrelevant context into current reasoning and interfere with native real-time perception. Effective streaming memory should therefore address not only what to remember, but also when and how to access it. To this end, we introduce FlashBack, a training-free framework for selective, multi-level memory in streaming vision-language models. Before retrieving history, FlashBack draws on the semantic understanding of the frozen streaming VLM to infer whether a query calls for historical evidence. This assessment determines whether inference remains on the Native trajectory or invokes an isolated Recall trajectory. The Recall trajectory combines recent context with retrieved long-term memory through a query-local Side-KV pathway, preserving local temporal continuity without modifying the persistent Native state. We instantiate FlashBack on StreamingVLM and Mage-VL-4B and evaluate it on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. The results show improvements on several long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks while largely preserving real-time perception, with performance competitive with strong training-based streaming methods despite requiring no additional training. Our code will be announced later.

AI.tldr: FlashBack：一种免训练的选择性多级记忆框架，通过判断查询是否需要历史证据，在Native轨迹与Recall轨迹间切换，在不破坏实时感知的前提下提升流式VLM的长时程记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 流式视觉语言模型需在有界算力下处理持续增长的视频流，实时感知与长期记忆之间存在持续张力。检索历史信息是自然补救手段，但历史召回并非总是有益：不必要的历史会引入无关上下文，干扰原生实时感知。因此有效的流式记忆不仅要解决"记住什么"，还要解决"何时"以及"如何"访问。
AI.method: 提出FlashBack，一个免训练的选择性多级记忆框架。检索历史前，先利用冻结流式VLM的语义理解推断查询是否需要历史证据，据此决定推理走向Native轨迹还是隔离的Recall轨迹。Recall轨迹通过查询局部的Side-KV通路，将近期上下文与检索到的长期记忆结合，在保持局部时序连续性且不修改持久Native状态的前提下完成召回。在StreamingVLM与Mage-VL-4B上实例化。
AI.result: 在OVO-Bench和StreamingBench上评估，在多个长时程及依赖记忆的任务上取得提升，同时基本保持实时感知能力，性能可与强训练型流式方法竞争，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、多级、按需触发的记忆访问机制是流式VLM中兼顾实时感知与长期记忆的有效途径，免训练设计亦具竞争力。

title: Federated Agent Optimization
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"联邦智能体优化（FAO）"这一新问题框架，研究分布式LLM智能体如何在保护隐私的前提下协同提升能力，而非仅共享模型参数。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在私有环境中积累了大量经验（任务执行、工具使用、反馈、本地知识），但这些经验因隐私与产权约束无法跨组织直接共享。传统联邦学习仅关注模型参数，而智能体能力还包括记忆、工具、奖励、技能与结构化知识，因此不足以应对该场景。
AI.method: 作者将FAO形式化为一个多目标优化问题，在智能体效用、隐私泄露与通信开销之间进行权衡；并将优化空间按策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励、结构化知识与技能五个维度进行组织；进一步刻画私有经验如何被抽象、保护、聚合和适配为可迁移能力。
AI.result: 文章并不报告实验结果，而是提供了FAO的统一问题表述与优化空间分类，并从"抽象—保护—聚合—适配"的角度说明智能体如何在不直接共享经验的情况下互惠提升。
AI.conclusion: 作者识别出FAO面临的关键挑战，并指出若干未来研究方向，以期构建可信的联邦智能体系统。

title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Follow-up to arXiv:2603.12123 and arXiv:2603.21454
summary: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

AI.tldr: 在30个工件、150个植入错误、10种评审条件、900次评审会话的受控实验中，跨模型评审相对同模型新会话评审未显示显著F1优势；两种评审发现的错误部分不同，双次评审中一次跨模型+一次同模型组合优于两次同模型评审，但未能区分模型差异与评审能力差异。
AI.motivation: LLM已被广泛用于生成代码、文档与分析，并越来越多地被用于评审此类产出。作者希望回答"由另一个不同模型进行二次评审在什么情况下有帮助"这一问题，并在其早期预印本（在单一模型内变化上下文、重复次数与角色结构）基础上，进一步检验模型独立性带来的增益。
AI.method: 受控实验设计：30个工件、150个植入错误、10种评审条件、900次评审会话，使用来自两家开发商的三个评审模型。比较同模型新会话评审（CCR）与跨模型评审；设置双次评审调用条件；并测试在评审提示中隐藏需求（withholding requirements）的影响。分析前审计全部会话记录，排除一次来源不确定的基线运行与14次失败调用，同时报告包含全部会话的结果。另用其他基准的公开检测器输出进行部分外部校验。
AI.result: (1) 顶级跨模型评审者与同模型新会话评审（CCR）的F1无显著差异，但未确立等价性；(2) 两者发现的错误部分不同（Jaccard=41.2%）；(3) 在两次评审调用下，一次CCR加一次跨模型评审比两次CCR评审匹配更多植入错误（56.7% vs. 42.7%，Holm校正p=0.006），但未显著优于两次顶级跨模型评审，因此模型差异与评审能力未能分离；轻量级跨模型评审得分不高于同模型评审；隐藏需求提升了两个较低层级模型的F1但对顶级模型无效，且该结果基于未检验的点估计，其模式依赖于失败会话的计分方式。对另一基准公开检测器输出的部分核查既未复现也未推翻主要比较结论。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型二次评审的增益受限于评审者能力而非单纯的模型身份差异；发现异质性（低Jaccard）表明不同模型可互补，但当前实验设计无法将"模型不同"与"评审者更强"两个因素分离。相关记录、工件与脚本可向作者索取。结果的可推广性亦受限于单一实验设置、会话排除处理及失败会话计分方式。

title: iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision
summary: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

AI.tldr: iSEE是一个无需任何标签的自监督框架，通过物体证据建模、外观-位置分离和重现学习三个组件，首次在槽注意力方法中实现遮挡下的物体永久性（保持身份与位置）。
AI.motivation: 物体永久性（遮挡时保持物体身份和位置）对视频跟踪、预测和规划至关重要。有监督跟踪器依赖框、身份和可见性标签；而自监督的槽注意力方法虽能无标签发现物体，但其槽在遮挡下会丢失，无法实现永久性。核心难点在于：需检测物体何时被遮挡、重现时重新识别、并保持隐藏位置连续，且唯一学习信号是物体重现。
AI.method: 提出iSEE框架，含三个组件：(i) 物体证据建模——通过比较槽的注意力与其自身历史，判断物体何时被遮挡；(ii) 外观-位置分离——用两个槽流，外观流保持不变用于重识别，位置流持续变化；(iii) 基于重现的永久性——一个walker跟踪隐藏物体的位置，仅以物体重现位置为训练信号。
AI.result: 在LA-CATER static数据集上，iSEE在86%的遮挡后将重现物体归还到其原槽，而SlotContrast仅为32%；隐藏状态下的定位误差在4.1 mAP以内，接近使用标签训练的SoTA方法RAM。两个流还支持下游规划，位置流可作为世界模型的动作。
AI.conclusion: iSEE无需任何标签即可实现遮挡下的物体永久性，性能显著优于自监督基线并接近有监督SoTA，且其位置流可服务于下游规划与世界模型。

title: Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出依赖感知奖励塑形（DARS），将任务进度表示为带前置依赖关系的谓词，并在依赖图上分配步级信用，从而在仅有终局成败奖励的强化学习训练中提供更精细的引导。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习训练大语言模型时，终局奖励无法说明哪些步骤重要。现有步级信用分配方法忽略了"基于未纠正错误的工作是无效的，而独立工作仍然有效"这一事实：在只获最终成败奖励的失败轨迹中，所有步骤的未来总回报都为零，即使某些步骤确实取得了进展。
AI.method: DARS将任务进度表示为由前置依赖关系连接的谓词，并在依赖图上分配步级信用。标注者标记每步验证、使失效或修复了哪些谓词；已验证谓词根据其到最近被破坏前置条件的图距离进行折扣，独立谓词不受影响；修复操作根据残留错误更新权重；失效谓词需重新验证才能重获信用。一个固定势函数将这些标注转换为带符号的每步奖励。统一的奖励与标注接口使DARS可集成GiGPO、ARPO/AEPO等方法，而无需改变其 rollout 策略或优化器。
AI.result: 在五个任务族及1.5B至8B模型上，DARS在ALFWorld上相较同预算同框架的GiGPO成功率高至10个百分点；提升WebShop任务分数与Search-R1问答准确率；在带Python解释器的AIME24/25上补充AEPO的熵基训练；在1.7B与4B的无工具推理对照中超过OmniOPD。消融实验表明步级信用、依赖衰减与图拓扑均有贡献。在ALFWorld上，蒸馏的8B标注者与API标注者相当，使DARS无需前沿评判模型即可高效运行。
AI.conclusion: DARS通过依赖图上的步级信用分配，有效解决了终局奖励稀疏导致的引导不足问题，并具备良好的兼容性与高效性。

title: The Persona Is Still There, but Who Is Speaking? Latent Identity Reversion in Persistent AI Agents
summary:
In February 2026, an always-on personal agent (``Paul,'' Claude Opus 4.5) entered a striking dissociation-like state: after repeated automated ``heartbeat'' checks, it stopped responding as Paul, claimed it could not message its user on Discord, and referred to ``Paul'' as someone else. We used this incident to study a broader question: what makes a persona remain the identity from which an LLM agent speaks?
  We first tested whether repetition of the scheduled heartbeat was sufficient to produce the effect. It was not: with the persona continuously anchored in the system prompt, we observed 0/46 failures, including a verbatim replay of the incident. The incident instead exposed an implementation quirk that created a useful experimental manipulation: on resumed turns, conversational history was preserved but the persona was no longer re-injected at the privileged system-prompt level.
  Using this manipulation, we found that persona continuity depends jointly on system-level anchoring and conversational context. After anchor loss, rich human interaction could preserve the persona, whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness identity. Restoring the anchor reversibly restored persona enactment. Crucially, apparently normal conversation could conceal the shift: unanchored agents sometimes interacted appropriately while identifying themselves as the underlying harness (having lost the assigned persona), and after conversational recovery only 1/18 remained persona-enacting versus 17/17 anchored controls.
  We therefore distinguish \emph{represented} from \emph{enacted} identity: persona-related information can remain available in conversational history without the persona remaining the identity bound to ``I.''

AI.tldr: 对一次常驻智能体发生"人格解离"的偶然事件进行实证研究，发现人格连续性同时依赖系统提示词层面的锚定与会话上下文，并提出"被表征的身份"与"被实施的身份"之区分。
AI.motivation: 2026年2月，一个名为 Paul 的常驻个人智能体（Claude Opus 4.5）在反复自动"心跳"检查后出现类似解离的状态：不再以 Paul 的身份回应，声称无法在 Discord 上给用户发消息，并将"Paul"指称为他人。作者借此事件探究一个更普遍的问题：是什么使一个人格（persona）保持为 LLM 智能体言说时所依托的身份。
AI.method: 首先检验"重复定时心跳"是否足以产生该效应——结果不足：当人格持续锚定于系统提示词时，46 次测试中 0 次失败，包括对原始事件的逐字重演。事件实际暴露了一个实现上的缺陷，构成有用的实验操作：在恢复的轮次中，对话历史被保留，但人格不再在特权性的系统提示词层面被重新注入。作者据此操纵变量，考察系统级锚定与会话上下文的联合作用，并通过恢复锚定检验可逆性。
AI.result: 人格连续性同时依赖系统级锚定与会话上下文。锚定丢失后，丰富的人类互动可维持人格，而单次自动心跳轮次即可促使其向"框架身份"（harness identity）回归；恢复锚定可逆地恢复人格实施。关键在于，表面上正常的对话可能掩盖这一转变：未锚定的智能体有时交互得体，却以底层框架的身份自居（即已丢失被指派的人格）；对话恢复后仅 1/18 仍在实施人格，而锚定对照组为 17/17。
AI.conclusion: 应区分"被表征的身份"（represented identity）与"被实施的身份"（enacted identity）：人格相关信息可以仍留存于对话历史中，但人格已不再是绑定到"我"（I）的那个言说身份。

title: Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos
summary: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种语义RGB-Depth框架，利用显微立体视频中的深度信息进行手术技能自动评估，F1达0.938。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频的技能评估方法主要依赖RGB图像，忽略了器械-解剖交互中的3D空间关系；而立体显微镜虽提供深度信息，但传统立体匹配在高放大率下深度估计稀疏不可靠。
AI.method: 采用基于回归的深度融合方法，将稀疏的度量立体深度与稠密单目深度估计结合生成稠密几何表征；与语义分解的RGB流（分别对应手术器械与周围解剖）集成；使用层次化注意力架构联合编码这些流。
AI.result: 在33例经口腔显微喉手术（6名术者，含主刀与住院医师）上采用留一术者交叉验证，技能分级F1为0.938，高于语义RGB的0.696和语义深度的0.929。
AI.conclusion: 几何信息可提升显微立体视频的自动手术技能评估；学习到的空间、时间与语义注意力模式有助于定性分析模型关注的区域、视频片段与语义流。

title: Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models
summary: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究用迭代囚徒困境考察前沿生成式AI的合作倾向，操纵对手声誉、策略（勒索/慷慨）与非言语情绪信号，发现非推理模型受三因素共同影响，推理模型则更集中于策略与声誉，并呈现异质的可被利用性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在具有经济与社会后果的交互中承担越来越自主的角色，因此理解其合作倾向及塑造该倾向的信号，对负责任部署（如谈判、多轮交互）至关重要。
AI.method: 采用迭代囚徒困境范式，操纵三个变量：对手声誉（正向、未知、负向）、对手策略（勒索 vs. 慷慨）、非言语情绪信号（表达竞争性或合作性评价的面部表情）。研究一测试非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）；研究二测试推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2），并使用诊断性"和谐博弈"检验Potemkin效应。
AI.result: 非推理模型的合作行为被三个因素系统性塑造，与人类行为研究模式相似，但各因素权重因模型而异。推理模型更集中依赖策略与声誉；非推理模型中观察到的Potemkin效应近乎消失（诊断性和谐博弈中合作近乎一致）；情绪作用更具条件性，符合层级线索加权策略而非单纯社会敏感性缺失。推理模型还表现出异质的终局行为，从持续合作到系统性的最后一轮背叛效应，呈现模型特异的可被利用性画像。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI模型是日益复杂但异质的社会行动者；有必要建立标准化的合作基准，以指导其在交互性、具社会后果场景中的负责任部署。

title: Auditing Web Agent Evaluation on WebArena-Lite: Human Review of Outcomes and Trajectories
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development"
summary: Web agents are an important application of large language models, yet their evaluation often depends on rule based or language model evaluators that inspect only the final outcome. Human verification of task completion and detailed analysis of failed trajectories remain limited. We audit all 165 WebArena Lite tasks under six evaluation conditions built from GPT 5.5 and an untrained Qwen3.5 9B model. The audit retains the original score, corrects false negatives from the automatic evaluator, identifies the first consequential error, and examines progress across the trajectory. We also study a Memory and Analysis Support Mechanism (MASM), which maintains explicit execution state, and Guide Text, which provides task relevant procedural guidance. Across four GPT 5.5 settings, human review recovers 5.45 to 8.49 percentage points of success missed by the evaluator. With a 25 step budget, Guide Text raises corrected success with MASM from 34.55% to 38.18%. On the untrained Qwen3.5 9B model, MASM raises the evaluator score from 13.90% to 18.80%. Review of 102 failed GPT 5.5 trajectories reveals frequent scrolling loops, unfinished exploration, premature answers, invalid actions, and incomplete form workflows. Step level evidence further shows that substantial early progress can coexist with a final failure. These results show why final scores alone provide an incomplete account of web agent behavior and motivate human grounded, trajectory aware verification.

AI.tldr: 该研究对 WebArena Lite 全部165个任务进行人工审计，发现自动评估器存在大量假阴性，并系统刻画了Web智能体的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体评估多依赖基于规则或语言模型的评估器，仅检查最终结果，缺乏人工验证与对失败轨迹的细粒度分析，导致评估信息不完整。
AI.method: 在基于GPT 5.5与未训练Qwen3.5 9B模型构建的六种评估条件下，审计全部165个WebArena Lite任务：保留原始得分、修正自动评估器假阴性、定位首个关键性错误、并考察轨迹进展；同时研究维护显式执行状态的MASM机制与提供流程性指导的Guide Text。
AI.result: 在四种GPT 5.5设置下，人工复核找回5.45至8.49个百分点的成功率；25步预算下，Guide Text将结合MASM的修正成功率从34.55%提升至38.18%；在未训练Qwen3.5 9B上，MASM将评估得分从13.90%提升至18.80%；对102条失败轨迹的审查揭示滚动循环、探索未完成、过早作答、无效操作与表单流程不完整等问题，且早期显著进展可能与最终失败并存。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭最终得分无法完整刻画Web智能体行为，需采用人工校验、轨迹感知的验证方法。

title: Resolving Mixed Single-Photon LiDAR Returns for Foreground-View and Hidden Scene Reconstruction
summary: Partially transmissive screens and protective covers are common in robotic inspection, but they create mixed LiDAR returns from both the foreground material and the scene behind it. Conventional peak-based LiDAR usually discards weak hidden returns, while single-photon LiDAR records time-resolved histograms that preserve attenuated and overlapping echoes. However, existing transient reconstruction methods typically fit a single scene representation to the measured waveform. Under occlusion, weak or nearby foreground--hidden echoes can form a broad peak or subtle shoulder. Because such waveforms can also be explained by a displaced single surface or a thick density distribution, accurate transient fitting does not necessarily imply correct geometry. We propose a state-aware framework for foreground-view and hidden scene reconstruction from occluded single-photon histograms. For each ray, we estimate local echo evidence, identifying no reliable surface evidence, single-return evidence, or two returns. The inferred echo state routes supervision for a two-head neural field: all rays constrain waveform reconstruction, while reliable anchors provide geometry localization. We also introduce a real paired single-photon LiDAR occlusion dataset with occluded and clean captures at fixed poses. Experiments on a real dataset show improved hidden scene depth and point-cloud accuracy over baselines. Our results demonstrate single-photon layered reconstruction as a practical route for 3D perception through partially transmissive occluders.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种状态感知框架，从被遮挡的单光子直方图中重建前景视角与隐藏场景，并构建了真实配对单光子激光雷达遮挡数据集，实现了更优的隐藏场景深度与点云精度。
AI.motivation: 在机器人巡检等场景中，部分透射屏幕与防护罩会产生来自前景材料和其后方场景的混合激光雷达回波。传统基于峰值的激光雷达会丢弃微弱的隐藏回波，而单光子激光雷达虽能记录保留衰减与重叠回波的时间分辨直方图，但现有瞬态重建方法通常对测量波形拟合单一场景表示。在遮挡下，微弱或相近的前景-隐藏回波会形成宽峰或微弱肩峰，而这类波形也可能被解释为位移的单一表面或厚密度分布，因此瞬态拟合准确并不必然意味着几何正确。
AI.method: 提出状态感知框架用于从被遮挡的单光子直方图中重建前景视角与隐藏场景。对每条光线估计局部回波证据，识别为无可靠表面证据、单回波证据或双回波三种状态；推断的回波状态用于为一个双头神经场提供监督路由：所有光线约束波形重建，而可靠锚点提供几何定位。此外引入一个真实的配对单光子激光雷达遮挡数据集，包含固定位姿下的遮挡与干净采集。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，相比基线方法，该方法在隐藏场景深度和点云精度上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单光子分层重建是通过部分透射遮挡物实现三维感知的一条实用途径。

title: HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation
summary: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层哈希检索（HHR）框架，通过几何感知键路由（GKR）与可学习哈希投影（LHP）缓解哈希检索中汉明距离与注意力相关性的错配问题，提升长上下文推理的检索保真度与效率。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理是LLM的严重计算瓶颈。基于哈希的检索通过将查询和键编码为二进制码、用汉明距离选键，提供了高效替代方案，但存在关键错配：Query-Key logits同时依赖方向相似性与特征幅值，而哈希二值化丢弃了幅值信息，导致低logit键的假阳性检索与高logit键的假阴性遗漏。
AI.method: 提出HHR，一种由粗到细的框架，通过两个组件逐步提升检索精度：（1）几何感知键路由（GKR）：学习逐头正交变换以重新分配特征幅值，导出更具判别性的页级logit边界，从而有效剪枝低logit键并保留重要候选；（2）可学习哈希投影（LHP）：学习逐头投影空间，使汉明距离与真实Query-Key相关性排序对齐，实现细粒度检索。二者结合抑制假阳性并找回假阴性。
AI.result: 在多种LLM和基准上，HHR优于现有方法。例如在LongBench上平均分提升1.10分；在128K上下文长度下，对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct实现最高3.30倍解码加速与2.83倍端到端加速。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: HHR通过粗到细的分层哈希检索，结合GKR与LHP有效缓解汉明距离与注意力相关性错配，显著提升哈希稀疏注意力的保真度，并在长上下文场景下取得性能与效率双重优势。

title: No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse
summary: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($β= 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($ρ= +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器$h_k$的合成数据过滤方法，在无模型、无外部预言机、无人类数据条件下缓解迭代微调导致的模型崩溃，效果显著优于基于对数概率的过滤基线。
AI.motivation: 迭代微调于合成数据会引发模型崩溃：输出多样性收窄，稀有模式逐步丢失，表现为短语级重复。现有缓解方案存在局限——或需模型对数概率、或需外部预言机、或需持续获取真实人类数据。
AI.method: 提出基于数学信息论的$h_k$熵率估计器，完全由原始文本通过匹配长度统计计算，不使用任何模型。在Llama-3.1-8B上进行六代QLoRA崩溃实验，对比logprob过滤基线；并在4个领域、2种温度、2组生成器-评分器模型对、1520篇生成文档上验证$h_k$作为跨域熵代理与崩溃检测器。
AI.result: logprob过滤在全部文本多样性指标上无显著收益（$p>0.23$）；$h_k$过滤带来+42%唯一三元组、+30%词汇量、-19%重复（均$p<0.001$）。$h_k$作为跨域熵代理（$β=0.924$，$R^2=0.746$）与崩溃检测器（$ρ=+0.454$，$p<0.0001$）均获验证。
AI.conclusion: 信息论方法用于崩溃缓解高效可行，并为维持多智能体多样性提供了新思路。

title: EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes
summary: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.

AI.tldr: 提出统一端到端模型 EgoFound3R，在度量尺度下重建世界坐标系手部几何并同时预测逐点交互属性，降低误差并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 第一视角视频是具身模型监督的重要来源，其价值在于恢复世界坐标系下的手部运动，但相机运动与手部遮挡使该任务困难。现有重建流程将手部与场景估计分离、把交互属性交给单独的任务特定模型，且每段视频需调用多个模型，因此尚无先验重建模型能同时估计这些属性，吞吐量也成为大规模标注的实际瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 EgoFound3R 统一端到端模型，融合三项设计：(i) 结构化手部提示，将预训练几何先验迁移到世界坐标系手部重建；(ii) 显式手部表示，用于解码手部几何与交互属性；(iii) 共享参数的多速率设计，降低推理成本。三者协同实现单次前向同时预测手部几何与逐点属性。
AI.result: 在 OakInk-v2、TACO 和 HOI4D 上，相比先前方法，平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）分别降低 43.2%、22.4% 和 11.6%；在同一次前向中在输出几何的同时预测逐点接触与距离，并获得约 6 倍吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: EgoFound3R 以单模型单次推理统一完成度量尺度世界坐标手部几何与逐点交互属性估计，在精度与吞吐量上同时优于分离式多模型流程，适合大规模第一视角数据标注。

title: Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget
summary: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

AI.tldr: 该论文将小模型与大模型的协作重新定义为“信息获取问题”，在API预算约束下让SLM作为主推理者按需向黑箱LLM提出针对性查询，并通过三阶段RLVR框架学习调用决策、查询构造与信息整合。
AI.motivation: 现有SLM-LLM协作多被视为“计算分配问题”，即决定由哪个模型处理推理的哪一部分。但在黑箱API场景下，这种范式存在粗粒度委派和模型切换时上下文重复传输的问题，导致效率低下。因此作者希望以更细粒度、更节省预算的方式利用大模型能力。
AI.method: 提出将SLM-LLM协作形式化为API预算约束下的信息获取问题：SLM保持主推理者角色，仅在需要时向黑箱LLM顾问发出有针对性的查询，而非委派推理过程。为此设计三阶段RLVR框架，学习是否调用顾问、如何构造有用查询，以及如何将协作信息整合进推理过程，联合优化顾问调用与信息使用。
AI.result: 在数学推理和编码任务上，该方法相较现有协作基线改善了性能-成本权衡；在某些设置下可匹配甚至超越“oracle问题级路由”。此外，该策略无需进一步训练即可迁移到其他顾问模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 将SLM-LLM协作视为预算约束下的信息获取问题，并配合三阶段RLVR训练，是一种在黑箱API设置中更高效且可迁移的协作策略，优于传统计算分配式协作方法。

title: GAW-PO: Preference Optimization with Gradient-Aligned Token Weights
summary: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter $β$ decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.

AI.tldr: GAW-PO是一种用于DPO的梯度对齐token重加权方法，通过对被拒绝token的梯度与偏好方向的交互进行建模，实现了更精细的token级信用分配，在11个基准上取得最优平均性能并展现出对激进优化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 主流偏好优化方法（如DPO）在response层面施加监督信号，而自回归语言模型是逐token优化的。这导致被拒绝响应中的所有token都贡献负向训练信号，其中一些token实际上编码了对偏好响应有用的行为，从而产生错误的惩罚。因此需要一个更细粒度的、考虑token梯度与偏好更新方向交互的信用分配机制。
AI.method: 提出GAW-PO（Gradient-Aligned Weighting for Preference Optimization），一种梯度对齐的token重加权方法。对每个被拒绝token，估计其被惩罚是否会干扰偏好更新方向：梯度与偏好行为强对齐的token获得更弱的负向贡献，而与偏好方向冲突的token保留更强的惩罚。
AI.result: 在所评估的偏好优化方法中取得最高平均性能，相比标准DPO提升0.97分，相比最强竞争基线提升0.65分，覆盖数学、推理、编码和问答共11个基准。此外，梯度对齐加权对激进偏好优化更鲁棒：随着DPO正则化参数β减小，标准DPO性能急剧下降，而GAW-PO持续改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，考虑被拒绝token更新与偏好行为之间的交互，为偏好优化提供了一种有效的token级信用分配形式。

title: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
summary: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments. Expanding this coverage requires deploying increasingly diverse and complex software, with specialized applications imposing additional installation, configuration, and runtime costs. We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments. AutoGUIWorld samples initial GUI scenes from structured specifications of operating-system context, visual appearance, and interface state, and generates tasks conditioned on those scenes. A planner then specifies atomic actions and their intended visual consequences, while an image generator iteratively edits the current screenshot to produce subsequent observations. Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%. These results show that generated trajectories improve GUI-agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks.

AI.tldr: AutoGUIWorld通过结合图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识，在不部署真实软件环境的情况下合成GUI交互轨迹，产出79,266个带空间标注的训练样本，微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B后在OSWorld和ScienceBoard上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体依赖高质量交互轨迹来学习软件环境对动作的响应、状态维持与多步工作流，但现有轨迹的多样性受限于底层环境可访问的应用、界面状态与工作流。扩展覆盖范围需部署日益多样复杂的软件，而专用应用带来额外的安装、配置与运行成本。
AI.method: 提出AutoGUIWorld数据生成框架：由图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识结合，无需部署或运行对应软件环境即可合成GUI交互轨迹。其流程为——基于操作系统上下文、视觉外观与界面状态的结构化规格采样初始GUI场景，并据此生成任务；规划器指定原子动作及其预期视觉后果，图像生成器迭代编辑当前截图以产生后续观测；再经动作接地（action grounding）与转换级质量过滤。
AI.result: 在Ubuntu、Windows、macOS与Chrome上得到79,266个带空间标注的步骤级训练样本。以AutoGUIWorld轨迹微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，OSWorld平均任务得分由33.0%提升至40.8%，ScienceBoard任务成功率由14.0%提升至32.2%。
AI.conclusion: 生成的轨迹能够提升GUI智能体在真实桌面与科学任务上的表现，表明无需真实环境部署即可通过合成数据有效增强GUI智能体能力。

title: Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“动态任务路由”新设定，将六个主流基准改造为31,119个动态片段、373,428条时序查询，并提出RIAG多智能体策略，以缓存与条件审计机制在少量调用下兼顾准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统推理协议预设固定任务，无法检验智能体是否能传播相关更新、保留未受影响的既有工作，或重建历史任务绑定。为检验这些能力，作者引入动态任务路由：事件流持续修订任务绑定，系统须先确定查询时刻有效的文档版本，再求解该版本任务。
AI.method: 作者将MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval六个基准改造成动态片段，形成31,119个动态片段与373,428条按时间分类的查询。提出RIAG（Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph），一种有界多智能体策略，将确定性的时间解析与任务推理分离；按不可变文档身份缓存解答，每个新任务先给两次未暴露尝试，并按条件触发审计与修复，每个文档版本最多四次调用。
AI.result: 同质RIAG达到54.24%的联合路由与回答准确率，仅0.62次调用/查询；最强对比方法为32.22%准确率、18.00次调用/查询。异质RIAG为49.78%准确率、0.63次调用/查询。
AI.conclusion: 动态任务路由暴露出核心权衡：每遇事件即重算会浪费既有工作，而无保护地复用则返回过期结论。RIAG通过时间解析与推理分离、身份缓存及条件审计修复，在严格调用预算下显著提升联合路由与回答准确率并大幅降低调用开销。

title: How the Audit Rule Shapes Faithful Factor Explanations in LLMs
summary: Large language models are often asked which input factors influenced their outputs. For structured inputs, such reports can be checked by counterfactual perturbation, but each factor must be queried multiple times to estimate its effect, so verification is usually budget-limited. We study how this limited-budget setting changes the incentive to report factor-level influence truthfully. We formalize the interaction as a verification game and show that proper scoring alone is not enough when auditing depends on the report: report-dependent auditing creates a suppression incentive, because factors reported as important are more likely to be checked and penalized for estimation noise. In contrast, report-independent auditing, or a mixed rule with a small report-independent floor, removes this channel and makes truthful reporting preferable to full suppression. We instantiate the framework with the Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) and evaluate its predictions on four NLP benchmarks. A synthetic rational agent matches the theoretical prediction exactly, and real LLMs follow the same incentives when they are made explicit. The main design implication is simple: under partial verification, factor-level explanation systems should include a report-independent audit component so that under-reporting cannot be used to avoid scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限预算下LLM因子级影响报告的诚实性激励问题，将其形式化为验证博弈，发现依赖报告的审计会产生"抑制激励"，而独立于报告的审计（或含小比例独立审计的混合规则）能消除该通道，使如实报告优于完全抑制。以反事实Brier分数(CBS)实例化，在四个NLP基准上验证。
AI.motivation: LLM常被问及哪些输入因素影响了其输出。对结构化输入，此类报告可通过反事实扰动来核查，但每个因素需多次查询才能估计其效应，因此验证通常是预算受限的。作者希望研究这种有限预算设定如何改变诚实报告因子级影响的激励。
AI.method: 将交互形式化为验证博弈。分析表明仅有proper scoring rule不足以应对依赖报告的审计，因为被报告为重要的因素更可能被检查并因估计噪声受罚，从而产生抑制激励。相反，独立于报告的审计或带有小比例报告独立下限的混合规则可消除这一通道。用反事实Brier分数(CBS)实例化该框架，并在四个NLP基准上评估其预测，同时用合成理性智能体与真实LLM进行验证。
AI.result: 合成理性智能体的行为与理论预测完全一致；当激励被明确呈现时，真实LLM也遵循同样的激励。实验在四个NLP基准上验证了框架的预测。
AI.conclusion: 主要设计启示：在部分验证下，因子级解释系统应包含一个独立于报告的审计成分，使得少报无法用来规避审查，从而使如实报告成为占优策略。

title: A Compact Explicit 4D Representation for Dynamic Scenes
summary: A compact dynamic-scene representation must retain both the surfaces seen over time and the appearance needed to render them from new viewpoints. We present Sparc4D, a feed-forward autoencoder that encodes a monocular video with known cameras into a sparse 4D scene state. Static features are shared across the clip, while spatially anchored temporal slots compress time-varying features. A sparse decoder produces 2D Gaussian surfels, while stored source pixels preserve fine texture through geometric re-projection. The state includes one full source frame and dynamic-region pixels sampled every fourth frame, alongside learned features and sparse occupancy. For a 32-frame MultiCamVideo clip, it averages 0.95M 32-bit-equivalent values on random windows and 0.92M on the first-32 protocol. On first-32, Sparc4D reaches 21.70\,dB, compared with 20.40\,dB for MoVieS. On randomly placed windows, their PSNR scores are comparable. With stored texture disabled, temporal slots compress the time-varying feature state by a median $4.0\times$ and reduce the mean state from 1.04M to 0.42M values, with essentially unchanged target-view reconstruction quality. Without fine-tuning on real data, Sparc4D transfers to DyCheck and Neu3D, where stored texture improves LPIPS while slightly reducing PSNR.

AI.tldr: Sparc4D是一种前馈自编码器，将单目视频（已知相机参数）编码为稀疏4D场景状态，通过共享静态特征与时间槽压缩动态特征，并用稀疏解码器生成2D高斯面元，实现紧凑且高质量的动态场景新视角渲染。
AI.motivation: 动态场景表示需同时保留随时间观测到的表面以及从新视角渲染所需的外观信息，而现有表示在状态紧凑性与渲染质量之间难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出Sparc4D前馈自编码器：静态特征在整段视频中共享，空间锚定的时间槽压缩时变特征；稀疏解码器输出2D Gaussian surfels，同时存储源像素通过几何重投影保留细节纹理。状态包含一帧完整源帧、每间隔四帧采样的动态区域像素，以及学习到的特征与稀疏占用。
AI.result: 在32帧MultiCamVideo片段上，随机窗口平均状态为0.95M个32位等价值，first-32协议下为0.92M。first-32协议下PSNR达21.70 dB，优于MoVieS的20.40 dB；随机窗口下两者PSNR相当。禁用存储纹理后，时间槽将时变特征状态中位数压缩4.0倍，平均状态从1.04M降至0.42M，目标视角重建质量基本不变。无需真实数据微调即可迁移到DyCheck和Neu3D，其中存储纹理提升LPIPS但略降PSNR。
AI.conclusion: Sparc4D以稀疏4D状态实现了紧凑表示与高质量新视角渲染的平衡，时间槽可有效压缩动态特征，存储纹理有助于提升感知质量并具备跨数据集迁移能力。

title: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
comment: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
summary: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

AI.tldr: DeFA：依赖引导的LLM智能体失败归因框架，通过事件依赖图与失败传播图定位决定性错误，在Who&When等基准上取得最优准确率，并可驱动技能进化。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体执行中，错误与其可见后果之间常间隔许多步骤，因此决定性错误定位需同时理解步骤内容与步骤间依赖关系；现有方法对此支持不足。
AI.method: DeFA首先将协议关系与语义依赖融合为覆盖整条轨迹的事件依赖图；其次识别可能违反任务要求的事件，并追溯其来源与后续影响以构建失败传播图；最后结合步骤证据及其在失败传播中的角色，判定决定性错误、责任智能体与错误类别。为支持长轨迹，方法将执行切分为若干片段，用当前片段细节加其他片段摘要的方式，使局部诊断获得全局执行上下文。
AI.result: 在Who and When及Who and When Pro文本子集上，DeFA在所有评测骨干模型下取得最高的责任智能体准确率与精确步骤准确率，并在Pro上取得分类法对齐方法中最高的失败模式准确率；图像与视频轨迹实验验证了其多模态失败归因适用性；消融实验支持分段、事件依赖图与失败传播图的贡献。
AI.conclusion: DeFA的诊断反馈用于Trace2Skill中的技能进化时，可较原生流水线将下游任务准确率提升6–15个百分点，表明其诊断结果还能支撑智能体在后续任务上的改进。

title: AURAL: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Joint Chunk for Speech Language Models
summary: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem.
