Across adversarial attacks and evaluated strengths, GRACE improves TP-FP AUROC by 22% relative to the strongest comparator in some cases while maintaining in-distribution detection performance.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级事后证据元模型GRACE，在冻结检测器前提下估计定位不确定性，无需重训练或改架构。
AI.motivation: 目标检测器在分布偏移与对抗攻击下需要可靠的不确定性估计，但现有方法常需重训练、改架构或重复推理，代价高且可能不可行。
AI.method: 冻结基检测器的轻量级事后证据元模型：自动识别定位相关特征，用显著性引导的修改构造递进式课程；以定位误差、修改程度与预测不稳定性组成的检测级目标训练元模型，为每个预测框估计不确定性，且不改变检测器及原始定位输出。
AI.result: 在多种对抗攻击及强度下，GRACE 相比最强对比方法将 TP-FP AUROC 最多提升约22%，同时保持分布内检测性能。
AI.conclusion: GRACE 以事后、轻量方式实现有效定位不确定性估计，兼顾鲁棒性与原分布性能，具备实际部署价值。

title: Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following
summary: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出 Gacha Decoding：一种推理时方法，将多样性视为指令遵循问题，借助外部 RNG 与模型指令遵循能力识别并实现响应空间的不同模式，随模型能力提升而持续提升生成多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成多样性方法多依赖 LM 的 token 熵，存在多样性-模型能力的张力：模型越强、token 熵越低，多样性反而下降。作者希望打破这一矛盾，让多样性随模型能力同步提升。
AI.method: 将多样性建模为指令遵循问题（"planning with dice"）：不依赖 token 熵，而是结合 LM 的指令遵循能力与外部 RNG 工具提供的随机性，从而可扩展地识别并实现响应空间中的不同模式。该方法为推理时方法，无需训练。
AI.result: 在开放域任务（真实聊天、创意写作、图像生成规划、蛋白质设计）中，同等质量下显著优于现有方法，Vendi 分数最高达次优方法的 2.4 倍；以超过一个数量级更少的样本（11.0x）达到相同数量的高质量模式，并发现其他方法无法呈现的新模式。随 LM 指令遵循能力增强，多样性持续改善，而 token 熵与先前方法的多样性则下降。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循（而非仅 token 熵）可以驱动生成多样性；Gacha Decoding 逆转了长期存在的多样性与模型能力之间的张力，表明多样性可随模型能力扩展。

title: Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mem++，一种非破坏性记忆框架，将记忆管理从"写入时蒸馏"转为"读取时选择"，在组织类长时程问答基准上显著超越现有记忆系统。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在组织中跨月记录决策，修订版常以新文档而非编辑形式出现，回答问题时需知道某一时点生效的版本。而多数记忆系统在写入时压缩记录（蒸馏为事实、笔记或图边），提前固化了可回答的内容，无法适配任意时间点提问。
AI.method: Mem++ 完整存储每篇文档及其日期与作者，写入时不调用任何生成模型；读取时仅检索日期不晚于问题所问时间点的文档，并融合词法与语义排序，保留旧版本由回答模型自行取舍。
AI.result: 在组织类基准 OrgMemBench 上，Mem++ 比最强记忆系统基线高 8.0–13.1 分（两个回答模型）；使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时取得最佳总分，比 RAG 高 2.6 分。在 LoCoMo 上取得最佳 LLM 评委平均分，在 LongMemEval-S 上排名第二，仅次于其实体图变体。
AI.conclusion: 非破坏性的读取时选择范式在时点敏感的长期记忆问答中优于写入时蒸馏方案，验证了保留完整版本记录的价值。

title: MWOP: Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning for Efficient MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial inference costs when processing long visual-textual sequences. While existing operation compression methods exploit modality-level redundancy, they largely treat computation within attention heads and shared feed-forward network (FFN) channels as unified units, leaving finer-grained redundancy underexplored. We find that redundancy varies both across modality-interaction paths within the same attention head and across visual and textual executions of the same FFN channel. Based on these findings, we propose Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning (MWOP), which independently prunes visual-to-visual (V2V), text-to-visual (T2V), and text-to-text (T2T) attention paths within each layer, and separately selects FFN channels for visual and textual inputs. A first-order Taylor criterion guides the pruning process, with FFN importance re-evaluated after attention pruning and LoRA-based recovery training. To translate the resulting fine-grained sparsity into practical acceleration, we further develop path-sparse Triton attention kernels and compact visual-side FFN execution. MWOP preserves the token sequence while reducing attention and FFN computation, making it complementary to token compression and enabling simultaneous reduction of sequence length and per-token computation. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, MWOP alone achieves a $1.6\times$ prefill speedup with 99.7\% average performance retention across 12 benchmarks. Combined with two representative token compression methods, it further increases their prefill speedups from $2.0\times$ and $1.9\times$ to $2.9\times$ and $2.7\times$, respectively. Results on Qwen2.5-VL-7B further demonstrate its applicability across architectures. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/MWOP.

AI.tldr: 提出模态感知宽度级操作剪枝（MWOP），在同一注意力头内区分V2V/T2V/T2T路径、在FFN中区分视觉/文本通道，实现细粒度稀疏并配套Triton核加速，与token压缩互补。
AI.motivation: MLLM处理长视觉-文本序列时推理成本高。现有操作压缩方法利用模态级冗余，但把注意力头内计算与共享FFN通道当作统一单元，未挖掘更细粒度冗余。作者发现冗余在注意力头内不同模态交互路径间、以及同一FFN通道的视觉/文本执行间均有差异。
AI.method: MWOP：逐层独立剪枝V2V、T2V、T2T注意力路径，并为视觉与文本输入分别选择FFN通道。以一阶Taylor准则指导剪枝，注意力剪枝后重估FFN重要性，并进行LoRA恢复训练。为将细粒度稀疏转化为实际加速，开发路径稀疏Triton注意力核与紧凑的视觉侧FFN执行。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上，MWOP单独实现1.6× prefill加速，12个基准平均性能保持99.7%；与两种代表性token压缩方法结合，将其prefill加速从2.0×和1.9×提升至2.9×和2.7×。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上验证了跨架构适用性。
AI.conclusion: MWOP保留token序列、减少注意力与FFN计算，与token压缩互补，可同时降低序列长度与单token计算量，是一种有效的MLLM细粒度推理加速方案。

title: PRISM: A Category-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Refining Multimodal Analogies
summary: Analogical reasoning involves identifying and preserving relational structures across domains. However, existing approaches to AI-driven multimodal analogy generation lack an interpretable measure of whether this structure is understood and maintained in the generated output. We address this gap with Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping (PRISM), a modality-agnostic framework for measuring and improving relational alignment in multimodal analogies, evaluated on visual metaphor generation. PRISM represents analogies as explicit relational mappings grounded in category theory and uses VLMs to instantiate these structures across modalities. Its first component, the pullback score, quantifies relational alignment from the resulting graph representation. On the AnaloBench benchmark, selecting the correct analogy purely by pullback score achieves 82.5% accuracy, demonstrating that the score captures meaningful relational information. PRISM's second component is an iterative refinement loop that uses the pullback score as an in-context feedback signal to iteratively revise the generated image towards greater relational depth. VLM-as-a-judge and human evaluations show that PRISM consistently improves metaphor consistency and analogy appropriateness over zero- shot generation, with human participants preferring the refined output in 57.65% of pairwise comparisons. However, a qualitative analysis reveals that refinement can favour visually crowded compositions rather than genuinely deeper relational correspondences.

AI.tldr: PRISM：一个基于范畴论的模态无关框架，用可解释的"拉回分数"衡量并迭代改进多模态类比（视觉隐喻）中的关系结构对齐，取得82.5%类比选择准确率并提升人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态类比生成缺乏可解释的度量来判断生成结果是否真正理解并保持了跨域的关系结构；本文旨在填补这一评估与改进手段的空白。
AI.method: 将类比表示为基于范畴论的显式关系映射，用视觉语言模型（VLM）跨模态实例化结构。包含两部分：（1）拉回分数（pullback score），从图表示中量化关系对齐程度；（2）迭代精炼循环，将拉回分数作为上下文反馈信号，迭代修订生成图像以增强关系深度。
AI.result: 在AnaloBench上，仅凭拉回分数选择正确类比达82.5%准确率；VLM-as-a-judge与人类评估显示PRISM在隐喻一致性和类比适切性上优于零样本生成，人类在57.65%的成对比较中偏好精炼结果。定性分析发现精炼有时偏向视觉上更拥挤的构图，而非真正更深层的关系对应。
AI.conclusion: PRISM提供了可解释的关系对齐度量与改进机制，验证了拉回分数确实捕获有意义的关系信息，但其精炼过程存在"视觉拥挤"偏差，需进一步区分表观复杂度与真实关系深度。

title: Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization
summary: The rapid growth of video-based social media has increased users' exposure to harmful content, creating a need for reliable automated video safety detection. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do not support controllable precision-recall trade-offs, though the desired operating point may vary across moderation pipelines and unsafe categories. To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO), a reinforcement learning framework for Multi-label Video Safety Detection (Multi-VSD). ATPO introduces the Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR), which dynamically adjusts false-positive and false-negative penalties during training to enable controllable precision-recall trade-offs. Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一个面向多标签视频安全检测（Multi-VSD）的强化学习框架，通过自适应Tversky奖励（ATR）动态调整假阳性/假阴性惩罚，实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。
AI.motivation: 视频社交媒体的快速增长使用户暴露于有害内容的风险上升，需要可靠的自动化视频安全检测。现有视觉语言模型（VLM）虽具备强视频理解能力，但其有害视频检测系统存在两大局限：一是将安全检测简化为二分类，忽视了不安全视频固有的多标签特性；二是依赖静态训练目标，无法支持可控的精确率-召回率权衡，而不同审核流程与不安全类别所需的操作点各不相同。
AI.method: 提出ATPO——面向多标签视频安全检测的强化学习框架。其核心是自适应Tversky奖励（ATR），在训练过程中动态调整假阳性与假阴性惩罚，从而实现对精确率-召回率权衡的可控调节。
AI.result: 在SafeWatch-Bench和XD-Violence上，ATPO显著提升多标签性能，在SafeWatch-Bench-Real上将Jaccard Index从40.66提升至75.44。此外，ATR能够可靠地引导精确率-召回率的操作点，支持具有异构策略需求的部署场景。
AI.conclusion: ATPO通过强化学习与自适应奖励机制有效解决了多标签视频安全检测中的多标签建模与可控权衡两大问题，具备良好的部署适应性。代码与检查点已开源。

title: The Impact of Processing Parameters on High-Accuracy Measurements in UAV Photogrammetry
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry is increasingly used in applications requiring high accuracy, such as determining ground surface changes caused by landslides, mining, or microrelief transformation. While acquisition strategies have been widely studied, the influence of the processing workflow-particularly Bundle Block Adjustment parameter settings-remains insufficiently explored. This study addresses this gap through a systematic, full-factorial evaluation of 768 processing variants applied to ten UAV datasets collected over 1.5 years in a 220 ha study area. Eight key parameters were analysed. The results show substantial variability in final 3D accuracy: the best performing variant achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 16 mm, whereas the weakest reached 303 mm. The most influential factors were the number of ground control points, the application of additional camera calibration corrections, and the use of the Post-Processing Kinematic GNSS method for determining camera projection center coordinates. The study also evaluates how workflow optimization affects the accuracy of displacement, tilt changes, and horizontal strain determination. While random displacement errors remained stable (RMSE of ~6-7 mm), systematic errors were significantly reduced by over half in all axes, with vertical median absolute error decreasing from 14 mm to 7 mm in the optimized configuration compared to the baseline previously used by the authors. This study provides the first large-scale, practice-oriented assessment of how processing parameter selection shapes the accuracy of both photogrammetric products and deformation indices determination. The results offer actionable guidance for developing more robust and repeatable UAV photogrammetry workflows tailored to high-precision monitoring.

AI.tldr: 通过对768种处理变体、10个无人机数据集的全因子评估，本文揭示光束法平差参数设置对无人机摄影测量3D精度与形变指标精度的显著影响，最优RMSE为16 mm，最差达303 mm。
AI.motivation: 无人机摄影测量已广泛用于滑坡、采矿、微地形变化等高精度地表监测场景。既有研究多聚焦采集策略，而处理流程（尤其是光束法平差参数设置）对精度的影响尚缺乏系统性考察，实践中参数选择缺乏可操作依据。
AI.method: 在220 ha研究区、历时1.5年采集的10个无人机数据集上，开展系统性全因子实验，构建并评估768种处理变体，分析8个关键参数；随后进一步评估工作流优化对位移、倾斜变化与水平应变确定精度的影响。
AI.result: 最终3D精度差异显著：最优变体RMSE为16 mm，最弱达303 mm。影响最大的因素为地面控制点数量、附加相机检校改正、以及采用后处理动态GNSS（PPK）确定相机投影中心坐标。优化配置下随机位移误差保持稳定（RMSE约6–7 mm），而系统误差在三个轴向均降低一半以上，垂直方向中位绝对误差由基线的14 mm降至7 mm。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次开展大规模、面向实践的处理参数选择评估，证明光束法平差参数设置同时决定摄影测量产品与形变指标精度，可为构建稳健、可重复的高精度无人机摄影测量工作流提供可操作指导。

title: AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs
comment: The demo paper with 1 page main paper, 7 pages supplementary material accepted and presented in ECCV 2026
summary: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

AI.tldr: AiSearch：基于VLM零样本能力的可交互多模态检索框架，支持图像/视频自然语言搜索、用户反馈迭代细化与多模型可视化基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现代检索系统需兼顾自动化与交互性，支持用户实时搜索并迭代优化结果；现有方案在多模态（图像/视频）自然语言检索、结果按用户意图细化，以及多模型选择与对比方面仍不充分。
AI.method: 提出AiSearch框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的零样本能力实现图像与视频的自然语言检索；通过用户反馈进行交互式检索细化；并提供跨多个VLM的可视化基准测试以辅助模型选择。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验数据，仅说明框架支持三类功能：自然语言多模态检索、基于用户反馈的交互式结果细化、跨VLM的可视化基准评测。
AI.conclusion: AiSearch提供了一种灵活、可交互的多模态检索方案，借助VLM零样本能力兼顾自动化与实时细化，并通过可视化基准帮助用户按任务挑选最合适的模型。

title: Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation
summary:
Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究LLM新颖性评判器的设计选择，发现提示设计等微小差异会使成对准确率变化超过50个点，甚至低于随机水平，且专门构建的评判器反而不如最廉价的提示基线。
AI.motivation: 自动创意生成系统常以LLM作为新颖性评判器，但这些评判器多为临时搭建，且若经验证也多在人类论文上而非其实际要评分的生成创意上验证，因此其真实性能不明。
AI.method: 构建受控评测集：从OpenReview挖掘审稿人明确肯定或否定论文原创性的段落，仅保留在其研究领域极端评价上意见一致的投稿，并与普通LLM生成器产生的创意配对；随后系统操纵评判器的提示设计、检索与推理预算等选择，在六个评判器上做对比实验。
AI.result: 提示设计的微小改动影响巨大，例如告知评判器审稿人认为某一创意新颖、另一不新颖，会改变其对一半以上相同创意对的裁定，使成对准确率变动超过50个点，偶尔低于随机水平；同一改动对一个评判器有益而对另一个有害；检索与更大推理预算帮助有限；两个专门构建的新颖性评估器表现不及最廉价的提示基线。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果对自动创意生成系统所报告的新颖性提升提出质疑，并呼吁建立稳健的新颖性评估方法。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Handshake: Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Refinement for Surgical-Grade Glioma Segmentation
summary: While state-of-the-art automated models for medical image segmentation achieve high mean performance, they frequently suffer from localized, catastrophic failures that preclude safe clinical deployment, particularly in neuro-oncology. Interactive segmentation frameworks mitigate this by incorporating human oversight, but traditionally impose prohibitive cognitive and temporal workloads by requiring clinicians to manually search for errors. In this project, we present an efficient, Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop framework for glioma segmentation that bridges the gap between automated baseline performance and surgical-grade precision, achieving sub-2.0 mm HD95 on curated benchmarks while providing safety-net routing for structural failures across real-world clinical data. By extracting voxel-wise Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) uncertainty and applying hierarchical topological filtering, our method proactively isolates high-risk structural anomalies. We comprehensively evaluated our approach on a challenging out-of-distribution clinical stress-test cohort (N = 362). Operating under a simulated Human Oracle, the framework improved the Whole Tumor (WT) Dice score from 0.891 to 0.914 and reduced the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) from 5.82 mm to 4.76 mm. Critically for surgical safety, the system rescued severe boundary failures in the Tumor Core, reducing mean HD95 from 17.96 mm to 14.83 mm (improving absolute TC Dice to 0.356). These spatial rescues were achieved while demanding a median interactive workload of just 11.3% of the target volume. Acknowledging this as a simulated upper bound lacking real-world cognitive friction, the framework nevertheless demonstrates a highly Pareto-efficient pathway for safely deploying clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合结构与偶然不确定性的混合人机回环框架，用于胶质瘤分割，在提供安全兜底路由的同时实现高精度与低交互负担。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割模型虽平均性能高，但存在局部灾难性失败，难以安全临床部署；传统交互式分割需医生手动寻找错误，带来难以承受的认知与时间成本。因此需要一种能主动定位高风险错误、降低人工搜索负担的人机回环方案，以在神经肿瘤学中兼顾自动化基线与手术级精度。
AI.method: 框架提取体素级测试时增强（TTA）不确定性，并施加分层拓扑过滤，主动隔离高风险结构异常；在此基础上构建混合结构-偶然不确定性的人机回环（Human-in-the-Loop）机制，实现对结构性失败的安全兜底路由。在挑战性的分布外临床压力测试队列（N=362）上，以模拟人类专家（Human Oracle）方式进行综合评估。
AI.result: 在模拟 Human Oracle 下，全肿瘤（WT）Dice 由 0.891 提升至 0.914，HD95 由 5.82 mm 降至 4.76 mm；在肿瘤核心（TC）上挽救严重边界失败，平均 HD95 由 17.96 mm 降至 14.83 mm，绝对 TC Dice 提升至 0.356。同时交互工作量的中位数仅为目标体积的 11.3%。在精心整理的基准上实现了低于 2.0 mm 的 HD95。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了高效、帕累托最优的临床 AI 安全部署路径：以较低交互代价显著提升分割精度与鲁棒性，并为结构性失败提供安全网。但需承认结果为模拟上界，未包含真实世界中的认知摩擦，仍待进一步实际验证。

title: Contrastive Attention Mitigates Spectral Bias in Spiking Transformers
summary: Spiking Transformers merge the energy-efficiency of spiking neural networks (SNNs) with the representational power of self-attention, creating a promising architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation. However, a performance gap persists versus its counterparts in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Unlike prior works attributing this to binary activations, we reveal that both spiking neurons and spiking self-attention (SSA) act as low-pass filters through multiscale spectral analysis. This characteristic leads to the dissipation of high-frequency components. To address this issue, we propose the Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) paradigm, which draw inspiration from the edge-detection and differential sensing properties of biological visual system. By extracting contrast prototypes via global contrastive aggregation and applying local differential refinement, SCA effectively enhances high-frequency information. Extensive experiments show that SCA is a general module that consistently boosts Spiking Transformers across image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking. Furthermore, it achieves lower complexity, offering superior efficiency over original SSA. These results establish its potential as a fundamental building block for energy-efficient Spiking Transformers.

AI.tldr: 脉冲Transformer相较ANN存在性能差距，本文通过多尺度频谱分析发现脉冲神经元与脉冲自注意力本质上是低通滤波器导致高频信息耗散，为此提出受生物视觉启发的脉冲对比注意力（SCA），通过全局对比聚合与局部差分细化增强高频信息，在多个任务上一致提升性能并降低复杂度。
AI.motivation: 脉冲Transformer结合了SNN的能效与自注意力的表征能力，但与ANN counterpart之间仍存在性能差距。以往工作多将其归因于二值激活，本文则试图重新揭示这一差距的根本原因，以填补性能鸿沟。
AI.method: 通过多尺度频谱分析，揭示脉冲神经元与脉冲自注意力（SSA）均表现为低通滤波器，导致高频分量耗散。为此提出脉冲对比注意力（SCA）范式，受生物视觉系统的边缘检测与差分感知特性启发：通过全局对比聚合提取对比原型，并施加局部差分细化，以有效增强高频信息。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SCA是通用模块，在图像分类、语义分割和事件驱动跟踪任务上一致提升脉冲Transformer性能；同时其复杂度更低，效率优于原始SSA。
AI.conclusion: SCA可作为高能效脉冲Transformer的基础构建模块，具备成为通用组件的潜力。

title: Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages
summary: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文从数据与模型两个维度扩展了语言模型学习偏置与类型学共性关系的分析，聚焦交叉序列依存与栈式语言模型，发现栈式模型难以习得交叉序列依存，但有限工作记忆的栈式模型泛化更好，为相关词序配置的类型学共性提供可能的归纳偏置基础。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中某些属性（如SOV词序）在数千种已证语言中更为普遍，这种类型学共性常被归因于学习偏置。已有计算模拟（近期借助语言模型）推动了该理论的探索，但分析仍需在数据与模型两侧扩展：一方面需关注交叉序列依存这一已证句法复杂度的上限，另一方面需考察可能促进层级模式学习的栈式语言模型。
AI.method: 在数据侧引入交叉序列依存作为分析对象，在模型侧引入栈式语言模型（SLMs）。首先在多种人工语言上评估SLMs对交叉序列依存的泛化能力，随后通过限制工作记忆的SLMs考察其泛化表现。
AI.result: 栈式语言模型在多样化人工语言的交叉序列依存上表现挣扎，难以泛化此类结构；但工作记忆受限的栈式语言模型反而泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 有限工作记忆可能构成一种归纳偏置基础，从而解释某些词序配置的类型学共性，为学习偏置驱动类型学共性的理论提供了新证据。

title: FiVOS: A Fish Segmentation Algorithm Based on Interactive Video Object Segmentation and Filter Enhancement
summary: With the continuous expansion of aquaculture, precise and efficient monitoring of fish behavior has become increasingly critical for improving farming efficiency and reducing economic losses. In particular, with the ongoing enhancement of computational capabilities in deep learning models, vision-based fish segmentation methods are garnering growing attention. By analyzing video segmentation results, fish behavior can be effectively tracked, thereby providing reliable data support for the precise regulation of aquaculture environments. However, existing deep learning-based video segmentation methods for aquaculture scenarios often overlook the dynamic correlations between video frames. In contrast, Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS) employs an interaction-propagation scheme to achieve high-precision segmentation while minimizing user effort, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency. Yet, IVOS applications in aquaculture remain limited due to data scarcity, and are susceptible to error accumulation and mask loss over long sequence propagation due to high intra-class similarity. In response, this paper proposes an improved interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and constructs two fish-specific datasets. FiVOS utilizes a mask block filter to enable early detection and correction of erroneous propagated mask blocks, enhancing filtering accuracy through a rule-based thresholding approach. Additionally, it serializes noise filters to further eliminate erroneous mask noise, thereby improving model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that FiVOS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in fish video segmentation tasks, providing robust technical support for fish behavior research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进的交互式视频目标分割方法FiVOS并构建两个鱼类专用数据集，通过掩码块过滤与噪声过滤串联机制解决长序列传播中的误差累积与掩码丢失问题，在鱼类视频分割任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 水产养殖规模持续扩大，鱼类行为的精准高效监测对提升养殖效率、降低经济损失至关重要。基于视觉的分割方法受到关注，但现有面向养殖场景的深度学习视频分割方法往往忽视视频帧间的动态关联；而交互式视频目标分割（IVOS）虽能以少量交互实现高精度分割，却因数据稀缺在水产领域应用有限，且受类内高相似性影响，长序列传播中易出现误差累积与掩码丢失。
AI.method: 提出改进的交互式视频目标分割方法FiVOS，并构建两个鱼类专用数据集。FiVOS引入掩码块过滤器，实现错误传播掩码块的早期检测与纠正，并通过基于规则的阈值化提升过滤精度；同时将噪声过滤器串联化，进一步消除错误掩码噪声，增强模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FiVOS在鱼类视频分割任务上达到最先进（SOTA）性能，为鱼类行为研究提供了可靠的技术支撑。
AI.conclusion: FiVOS通过掩码块过滤与噪声过滤串联机制有效缓解长序列传播中的误差累积和掩码丢失，配合所构建的鱼类数据集，在鱼类视频分割上取得领先效果，可为水产养殖环境精准调控与鱼类行为研究提供数据与技术支撑。

title: Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now undertake increasingly complex tasks, but the way they organize interaction history into memory does not ensure a coherent understanding of the current world. We introduce PoS, an inference-time framework that constructs and continually maintains explicit belief states as the agent's decision context. Each belief combines an estimate of the current world state with unresolved task requirements, making explicit what the agent still needs to learn and accomplish. To keep this belief reliable and actionable, PoS validates its consistency and monitors task progress to detect Belief Trapping, where the agent continues to act without making meaningful progress toward the goal. Recovery is then tailored to both the trapping pattern and the type of unresolved task requirement. Experiments on four benchmarks spanning execution and diagnosis show that PoS achieves the highest overall performance on every benchmark with all three LLM backbones. Ablations demonstrate the importance of consistency validation and recovery, while context-scaling experiments show resilience to context growth. Together, these results support belief construction and continual maintenance as a foundation for long-horizon context management beyond history retention and compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoS，一种推理时框架，通过构建并持续维护显式的信念状态（结合世界状态估计与未完成任务需求）作为LLM智能体的决策上下文，并借助一致性验证与任务进展监控检测"信念陷阱"，从而在长时程任务中超越单纯的历史保留与压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体虽能处理日益复杂的任务，但其将交互历史组织为记忆的方式无法保证对当前世界形成连贯理解，导致长时程上下文管理存在局限。
AI.method: PoS在推理阶段构建并持续维护显式的信念状态作为决策上下文：每个信念由当前世界状态估计与未解决的任务需求组成；通过对信念进行一致性验证、并监控任务进展来检测"信念陷阱"（Belief Trapping，即智能体持续行动但无实质进展）；随后依据陷阱模式与未解决任务需求的类型进行定制化恢复。
AI.result: 在涵盖执行与诊断的四项基准上，PoS在三种LLM骨干下均取得最高的整体性能；消融实验表明一致性验证与恢复机制的重要性；上下文扩展实验显示其对上下文增长具有韧性。
AI.conclusion: 信念构建与持续维护可作为长时程上下文管理的基础，超越历史保留与压缩的范式。

title: LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them
summary: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM2Jev框架，从LLM下一词概率中直接提取校准的类别决策分布，发现现代LLM无需微调即具备决策能力，微调仅对弱模型和特定任务有针对性收益。
AI.motivation: Jev-style决策模型能直接输出可被软件系统使用的类别概率分布，但需要专门构建。本文探究通用LLM是否开箱即具备该能力，以及何时真正需要微调。
AI.method: LLM2Jev为架构保持型框架，从括号数字标识符的下一词概率中提取校准决策。提供免训练推理方案，以及微调目标：用树因子化listwise损失优化候选选择，并用KL散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定到基座模型。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B与Qwen3-0.6B上评测：免训练时4B模型达到同骨干社区Jev模型水平，优于letter-logit读出，支持任意选项数并原生处理图像多模态决策。微调收益具有针对性：显著提升弱模型及多选项意图路由等任务，对强骨干收益递减。KL锚可防止对话文本生成的行为退化，LoRA在强模型上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 现代LLM本身即为有效决策模型，微调属针对性增强而非普遍必需；KL锚定保障生成能力不被破坏。

title: SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models
summary: Recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that single models can obtain informative training signals by evaluating their behavior in demonstrationor feedback-augmented contexts, with the help of a teacher network, which is driven by the student's learned parameters. Inspired by this internal-reference principle, we investigate how diffusion models can identify self-referenced training signals without external demonstrations or teacher networks. We introduce SALD, a self-referenced training framework that evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels using the same model. The easier, lower-noise path is evaluated without gradient tracking to provide a reference, while the harder, higher-noise path provides the training gradient. Rather than directly distilling the easy-path prediction, SALD uses the difference between two path errors to adapt the hardpath objective. The proposed Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts this relative error into a differentiable sample-level weight. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) accumulates relative difficulty across training and adapts the future gap between the two noise levels. Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) further compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight. All components share a single set of model parameters, requiring neither an external teacher network nor additional trainable parameters during training or inference, and no modification to the inference procedure. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the contributions of the proposed components.

AI.tldr: 提出SALD自参考训练框架，通过同一扩散模型在两个噪声水平上的路径误差差构建样本级与频率级权重，无需外部教师网络或额外可训练参数即可提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 语言模型自适应研究表明，模型可通过在示例或反馈增强的上下文中评估自身行为获取有效训练信号，但通常依赖教师网络。本文探索扩散模型能否在没有外部示例或教师网络的情况下，利用内部参考原理识别自参考训练信号。
AI.method: SALD在同一模型的两个噪声水平上评估每个图文对：低噪声易路径不跟踪梯度以提供参考，高噪声难路径提供训练梯度。方法不直接蒸馏易路径预测，而是利用两路径误差之差调整难路径目标。具体包括三个组件：AGD（Advantage-Guided Diffusion）将相对误差转化为可微的样本级权重；TAM（Temporal Advantage Memory）累积训练中的相对难度并自适应调整两个噪声水平间的未来间隔；SAD（Spectral Advantage Decomposition）比较两路径残差功率谱，构建可微的频率派生潜在元素权重。所有组件共享同一套模型参数，训练与推理均不需外部教师网络或额外可训练参数，也不修改推理流程。
AI.result: 在多种架构和数据集上的实验显示生成质量获得一致性提升，组件消融实验量化了各提出组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型可借助内部参考原理实现自参考训练，在无外部教师网络、无额外可训练参数、不改变推理流程的前提下有效提升生成质量，为扩散模型自监督训练信号设计提供了新思路。

title: SpikeMoE: Brain-Inspired Competitive Routing for Flexible Spiking Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable event-driven computation through biologically inspired dynamics at the neuronal scale, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) perform conditional computation through expert selection at the model scale. Integrating their strengths offers potential for flexible neural architectures. A key challenge, however, lies in designing an expert selection mechanism based on spiking activity. To address this, we introduce a spike-based k-WTA Router inspired by competition-inhibition observed in the hippocampal CA1 region. The router incorporates lateral inhibition and refractory period to select Top-K experts according to discrete spike counts. Building on this, we present SpikeMoE, a framework that integrates neuronal-scale spiking dynamics with model-scale expert selection. To address incomplete multisensory inputs in multimodal tasks, we further equip SpikeMoE with a two-stage missing-modality modeling module that combines empirical prototypes from an observed-modality pool with modality-specific learnable embeddings to construct missing-modality representations. Experiments on vision, language, and multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that SpikeMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance among the SNN baselines, matches or exceeds the performance of ANN counterparts, and maintains robustness across diverse missing-modality conditions. These results demonstrate a favorable trade-off between performance and energy efficiency, validating the integration of spiking dynamics with sparse expert computation and highlighting SpikeMoE as a promising approach to energy-efficient brain-inspired computing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SpikeMoE框架，将脉冲神经网络（SNN）的神经元级事件驱动动态与混合专家（MoE）的模型级条件计算相结合，核心是受海马CA1区竞争-抑制机制启发的脉冲k-WTA路由器，并针对多模态缺失问题设计了两阶段缺失模态建模模块，在视觉、语言和多模态任务上取得SNN基线中的最优性能。
AI.motivation: SNN可在神经元尺度实现事件驱动计算，MoE可在模型尺度实现条件计算，二者结合有望构建灵活高效的神经架构。但关键挑战在于如何基于脉冲活动设计专家选择机制，且多模态任务中常存在模态不完整的问题。
AI.method: 提出受海马CA1区竞争-抑制启发的spike-based k-WTA路由器，通过侧抑制与不应期机制，依据离散脉冲计数选择Top-K专家；在此基础上构建SpikeMoE框架，融合神经元级脉冲动态与模型级专家选择；并为其配备两阶段缺失模态建模模块，结合观测模态池的经验原型与模态特定可学习嵌入来构造缺失模态表示。
AI.result: 在视觉、语言和多模态基准上的实验表明，SpikeMoE在SNN基线中达到state-of-the-art性能，匹配或超越ANN对应方法，并在多种缺失模态条件下保持鲁棒性，实现了性能与能效之间的良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了将脉冲动态与稀疏专家计算相结合的有效性，表明SpikeMoE是面向高能效类脑计算的一种有前景的方法。

title: Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)
summary: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TESS，一个基于逐点价值匹配（PVM）目标的可扩展数据选择框架，解决元学习数据选择中细粒度估值与可迁移性之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 在大规模异构语料上训练大语言模型时，数据选择至关重要。元学习式数据选择（MTS）提供了优于启发式评分的原则性方案，可从目标验证目标中学习数据权重。但现有方法在细粒度估值与对未见数据的可迁移性之间存在权衡。用选择网络替代逐样本权重是自然的解法，但将此类网络直接嵌入现有MTS目标会导致权重抑制和对易学特征的持续依赖，造成优化不稳定与泛化差。
AI.method: 提出TESS（可迁移样本评分与选择），一个可扩展的数据选择框架，构建在逐点价值匹配目标（Pointwise Value Matching, PVM）之上，以替代直接嵌入选择网络的MTS目标。
AI.result: 在LLM安全性和定向指令微调任务上的实验表明，TESS具有强迁移能力：可从子集迁移到完整语料、从较小模型迁移到较大模型，并跨数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标缓解了权重抑制与易学特征依赖问题，实现了细粒度且可迁移的数据选择，并在多个LLM训练场景中验证了其可扩展性与泛化能力。

title: VTR-Bench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Video Generation
summary: Recent video generation models can produce highly realistic videos from natural language instructions, with visual quality approaching cinematic standards. Existing evaluation benchmarks, however, predominantly assess visual quality, aesthetic appeal and physical plausibility, while paying limited attention to text, an essential medium for conveying information in everyday scenes. A generated video may appear visually compelling and feature lifelike subjects, yet still render the text within the scene incorrectly. To address this overlooked dimension, we introduce \textbf{VTR-Bench}, a systematic benchmark for evaluating the \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}ext \textbf{R}endering capabilities of video generation models. VTR-Bench situates text within concrete application scenarios, such as advertisements and scientific videos, with 300 carefully constructed prompts spanning five scenario categories. We develop an automated evaluation pipeline with human alignments that separately assesses text fidelity through carrier-specific transcription and scene and motion requirements through a prompt-specific chain of query. Beyond evaluation, we introduce a \textbf{Keyframe-Guided Agentic Framework} in which a Director agent coordinates image and video generation with visual evaluation, guiding iterative refinement and candidate selection through visual feedback. Experiments on 11 state-of-the-art models reveal widespread difficulties in accurately rendering scene text, with the best-performing model recording an overall word error rate (WER) of 0.250. We further analyze text rendering failures to characterize the challenges faced by current video generation models. These findings highlight visual text rendering as a key challenge for video generation and demonstrate a practical path toward improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/hardenyu21/VTR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出VTR-Bench基准，系统评估视频生成模型的视觉文本渲染能力，并给出关键帧引导的智能体框架以改进渲染效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评测基准主要关注视觉质量、美学和物理合理性，忽视场景文本渲染这一信息传递的重要维度；生成视频虽视觉逼真，但场景内文字常渲染错误。
AI.method: 构建含300条提示词、覆盖五类应用场景（如广告、科学视频）的VTR-Bench；设计自动化评测流程（含人工对齐），分别通过载体特定转录评估文本保真度、通过提示词特定查询链评估场景与运动需求；并提出关键帧引导智能体框架，由Director智能体协调图像与视频生成及视觉评估，借助视觉反馈迭代优化与候选筛选。
AI.result: 在11个先进模型上测试，普遍难以准确渲染场景文本，最佳模型整体词错误率（WER）仍达0.250；并进一步分析文本渲染失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 视觉文本渲染是视频生成的关键挑战，本工作凸显该问题并提供可行的改进路径。

title: A Deterministic and Auditable AI Security Risk Assessment Framework with ATLAS Aligned Executable Rules and Formal Verification
summary: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in high impact and safety critical settings, yet security assessment remains difficult to reproduce and defend under audit. Existing approaches often rely on narrative checklists or assessor driven scoring, and they lack an explicit, machine evaluable mapping from observable engineering artefacts to stable technique level outcomes. We present an evidence driven AI security assessment framework that operationalises assessment as a deterministic decision function. The framework normalises heterogeneous artefacts into a project independent Control ID taxonomy scored on a bounded four level ordinal scale, compiles technique level predicates from a pinned MITRE ATLAS snapshot via an explicit mitigation to control mapping, and outputs technique indexed feasibility and impact levels with traceable links back to the triggering evidence. We package all normative choices as a versioned assessment policy object to support repeatable reassessment across snapshots. To ensure semantic correctness, we formally verify boundedness, totality, ordered semantic consistency, and monotonicity of the compiled evaluator over the full declared score domain. We evaluate the framework on five public open source AI projects pinned to explicit repository snapshots, quantify before and after changes under a unified hardening intervention, and validate responsiveness to real engineering changes through fork based implementations of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and Continuous integration (CI) security scanning gates. Results show consistent downward shifts in feasibility profiles under strengthened observable controls, while worst case residual feasibility persists when technique specific core controls remain absent from the evidence scope.

AI.tldr: 提出证据驱动的AI安全评估框架，将评估转化为确定性决策函数，输出技术级可行性与影响等级，并在5个开源AI项目上验证其对工程变更的响应性。
AI.motivation: AI系统越来越多部署于高影响与安全关键场景，但安全评估难以复现、难以在审计下自证；现有方法依赖叙述性清单或评估者主观打分，缺乏从可观测工程制品到稳定技术级结论的、机器可评估的显式映射。
AI.method: 框架将异构制品归一化为项目无关的Control ID分类体系（四档有界序数评分），基于固定版本的MITRE ATLAS快照，通过显式的“缓解措施—控制项”映射编译技术级谓词，输出按技术索引的可行性/影响等级及可追溯证据链接；所有规范性选择封装为带版本的assessment policy对象以支持跨快照重复评估。并对编译后评估器在完整评分域上形式化验证有界性、完全性、有序语义一致性与单调性。实验在5个公开开源AI项目（绑定明确仓库快照）上进行，在统一加固干预下量化前后变化，并通过基于fork的SBOM生成与CI安全扫描门禁实现验证响应性。
AI.result: 在可观测控制增强后，可行性剖面一致下移；当技术特定核心控制仍缺失于证据范围时，最坏情形残余可行性持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把AI安全评估操作化为可复现、可审计、机器可评估的确定性流程，支持版本化重复评估，并通过形式化验证与开源项目实证证明了其对真实工程变更的敏感性及残余风险的可见性。

title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows
comment: 41 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Code: https://github.com/TextQLLabs/Argo-Bench. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/textql/Argo-Bench. Website: https://argo-bench.com
summary: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Argo-Bench：一个面向企业级数据科学与分析的可执行评测框架，含 210 项任务、235 张表、75 亿行的 ERP 数据仓库，要求智能体先重构事实再执行决策动作，并按仿真后果评分。
AI.motivation: 真实企业数据科学与分析流程需要跨数十张表进行推理、执行统计分析并据结果采取行动；而现有 text-to-SQL 基准仅评估查询生成，且其答案键常被审计发现错误。同时，真实企业数仓过于敏感无法公开，导致现有基准多基于"单一表即可容纳一个业务事件"的公共数据集，缺乏真实规模与复杂性。
AI.method: 基于公开数据、同行评审的行业文献和监管申报文件，构建模拟纽约市食品配送平台的仿真世界（2024 年 8100 万订单），具备扎实的经济模型、欺诈模式与市场激励结构；将其导出为模仿 Oracle E-Business Suite 架构的 ERP 仓库，含 235 张表、75 亿行。仿真器的真实状态（ground truth）对智能体可见的仓库隐藏，因此任务需先导航仓库重构事实再采取行动。任务形式超越 text-to-SQL：智能体需执行封禁欺诈账号、分配骑手激励预算、发放补发工资等动作，评分器依据其在仿真器中的后果打分。每项任务均配有可执行参考解，证明仅用该仓库即可求解。
AI.result: 在 14 个前沿与开源权重模型中，最强模型仅在 34.8% 的任务上达到 95 分及以上，平均得分 59.5 分。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在企业级真实数据环境中的理解、导航与决策能力仍显著不足；作者期望 Argo-Bench 推动智能体朝"理解、导航并在真实数据环境中行动"的方向发展。

title: FedCKA: Representation-Guided Layer Personalization for Federated 3D Perception Across Driving Domains
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Robust perception in intelligent vehicles demands 3D object detectors that remain dependable under domain shifts, such as changes in time of day, location, or weather. However, due to costly annotation and rare shifts, some environments lack sufficient data to train a standalone detector. Federated learning offers a privacy-preserving framework for collaborative model training, enabling clients to benefit from shared learning across diverse environments. Yet, this framework traditionally relies on a single global consensus model, which struggles to perform across heterogeneous local data distributions. Local conditions are better captured by adapting a subset of the model, but many personalization approaches rely on predefined layer partitions or fixed personalization ratios, thereby limiting adaptation to client-specific divergence. To reduce this rigidity, we propose FedCKA, a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)-based strategy that dynamically handles the personalization-globalization trade-off. Specifically, FedCKA computes layer-wise feature similarities between local client models and the global consensus model during training. By converting layer-wise similarity scores into client-specific aggregation masks, FedCKA selectively shares representation-consistent layers. Evaluation on a unified multi-domain benchmark based on nuScenes shows that FedCKA outperforms established federated baselines, including FedBN, FedRep, and FedSelect, improving average NDS by 7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The findings offer both a comparative benchmark and a promising direction for robust federated 3D perception across shifts in location, weather, and illumination. Code is available at https://github.com/j-verhoog/FedCKA.

AI.tldr: 提出FedCKA：基于中心核对齐（CKA）的联邦学习个性化策略，动态处理个性化-全局化权衡，用于跨域3D目标检测。
AI.motivation: 智能车辆鲁棒感知需要3D检测器在时间、地点、天气等域偏移下保持可靠，但部分环境因标注成本高、偏移稀缺而缺乏足量数据训练独立检测器。联邦学习可隐私保护地协同训练，但传统单一全局共识模型难以应对异构本地数据分布；现有个人化方法依赖预定义层划分或固定个人化比例，限制了对客户特定差异的适应。
AI.method: 提出FedCKA：在训练中计算本地客户端模型与全局共识模型之间的逐层特征相似度（基于中心核对齐CKA）；将逐层相似度分数转换为客户端特定的聚合掩码（aggregation masks），从而选择性地仅共享表示一致的层，实现动态的个人化-全局化权衡。
AI.result: 在基于nuScenes构建的统一多域基准上评估，FedCKA优于既有联邦基线（FedBN、FedRep、FedSelect），相较最强基线平均NDS提升7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了跨地点、天气、光照偏移下鲁棒联邦3D感知的对比基准与可行方向，代码已开源。

title: DRelay: Global Draft Context for Prefix-Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding Repair
summary: Parallel drafting reduces the drafting overhead of speculative decoding for large language models (LLMs), but its gains remain limited by the accepted prefix length. Even when the correct token is present in the candidate pool, a single early selection error prevents subsequent predictions from being used. We propose DRelay, which uses global information from the entire draft block to perform prefix-aware selective repair of candidate selections before target-model verification. DRelay bases its decisions on candidate correlations and the selected path: a global reader extracts predictive information across positions for each candidate. While a causal selector combines candidate-level information extracted by the global read with the tokens selected at preceding positions to determine whether the native choice at the current position is consistent with the global evidence and the selected prefix. It then decides whether to retain or replace the token, thereby repairing early errors and extending the accepted prefix. We further jointly train the draft backbone and the selector, combining candidate-support learning with a repair objective, while weighting the repair loss according to each block position's potential contribution to the consecutive accepted prefix. Across eight diverse benchmarks on an H800 GPU, DRelay consistently improves both average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding performance over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark. Under SGLang serving, DRelay improves average end-to-end speedup over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark by 14.7%-16.8%, 8.7%-9.3%, and 8.1%-9.3%, respectively.

AI.tldr: DRelay通过全局读取器与因果选择器对草稿块候选选择进行前缀感知选择性修复，联合训练草稿骨干与选择器，在八个基准上提升接受长度与端到端解码性能。
AI.motivation: 并行草稿降低了LLM投机解码的草稿开销，但其收益受限于被接受前缀长度：即使正确token已在候选池中，单个早期选择错误也会阻断后续预测被采用。
AI.method: DRelay利用整个草稿块的全局信息，在目标模型验证前进行前缀感知的选择性修复。其决策基于候选相关性以及已选路径：全局读取器为每个候选跨位置提取预测性信息；因果选择器结合全局读取得到的候选级信息与前置位置所选token，判断当前位置的原生选择是否与全局证据和已选前缀一致，并决定保留或替换该token，从而修复早期错误并延长接受前缀。此外联合训练草稿骨干与选择器，将候选支持学习与修复目标结合，并按每个块位置对连续接受前缀的潜在贡献对修复损失加权。
AI.result: 在H800 GPU上的八个多样基准中，DRelay在平均接受长度和端到端解码性能上均持续优于DFlash、Domino和DSpark。在SGLang服务下，DRelay相对DFlash、Domino、DSpark的平均端到端加速分别提升14.7%-16.8%、8.7%-9.3%和8.1%-9.3%。
AI.conclusion: 通过前缀感知的选择性候选修复与面向接受前缀贡献的联合训练，DRelay有效缓解了并行草稿的早期选择错误问题，显著扩展接受前缀并提升投机解码的端到端效率。

title: Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models
summary:
Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

AI.tldr: 关键词匹配式工具调用基准会给实际不会工具调用的小模型虚假高分。本文在一对同架构西班牙语安全模型上记录了该假阳性，并提出一套廉价严格的诊断阶梯，用逐字复现检查、首token探测和定向SFT成功定位并修复了1B模型的失败。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用评测多依赖关键词匹配，可能把从未真正执行工具调用的模型判为合格，产生假阳性；且业界缺少廉价、严格、能区分"真会调用"与"表面像调用"的诊断手段。
AI.method: 对比一对共享解码器、分词器和特殊token的模型：661.6M（约65%代码/技术文本，无专用SFT）与1,109M（网页为主的多阶段课程，含6B token工具SFT）。提出诊断阶梯：逐字复现训练样例、首token概率探测、嵌入漂移检查。随后对1B进行定向SFT修复（多样化语料、5倍学习率、2,202步、约3.3 GPU小时），并做因子分析与负样本过触发评估。
AI.result: 宽松指标下两模型几乎相同（B4：0.660 vs. 0.650）。逐字复现：600M在6/6样例上生成带泛化参数的有效调用，1B在0/6（各检查点均如此）。首token探测将1B失败定位为缺失先验（<|tool_call|>上概率仅10^-4–10^-5），被网页为主训练阶段抹除。修复后：269条语料行上有效发射率由0.100升至0.959（600M为0.926）；238条未见提示上修复1B达0.536，高于600M的0.428（p=0.004）。嵌入漂移检查显示触发token的绑定嵌入未变（97.7% bf16表位级一致），表明改变发生在周边网络。两模型均过触发，负向提示下不调用直接作答率仅0.09（600M）和0.17（修复1B）。因子分析确认所有修复配置都装上了格式，但多样化语料对抑制的收益因种子敏感性仍属假设。
AI.conclusion: 关键词匹配基准会高估小模型的工具调用能力；所提诊断阶梯仅需数分钟CPU时间，可作为小模型工具调用声明的门槛。修复表明缺失的是先验而非能力，且可用极少token通过定向SFT恢复。

title: VoxelSynth3D: Interpretable Volumetric Image-Domain Metal Artifact Reduction with a Paired Synthetic CLINIC-Metal Benchmark
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication at BHI 2026
summary: Metal artifacts in postoperative musculoskeletal CT obscure bone-implant and adjacent soft-tissue interfaces. Many metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods require unavailable raw projections or learned models that may shift across scanners and implants. We present VoxelSynth3D, a training-free 3D image-domain framework for reconstructed CT. The framework combines support masking, normalized tissue synthesis, deviation gating, and restricted edge refinement. Detected implant voxels are preserved in the output, while correction targets metal-induced artifacts in the surrounding tissue. We also construct Synthetic CLINIC-Metal, a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource, from no-metal CTPelvic1K volumes with clean targets, metal/artifact masks, fixed seeds, and patient-level splits; 75 unpaired real metal cases receive qualitative/no-reference evaluation only. The operating point was fixed in a near-flat validation basin. With exact-mask oracle localization, all methods share a metal-excluded tissue ROI. On 40 held-out cases, VoxelSynth3D reduced RMSE from 801.48 to 786.18 HU (paired gain 15.30 HU, 95% CI 11.68-19.23), improving every case and exceeding the evaluated 3D Gaussian smoother by 13.58 HU. Clean-edge agreement decreased next to metal but exceeded input beyond 5 mm. Thus, VoxelSynth3D provides case-consistent within-distribution tissue-error reduction with a localized structural tradeoff. Spacing-aware sensitivity retained aggregate broad-region improvement and identified near-metal calibration as a target.

AI.tldr: VoxelSynth3D是一个无需训练的三维图像域金属伪影校正框架，结合支撑掩膜、归一化组织合成、偏差门控与受限边缘精修，在保留植入物体素的同时校正周围组织伪影。
AI.motivation: 术后肌骨CT中的金属伪影会遮挡骨-植入物界面及邻近软组织。现有金属伪影校正方法多依赖难以获取的原始投影或学习模型，且模型在不同扫描仪与植入物间迁移性差。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的三维图像域框架VoxelSynth3D，作用于重建CT，整合支撑掩膜、归一化组织合成、偏差门控和受限边缘精修；检测到的植入物体素在输出中保留，仅校正周围组织的金属诱导伪影。同时构建配对合成评估资源Synthetic CLINIC-Metal（基于无金属CTPelvic1K体数据，含干净目标、金属/伪影掩膜、固定随机种子和患者级划分），75例非配对真实金属病例仅作定性/无参考评估；操作点固定在近平坦验证区间，采用精确掩膜oracle定位使各方法共享排除金属的组织ROI。
AI.result: 在40例留出病例上，VoxelSynth3D将RMSE从801.48降至786.18 HU（配对增益15.30 HU，95% CI 11.68–19.23），每例均有改善，并比所评估的三维高斯平滑器优13.58 HU。金属附近的干净边缘一致性下降，但在5 mm以外优于输入。间距感知敏感性分析保留了整体区域改善，并识别出近金属标定为改进目标。
AI.conclusion: VoxelSynth3D实现了病例一致、分布内的组织误差降低，但存在局部结构权衡；间距感知敏感性分析可识别近金属标定这一改进方向。

title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Personalized Health Checkup Interpretation and Guidance
summary: Personalized interpretation of health checkup results requires reasoning across longitudinal records, medical knowledge, lifestyle guidance, and healthcare navigation. We present a multi-agent large language model (LLM) system that identifies multiple intents, maps each to a task-specific agent, executes them in parallel, and synthesizes their outputs. We compared answers generated in Single Agent and Multi Agent settings on 120 Korean compound queries combining two to four requirements, using synthetic health checkup records. The Multi Agent improved the weighted LLM-judge score from 1.695 to 1.797 (p = 0.027), and three additional LLM judges showed consistent improvements ($Δ$ = +0.111 to +0.186, all p < 0.05). The gains came from usefulness, consistency, and the handling of every requirement in compound queries, whereas numerical accuracy and grounding improved significantly under only one of the four judges and medical safety did not differ, and critical failures occurred at similar rates (Single Agent 15.0% vs. Multi Agent 13.3%). Two human evaluators preferred Multi Agent in 66.7% and 68.3% of pairwise comparisons. Multi Agent execution increased latency and cost by 1.31$\times$ and 2.02$\times$, respectively. In exploratory subgroup analyses, the improvement was concentrated in queries involving personal-record lookup.

AI.tldr: 多智能体LLM系统在韩语复合健康体检查询上优于单智能体：加权评分1.695→1.797（p=0.027），人类偏好约2/3，但延迟和成本分别增加1.31×和2.02×，且医学安全性与关键失败率无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 个性化解读健康体检结果需要同时跨纵向记录推理、调用医学知识、给出生活方式指导并完成就医导航，单一智能体难以兼顾多重要求，因此需要多智能体分工协作来提升复合查询的处理质量。
AI.method: 提出多智能体LLM系统：识别多个意图，将每个意图映射到任务专用智能体，并行执行后综合各智能体输出。基于合成健康体检记录，构建120条韩语复合查询（每条含2–4项要求），对比单智能体与多智能体设置生成的回答，采用加权LLM-judge评分、另外3个LLM评审、2名人类评估者成对比较，并测量延迟与成本。
AI.result: 多智能体将加权LLM-judge评分从1.695提升至1.797（p=0.027），另3个LLM评审一致改善（Δ=+0.111至+0.186，均p<0.05）。增益主要来自有用性、一致性及对复合查询中每项要求的覆盖；数值准确性与依据性仅在4个评审中的1个下显著改善，医学安全性无差异，关键失败率相近（单智能体15.0% vs 多智能体13.3%）。两名人类评估者在66.7%和68.3%的成对比较中偏好多智能体。多智能体执行使延迟和成本分别增加1.31×和2.02×。探索性亚组分析显示改善集中在涉及个人记录检索的查询。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体架构能有效提升复合健康体检查询的覆盖度、有用性与一致性，并获得人类偏好支持，但未提升医学安全性与关键失败率，且存在延迟与成本开销，收益主要局限于需个人记录检索的查询类型。

title: From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"源学习"(source learning)问题，即针对持久权威信息源构建可复用的源专属能力，用持久"源模型"表示这种理解，并提出 SourceLearn 通过自导向与任务导向两种机制持续精化源模型，在五个基准、三种 LLM 后端中15个设置中13个取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法分别改进信息源内容的访问与组织方式，以及通过智能体记忆保存历史交互中的可复用知识，但对同一信息源的重复使用仍被视为"重复访问"，而非逐步加深对该源理解的机会。论文旨在研究"源学习"，即对持久权威信息源形成可复用的源专属胜任能力。
AI.method: 用持久"源模型"(source model)表示源专属胜任能力，刻画对信息源知识结构、解释方式与应用方式的可复用理解。提出 SourceLearn，融合两种互补学习机制：(1) 自导向源学习(Self-Directed Source Learning)，识别尚未充分理解之处并自适应地重访信息源；(2) 任务导向源学习(Task-Guided Source Learning)，利用下游任务经验揭示局部表示缺口与知识组织的反复需求。两者均由学习信号决定需要重新考虑的内容，持久更新则从权威信息源重建。
AI.result: 在五个基准和三种 LLM 后端上，SourceLearn 在15个设置中的13个取得最佳性能，相较 Hybrid RAG 提升最高达22.6个百分点，并相对静态源表示与基于经验的记忆基线取得显著的整体改进。
AI.conclusion: 将信息源的重复使用从"重复访问"重新表述为可积累的"源学习"过程是有效的：结合自导向与任务导向两种机制、并以权威源重建持久更新，可构建持续精化的源模型，从而在知识密集型任务序列上取得稳定且显著的性能优势。

title: SuperMotion: Source-Preserving Denoising for Text-Driven Human Motion Editing
summary: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the \textbf{Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion)}, which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20\% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.

AI.tldr: 提出源保留去噪框架SuperMotion，在扩散逆过程每一步显式复用源动作，通过保守护门与干净空间锚点注入样本级时序细节，无需编辑掩码即可提升文本驱动动作编辑精度并缓解时序细节衰减。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散编辑器主要依赖学习到的条件机制来保留未编辑内容，但在去噪推进过程中输出容易丢失时序细节。作者希望显式利用源动作本身来保证源内容保留，并维持时序高频细节。
AI.method: SuperMotion在每步逆扩散中显式复用源动作：先将源动作对齐到输出时间线，并预测一个跨帧与特征维度的保守护门以控制复用程度；随后构建干净空间源锚点，用护门将预测的干净动作与对齐源混合，并将校正后的估计直接送入采样后验。由于对齐源是真实动作而非回归输出，锚点注入了重构训练去噪器易平滑掉的样本级时序细节。训练上以编辑目标监督锚定估计，并通过时序高频损失匹配其二阶时序差分，无需显式编辑掩码。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SuperMotion提升了编辑准确率，在MotionFix上达到33.20% full-pool R@1，同时减轻时序细节衰减并在实现请求变化时保持动作动力学。消融实验确认所学保守护门是性能增益的来源，且其通过复用源动作恰当保留未编辑内容。
AI.conclusion: 显式源复用结合可学习保守护门与干净空间锚点，可在无编辑掩码条件下有效改善文本驱动动作编辑的准确性与时序保真度，为扩散式动作编辑提供了一种保留源内容的新范式。

title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
summary: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别了无验证器强化学习中基于概率奖励的长度依赖失效模式（后验集中现象PCP），并提出RLCPR框架以提升优化稳定性与token效率。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏外部验证器的通用推理任务中，基于概率奖励的无验证器强化学习具有前景，但其奖励可靠性（尤其在长时程推理中）尚未被充分探究。
AI.method: 论文首先识别并刻画了后验集中现象（PCP）：当推理轨迹变长时，参考答案在给定推理轨迹下的条件概率常坍缩至低方差区间，导致奖励几乎无法区分。基于此提出RLCPR框架，包含两个组件：不确定性感知数据采样（在生成前减少易集中的rollout）和集中感知正则化（在后验奖励坍缩时惩罚不必要的长轨迹）。
AI.result: 在七个基准中的六个上，RLCPR相比最先进的无验证器强化学习基线最高提升4.0%，涵盖通用领域与数学推理任务，同时具有更高的token效率。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模后验集中现象可有效缓解概率奖励在长时程推理中的失效问题，提升无验证器强化学习的优化稳定性与token效率。

title: AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoCompact，让编码智能体将上下文压缩决策（何时压缩、保留何种工作状态、如何续接）纳入策略学习，经监督微调与强化学习联合优化，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上通过率分别绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体需通过长轨迹完成仓库级软件工程任务，随着任务推进，早期探索内容会逐渐过时，因此上下文管理不仅是避免溢出，更需智能体自主决定压缩时机、保留的工作状态以及压缩后的续接方式。现有方法未将这类决策作为策略的一部分进行学习。
AI.method: 1) 在编码任务上运行基础智能体，用评判器（judge）审查其压缩决策、摘要及压缩后动作；2) 将有缺陷的输出替换为修正版本后在环境中执行，使轨迹从修正后的决策继续推进，以此收集训练数据；3) 用这些轨迹进行监督微调；4) 再通过带任务成功奖励的强化学习联合优化编码与压缩能力。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上，AutoCompact 相比基础模型通过率分别绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%；改进在所有评估的推理预算下均成立，包括 256K 上下文窗口（从不溢出）以及 16K 窗口（溢出触发回退压缩）两种设置。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文压缩作为智能体策略的一部分进行学习是有效的，AutoCompact 能在不同推理预算与上下文窗口条件下稳定提升仓库级编码任务的成功率。

title: Synthetic training for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation in data-scarce settings
summary: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, but their automated segmentation is limited by the scarcity of positive cases and voxel-level annotations. We propose a synthetic training framework for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation that requires no real lesion annotations for training and leverages radiological description of the lesions. Starting from anatomical brain parcellations, the framework applies spatial augmentation and voxel resampling, procedurally inserts cSS and CMB labels using clinical priors on lesion location and morphology, and synthesises images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and Rician noise simulation. Models were trained on dynamically generated image-label pairs and evaluated against manual delineations in 10 cSS cases and 13 CMB cases. The proposed configurations outperformed classical filter baselines. For cSS, the hypointensity constrained model achieved higher AUPRC and AUROC than the Frangi filter (AUPRC: 0.284 vs 0.083; AUROC: 0.907 vs 0.731). For CMBs, explicit synthesis of blood vessels as lesion mimics improved performance over the classical baseline (AUPRC: 0.538 vs 0.004; AUROC: 0.999 vs 0.968). These results support our proposal as a feasible strategy for data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需真实病灶标注的合成训练框架，用于长尾出血性病灶（CMB与cSS）分割，性能优于经典滤波器基线。
AI.motivation: 脑微出血（CMB）与皮层表面铁沉积（cSS）是脑小血管病的影像标志物，但其自动分割受制于阳性病例稀少与体素级标注缺乏，属于典型的长尾、数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 基于解剖脑区划分，施加空间增强与体素重采样，按临床先验（病灶位置与形态）程序化插入cSS与CMB标签；通过随机强度赋值、模糊与Rician噪声模拟合成图像。模型在动态生成的图像-标签对上训练，无需真实病灶标注。
AI.result: 在10例cSS与13例CMB病例上与人工勾画对比评估。cSS方面，低信号约束模型AUPRC 0.284、AUROC 0.907，优于Frangi滤波（0.083、0.731）；CMB方面，显式合成血管作为混淆结构使AUPRC达0.538、AUROC达0.999，优于经典基线（0.004、0.968）。
AI.conclusion: 该合成训练框架是数据稀缺条件下出血性病灶分割的一种可行策略。

title: NextMe-800: Anticipating Personal Behavior from Months of Egocentric Video
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Dataset and benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mmm8383/NextMe-800 ; project page: https://kkkkawayi.github.io/nextme-800/
summary: We often plan ambitiously yet act habitually and wonder, in retrospect, whether we would have planned differently had we known what we would actually do. Hindsight offers a valuable perspective on past decisions, although we often wish we could have simulated hindsight at the moment of choosing. If a system could generate plausible trajectories from one's personal history, such previews might help people formulate more realistic plans and make better informed decisions. We introduce NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour first-person dataset from one volunteer over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio, captioned at five hierarchical abstraction levels from atomic actions to major activities. We formulate personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction and construct NextAct, a 1,500-point benchmark combining NextMe-800 with the multi-person EgoLife dataset. Using an embedding-based soft edit distance as the metric, we evaluate how well different models can anticipate personal behavior across abstraction levels and prediction horizons. NextMe-800 and NextAct provide a months-long resource and evaluation framework for studying how far ahead personal behavior can be anticipated from egocentric observation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了NextMe-800数据集（单人126天、约800小时的第一人称多模态数据，含1Hz图像、注视、音频及五级抽象层次标注）以及NextAct基准（结合EgoLife，共1500个评测点），将个性化行为预测形式化为开放词表K步序列预测，并用基于嵌入的软编辑距离评估模型在不同抽象层次和预测跨度上的前瞻能力。
AI.motivation: 人们常制定宏大计划却按习惯行事，事后才反思若能预知实际行为是否会做出不同规划。事后之明对理解过去决策有价值，但人们更希望在决策当下就能"模拟"这种事后视角。若能基于个人历史生成合理的未来行为轨迹预览，就可能帮助人们制定更现实的计划、做出更明智的决策，因此需要长期、细粒度的个人行为数据与预测评测框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建NextMe-800：来自单一志愿者、跨越126天、约800小时的第一人称数据集，包含1 Hz图像、注视与音频，并按五级层次化抽象（从原子动作到重大活动）进行文本标注。2) 将个性化动作预测形式化为开放词表的K步序列预测任务。3) 构建NextAct基准：将NextMe-800与多人EgoLife数据集结合，形成1500个评测点。4) 采用基于嵌入的软编辑距离（soft edit distance）作为评价指标，评测不同模型在不同抽象层次与预测跨度下的表现。
AI.result: NextMe-800提供了数月尺度、多模态、多抽象层级的个人第一人称行为资源；NextAct形成了1500点规模的评测基准。通过软编辑距离指标，论文量化评估了不同模型跨抽象层次与预测视野对个人行为的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: NextMe-800与NextAct为研究"从第一人称观察出发、能在多大时间尺度上预测个人行为"提供了跨数月的资源与评测框架。

title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次化连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），将离散token生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合于单一去噪过程，训练目标源自token似然的变分界，在Sudoku、Countdown和LM1B上优于同规模离散与连续扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时，各token从边缘分布独立采样，破坏了同一批解码token间的统计依赖；连续扩散语言模型虽通过共享连续状态去噪来保留依赖，但其去噪器仅见到该连续状态，在最终解码前无法与合法token配置绑定。因此需要一种能统一离散token生成与连续隐状态、同时保持token间依赖的框架。
AI.method: 提出HC-DLM，在单一且有原则的去噪过程中耦合离散token生成与连续隐变量轨迹，训练目标由token似然的变分下界推导得出。与将连续上下文附加到自包含离散链上的近期方法不同，HC-DLM使隐变量成为唯一持久的生成状态：每一步都从隐变量读出token，并将token反馈作为下一隐变量更新的脚手架。
AI.result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）任务上，在相同模型规模下，HC-DLM在Sudoku和Countdown的谜题准确率以及LM1B的生成困惑度方面均优于离散和连续扩散基线。
AI.conclusion: HC-DLM通过让连续隐变量成为唯一持久生成状态并往复读写token，缓解了离散扩散并行解码的独立性瓶颈与连续扩散缺乏token绑定的问题，在推理、规划与语言建模任务上取得了相对基线的改进。

title: Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
summary: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generalization to unseen manipulation methods due to the limited ability to capture transferable forensic cues. Recent cross-reconstruction based methods attempt to improve generalization through semantic-artifact disentanglement, but typically align heterogeneous artifacts across generators and exclude artifact representations during reconstruction, which may overlook the inherent diversity and visual cues of manipulation artifacts. In this work, we revisit cross-reconstruction and introduce an artifact-oriented disentanglement framework for robust image forgery detection. We argue that \textbf{artifact diversity}, i.e., the intrinsic variations of manipulation artifacts introduced by different generation processes, contains complementary forensic cues rather than undesirable domain variations. Instead of enforcing explicit artifact alignment, our framework preserves diverse artifact characteristics through semantically aligned cross-generator reconstruction. Furthermore, we incorporate artifact representations into the reconstruction process and introduce a masked frequency-aware reconstruction strategy to emphasize manipulation-related residuals while reducing semantic interference. This design enables the model to learn transferable forensic representations from diverse artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements under both cross-dataset and cross-generator evaluation settings. Further analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of artifact diversity preservation and artifact-aware cross-reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出以伪造伪影多样性为核心的跨重建解纠缠框架，用于提升图像伪造检测的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有图像伪造检测器泛化能力不足，难以捕捉可迁移的取证线索；近期跨重建方法依赖语义-伪影解纠缠，但通常对不同生成器的异构伪影做显式对齐，并在重建中排除伪影表征，从而忽视了操纵伪影的固有多样性和视觉线索。
AI.method: 重新审视跨重建范式，提出面向伪影的解纠缠框架。核心观点是伪影多样性（不同生成过程带来的固有变化）蕴含互补取证线索，而非有害域变化。方法上不做显式伪影对齐，而是通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建保留多样伪影特征；同时将伪影表征纳入重建过程，并引入掩码频率感知重建策略，以强化操纵相关残差、抑制语义干扰。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，跨数据集与跨生成器评估设置下均取得性能提升；进一步分析与消融实验验证了伪影多样性保留和伪影感知跨重建的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将伪影多样性视为可利用的互补取证信息，并通过保留多样性、纳入伪影表征的重建设计，可学习到可迁移的取证表征，从而增强图像伪造检测的泛化性。

title: Auditing Routing Entropy as an Uncertainty Signal in Attention-Residual Transformers
summary: Dynamic architectures leave a per-example routing trace beside each prediction, and diffuse routing is easy to read as a sign that the prediction is unreliable. We audit that reading for routing entropy in Attention-Residual (AR) variants of Swin-Tiny and DeiT-Small, trained from scratch on CIFAR-10/100 with a soft-binned calibration auxiliary loss, asking whether the trace carries information about correctness beyond what the model's own confidence already reveals. Three checks probe this increment: does a routing signal appear at fixed confidence, does it replicate across training seeds, and can a held-out predictor exploit it against output-only and shuffled-trace controls? A sensitivity audit then injects effects of known size and measures the fraction of each that the probes recover. No test in the fixed 30-test binned family survives multiplicity correction, and neither the nominal hit nor a borderline result recurs in its sibling seeds. Across 24 paired runs a scalar routing probe yields no pooled improvement in routing-stratified calibration, and an entropy-profile probe predicts correctness better than the same probe given shuffled profiles yet worse than a confidence-only predictor in both binary log-loss and Brier score: a gain over shuffled traces does not become a gain over the output. Conditioning on the complete logit vector leaves the corresponding comparison unresolved. The audit bounds how far these non-detections can be read: at an injected effect of 0.010 nats the profile probe recovers 24-59% of the oracle gain, and a reference-preserving correction probe recovers 8% and 23% in the two CIFAR-100 settings, below the threshold we fixed for applying it to real labels. The results establish control-dependent gains and incomplete estimator recovery, not the absence of conditional routing information.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了动态架构中"扩散路由=不可靠预测"这一直觉，检验路由熵轨迹是否携带超出模型置信度的正确性信息。三项检验（固定置信度下的路由信号、跨种子复现、留出预测器对比控制）均未发现稳健超出置信度的增益：30项分箱家族无结果通过多重校正，24对运行的路由探针无汇总改进，熵剖面探针仅优于打乱轨迹但劣于纯置信度预测器。敏感性审计表明在注入0.010 nats效应时探针仅恢复24-59%的oracle增益，故结论为"控制依赖的增益与不完整的估计器恢复"，而非路由条件信息不存在。
AI.motivation: 动态架构（如Attention-Residual变体）在每次预测旁留下逐样本路由轨迹，而"扩散路由"容易被直觉性地解读为预测不可靠的信号。作者希望审计这一解读是否成立：路由轨迹中的熵是否携带关于预测正确性的信息，且该信息是否超出模型自身置信度已揭示的内容。核心动机是区分"路由信号存在"与"路由信号在控制置信度后仍有增量价值"。
AI.method: 在Swin-Tiny与DeiT-Small的Attention-Residual (AR)变体上，从头在CIFAR-10/100上训练，并加入软分箱校准辅助损失（soft-binned calibration auxiliary loss）。设计三项检验：(1) 在固定置信度下是否存在路由信号（30项分箱检验家族，含多重性校正）；(2) 信号能否跨训练种子复现（sibling seeds）；(3) 留出预测器能否在output-only与shuffled-trace对照下利用该信号。探针包括标量路由探针（路由分层校准）与熵剖面探针（预测正确性）。此外进行敏感性审计：注入已知大小的效应，测量探针能恢复的比例，并测试保留参照的校正探针。
AI.result: 在固定30项分箱检验家族中，没有任何结果通过多重性校正；名义命中与边缘结果均未在其姊妹种子中复现。24对配对运行中，标量路由探针在路由分层校准上无汇总改进。熵剖面探针在二元log-loss与Brier score上优于打乱剖面探针，但劣于纯置信度预测器——即"相对打乱轨迹的增益并未转化为相对输出的增益"。在完整logit向量条件下，相应比较仍未解决。敏感性审计给出下界解读：注入0.010 nats效应时，剖面探针恢复oracle增益的24-59%；保留参照的校正探针在两个CIFAR-100设置中分别恢复8%与23%，低于作者设定的应用于真实标签的阈值。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了"控制依赖的增益"（control-dependent gains）与"不完整的估计器恢复"（incomplete estimator recovery），而非路由条件信息不存在的结论。换言之，未检测到超出置信度的路由信息，可能源于探针/估计器的恢复能力不足，而非信息本身缺失；因此不能将非检测直接解读为路由轨迹无预测价值。作者设定了将校正探针应用于真实标签的恢复阈值，而实测恢复率低于该阈值，故未进一步应用。

title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://risys-lab.github.io/KaliBench/ | Github: https://github.com/RISys-Lab/KaliBench
summary: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

AI.tldr: 提出 KaliBench，一个面向 Kali Linux 自然语言到命令行翻译的细粒度基准与数据集，含 8,504 条查询-命令对，覆盖 1,642 个工具；实验显示开放权重模型在无提示设置下准确率不超 42%，但基于该基准的可验证奖励训练可显著提升小模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 在网络安全领域的评测多聚焦知识问答或端到端智能体任务，缺乏对"生成真实网络安全工具可执行命令"这一能力的直接度量。而网络安全操作依赖严格 CLI，微小语法错误、标志-值绑定错误或参数顺序错误都会导致执行失败，因此需要细粒度、可执行的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 KaliBench：基于手册（manuscript-grounded）的流水线，配合确定性规范化与别名感知评估，生成 8,504 条查询-命令对，覆盖 23 个能力维度、5 个安全阶段、1,642 个工具。采用多阶段验证流水线，结合 LLM 校验、沙箱终端执行与人在回路精修，保证语义正确性与实际可执行性。基于细粒度确定性信号，支持免运行时（runtime-free）的可验证奖励用于训练。
AI.result: 在三种评估模式、24 种配置（通用与安全专用开放权重模型）下，无限制设置中没有任何开放权重模型超过 42% 的精确命令准确率，表明无显式工具提示时精确使用 CLI 网络安全工具的难度很高。使用 KaliBench 的可验证奖励进行监督微调与强化学习，可显著提升 8B 模型，性能接近 685B MoE 模型。
AI.conclusion: KaliBench 填补了自然语言到网络安全 CLI 翻译的细粒度评测空白，兼具语义正确性与可执行性验证，并能提供免运行时可验证奖励；它揭示了当前开放权重模型的能力瓶颈，同时证明基于该基准的训练可有效提升小模型表现。
