title: PAGER: Partial-to-global Alignment via Geometric and Relational Distillation
summary: Pretrained 3D encoders are typically developed on globally reconstructed scenes expressed in a consistent world coordinate frame, whereas embodied systems must reason from partial, viewpoint-dependent observations in camera coordinates. We show that this shift from globally learned 3D feature spaces to realistic partial observations exposes a severe representation mismatch, which we find consistently across representative state-of-the-art encoders, including Sonata and Concerto. A frozen Sonata encoder with a global linear probe achieves 72.47 mIoU on full ScanNet scenes, but 2.57 mIoU on single-frame camera-coordinate inputs. Training-free gravity alignment recovers performance to 41.64 mIoU, showing that coordinate-frame mismatch is a dominant source of degradation but cannot be fully resolved through canonicalization alone. We introduce PAGER, a label-free adaptation method that aligns partial-view features with a frozen global 3D semantic space using only paired partial/global geometry. It learns lightweight adaptation modules while keeping the pretrained encoder and global segmentation probe frozen. Matched-point feature alignment anchors partial features to their global counterparts, while relational supervision preserves their similarity structure with respect to the global representation. Global geometry provides supervision only during training. Inference operates directly on the partial observation. Without partial-view labels, PAGER outperforms label-supervised PEFT on both Sonata and Concerto, and in zero-shot ScanNet$\rightarrow$ScanNet++ transfer surpasses fully fine-tuned Sonata ($53.93$ vs.\ $48.09$ mIoU), suggesting that preserving the frozen global representation can improve cross-dataset transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了预训练3D编码器从全局场景到部分视角观测时存在严重的表示错配，并提出无标签适配方法PAGER，通过将部分视角特征对齐到冻结的全局3D语义空间，在无部分视角标签下超越有监督PEFT与微调方法。
AI.motivation: 预训练3D编码器通常在一致世界坐标系下的全局重建场景上训练，而具身系统须从相机坐标系下部分、视角相关的观测进行推理，这种从全局3D特征空间到真实部分观测的转变暴露出严重的表示错配。
AI.method: 提出PAGER，一种无标签适配方法，仅利用成对的部分/全局几何将部分视角特征对齐到冻结的全局3D语义空间。它训练轻量适配模块，保持预训练编码器与全局分割探针冻结；通过匹配点特征对齐锚定部分特征与其全局对应物，并用关系监督保持相对全局表示的相似性结构。全局几何仅在训练时提供监督，推理直接作用于部分观测。
AI.result: 冻结Sonata编码器配全局线性探针在全ScanNet场景上达72.47 mIoU，但在单帧相机坐标输入上仅2.57 mIoU；免训练重力对齐恢复至41.64 mIoU。PAGER在无部分视角标签下于Sonata和Concerto上均超越有监督PEFT，并在零样本ScanNet→ScanNet++迁移中超过完全微调的Sonata（53.93 vs. 48.09 mIoU）。
AI.conclusion: 坐标帧错配是性能退化的主要来源，但仅靠规范化无法完全解决；保留冻结的全局表示同时进行轻量适配，可在无部分视角标签下提升性能并改善跨数据集迁移能力。

title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
comment: Accepted for oral presentation and publication at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
summary: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出开源基准 OpenMTB-Audit（500例合成NSCLC分子肿瘤委员会病例、5类对抗性错误、4个安全标签），发现8种LLM配置普遍存在"过度拒绝"与标签坍缩；并开发确定性七模块框架 MTB-AuditAgent，将过度拒绝降至6.7%、准确率达91.2%。
AI.motivation: AI 进入分子肿瘤委员会（MTB）工作流后，关键安全挑战在于区分"真正无证据支持的推荐"与"有证据支持但因信息不全、ECOG 体能状态差等临床警示仍需肿瘤医生复核的选项"；现有评估缺乏细粒度标签，导致模型通过标签坍缩虚高安全分数。
AI.method: 构建开源基准 OpenMTB-Audit，含500例合成非小细胞肺癌病例，覆盖五类对抗性错误与四个安全标签（Supported、Partially Supported、Unsupported、Insufficient Information）；评测八种大语言模型配置；提出 MTB-AuditAgent 确定性七模块框架，将证据核验、缺失信息检测、安全分类与拒答（abstention）解耦；并开展双肿瘤医生标注研究。
AI.result: 所有 LLM 配置在真实 Partially Supported 病例中 83.3–100% 未能保留该标签，即普遍过度拒绝，其高聚合安全分来自标签坍缩而非临床校准推理；MTB-AuditAgent 将过度拒绝降至6.7%，准确率91.2%（95% CI: 88.6–93.6%）；两位肿瘤医生标注的分歧集中于"信息充分性"与"治疗优化"的边界。
AI.conclusion: 现有 LLM 在 MTB 场景的安全表现被标签坍缩掩盖，需保留临床上有意义的标签区分；确定性、模块化解耦的 MTB-AuditAgent 显著缓解过度拒绝并提升准确性，同时标注分歧提示需明确信息充分性与治疗优化的判定边界。

title: Trajectory-Aware Clinical Risk Prediction via Severity-Grounded Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: While Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer a wealth of clinical data, effectively augmenting a patient's records with heterogeneous external knowledge to predict the patient's clinical risk remains a significant challenge. Existing methods fail to capture disease severity, treatment responses, and nuanced clinical progression, due to data sparsity and the underutilization of unstructured clinical notes. To address these challenges, we propose TRACER (a trajectory-aware and clinically grounded prediction framework) that (1) constructs a medical knowledge graph enriched with severity information from medical literature, (2) retrieves clinically relevant, severity-weighted paths of a patient's progression from the knowledge graph, (3) extracts clinically relevant events from unstructured clinical notes, and (4) augments patient context with similar peer cases. Experiments on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets demonstrate large gains over state-of-the-art baselines, with up to 28.5% increase in Macro F1 score for the mortality prediction task, and 19.7% increase for the readmission prediction task.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACER框架，通过医学知识图谱、严重程度加权路径、非结构化临床笔记事件抽取及相似病例增强，提升EHR临床风险预测性能。
AI.motivation: EHR含丰富临床数据，但现有方法因数据稀疏及未充分利用非结构化临床笔记，难以刻画疾病严重程度、治疗反应与细微临床进展，外部异构知识融合效果不佳。
AI.method: TRACER包含四部分：(1)从医学文献构建融入严重程度信息的医学知识图谱；(2)从知识图谱中检索患者病程的临床相关、严重程度加权路径；(3)从非结构化临床笔记中抽取临床相关事件；(4)用相似同类病例增强患者上下文。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV数据集上显著优于SOTA基线，死亡率预测Macro F1最高提升28.5%，再入院预测提升19.7%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹感知且临床落地的预测框架能有效融合异构外部知识与临床笔记，显著提升EHR临床风险预测表现。

title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector $τ_l$, the layer-wise representational difference induced by reversing temporal order. Tracking its magnitude across layers reveals a consistent temporal divergence profile where the divergence peaks at intermediate layers and progressively diminishes toward the output. We confirm this peak is specific to temporal reasoning and functionally critical for predictions, establishing that VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output. This progressive fading motivates our method, Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), which extracts $τ_l$ at the peak of the profile for each input and reinjects it into subsequent layers following the measured decay. TAI requires no training and consistently improves temporal reasoning across three VideoLLMs and four benchmarks with negligible impact on non-temporal tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/Before-It-Fades.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现视频大模型(VideoLLMs)存在"时序发散在中间层达到峰值、随后向输出层逐渐衰减"的现象,据此提出无需训练的Temporal Activation Injection (TAI),将峰值层的时间发散向量按测得的衰减规律重新注入后续层,在3个模型与4个基准上稳定提升时序推理能力。
AI.motivation: VideoLLMs按顺序接收视频帧并解读视觉内容的时间演化,但时序推理始终是跨架构的薄弱环节:将视频帧序颠倒(理论上应反转时序答案)后,模型的最终预测往往保持不变。作者希望定位这一失败的根源,即模型究竟在何处获取时序信息、又为何无法将其保持到输出。
AI.method: 1) 定义时序发散向量 τ_l,即由时序顺序反转所引起的逐层表征差异;2) 追踪其幅值随层数的变化,刻画时序发散剖面;3) 验证该峰值是时序推理特有的且对预测具有功能关键性;4) 提出Temporal Activation Injection (TAI):对每个输入在剖面峰值处提取 τ_l,并按照测得的衰减规律将其重新注入后续层。该方法无需训练。
AI.result: 时序发散剖面呈现一致规律:发散在中间层达到峰值,并向输出层逐步衰减;该峰值特异于时序推理且对预测功能关键。TAI在3个VideoLLM与4个基准上一致提升时序推理性能,且对非时序任务影响可忽略。
AI.conclusion: VideoLLMs在中间层已获得时序信息,但未能将其维持至输出,导致时序推理失败;通过在峰值层提取并按衰减规律重注入时序发散向量(TAI),可在不训练的前提下有效缓解该问题,代码已开源。

title: MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills
summary: As agents evolve from single-tool systems into modular, composite architectures, skills are becoming an important mechanism for capability development and distribution. However, the academic community lacks a structured framework for systematically analyzing and evaluating skills. Drawing on information gain and behavioral constraint, we propose the four-dimensional MCRI Framework and operationalize it as MCRI-Eval, a large language model-based evaluation method. We evaluate MCRI-Eval using 63,812 public skills from the OpenClaw skill Hub, with 58,275 skill-conditioned model executions across BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web. MCRI-Eval scores are positively associated with community popularity signals and achieve the highest downstream ranking agreement among the evaluated methods. MCRI-Eval also improves top-1 skill selection across all three benchmarks: compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, the skills selected by MCRI-Eval advance by 17.7, 22.8, and 19.6 percentile points in downstream performance rank on BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web, respectively. These results indicate that MCRI-Eval provides a useful pre-execution signal for prioritizing promising skills before costly execution-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCRI四维框架及其可操作的LLM评估方法MCRI-Eval，用于技能（skills）的结构化分析与评估。基于OpenClaw技能库63,812个公开技能和三项基准上58,275次技能条件执行验证，MCRI-Eval评分与社区热度正相关，下游排序一致性最高，并使top-1技能选择的性能百分位分别提升17.7、22.8、19.6个点。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体从单一工具系统演化为模块化、复合式架构，技能成为能力开发与分发的重要机制。然而，学术界缺乏对技能进行系统化分析与评估的结构化框架，导致在昂贵执行评估之前难以判断技能价值。
AI.method: 借鉴信息增益与行为约束，提出MCRI四维框架，并将其操作化为基于大语言模型的评估方法MCRI-Eval；在OpenClaw技能库63,812个公开技能上评估，并在BigCodeBench、BFCL-Fundamental、Mind2Web三个基准上执行58,275次技能条件模型执行，与社区热度信号及多种基线方法进行对照比较。
AI.result: MCRI-Eval评分与社区热度信号正相关，在评测方法中取得最高的下游排序一致性；在三个基准上均改善top-1技能选择，相比各基准最强基线，所选技能在下游性能排名上分别提升17.7、22.8和19.6个百分位点。
AI.conclusion: MCRI-Eval可在高成本执行评估之前提供有效的预执行信号，用于优先筛选有潜力的技能，为技能的规模化评估与选择提供可行方案。

title: Hob-VL: A Benchmark for Visually Grounded Boolean Reasoning
summary: Reliable visual reasoning requires composing multiple visual observations and returning consistent answers to logically equivalent questions. We introduce Hob-VL, a benchmark for visually grounded Boolean reasoning. Hob-VL comprises two tasks: (1) evaluating whether a Boolean rule holds in an image, and (2) identifying the (unique) object satisfying a Boolean description. Hob-VL contains 6,000 human-verified balanced Yes/No questions, each defined by a Boolean combination of ten visual statements, across 1,000 generated scenes and 46 diverse labeled photographs, along with 1,000 object-identification questions over the same photographs. Our question families are deliberately constructed to challenge reasoning through misleading local cues and nested logical operations, and include symbolic and structured natural-language presentations. Across eight model configurations with thinking disabled or minimized, Boolean accuracy ranges from 48.52% to 50.57%, while the identification accuracy reaches at most 43.0%. A thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves uneven gains while retaining substantial errors and inconsistencies. Hob-VL exposes these failures through executable reference answers and matched evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hob-VL，一个用于视觉接地布尔推理的基准，包含规则验证与对象识别两类任务，揭示现有模型在布尔组合推理上的严重缺陷。
AI.motivation: 可靠视觉推理需组合多个视觉观察并对逻辑等价问题给出一致答案，但现有基准难以系统评测这种布尔组合推理能力，尤其缺乏对误导性局部线索与嵌套逻辑操作的挑战。
AI.method: 构建Hob-VL基准：含6,000个经人工校验的平衡Yes/No问题，每题由一个布尔组合（基于十个视觉陈述）定义，覆盖1,000个生成场景与46张多样化标注照片；另含同一照片上的1,000个对象识别问题。问题族刻意设计以挑战误导性局部线索与嵌套逻辑操作，并提供符号化与结构化自然语言两种表述。
AI.result: 在八种模型配置（关闭或最小化思考）下，布尔准确率仅为48.52%–50.57%；识别准确率最高仅43.0%。启用思考的GLM配置虽有增益但不均衡，仍存在大量错误与不一致。
AI.conclusion: Hob-VL通过可执行参考答案与配对评估暴露了当前模型视觉布尔推理的失败，表明其在组合逻辑推理与一致性方面仍有显著不足。

title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
summary: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 预训练LLM配备轻量推理框架即可作为有能力的智能体，其pass@K（解覆盖率）常超过后训练对应模型；后训练将任务推向"必解"或"必不解"两极，提升采样效率但损失解覆盖率，作者提出Sharpening Tax量化该代价，并提出PTGS采样器以减小该税费。
AI.motivation: 已有观点认为RL后训练仅"锐化"基座模型已有行为，以单次准确率换取解覆盖率；但该权衡在数学与代码任务中被观察到，未必适用于需多轮工具使用与交互的智能体任务，后者可能依赖后训练新获得的能力。作者希望检验该权衡在智能体场景是否成立并量化其代价。
AI.method: 1) 在4个模型家族、14组基座/后训练模型对、3个智能体基准（共42个案例）上比较pass@1与pass@K；2) 分析后训练对任务可解性的分布影响机制；3) 提出诊断指标Sharpening Tax，量化后训练导致的测试时可扩展性损失，并检验其可由少量rollout估计及与其他指标的相关性；4) 提出posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS)，一种按提示估计难度自适应调整采样温度的即插即用贝叶斯采样器，并在两个智能体环境的RL训练中验证。
AI.result: 预训练LLM配合轻量推理框架在pass@1上远低于后训练模型，但在充足测试时预算下pass@K常反超；后训练将任务推向"总是解出"或"从不解决"两极，提升采样效率与一致性却降低解覆盖率；Sharpening Tax在42个案例中的多数设置普遍存在，可由少量rollout估计，且与其他指标相关性良好；PTGS在RL训练中比固定温度基线税费更小，重复采样下解出更多任务，同时单次准确率也提升。
AI.conclusion: RL后训练在智能体任务中并非简单锐化，而是以解覆盖率为代价换取采样效率与一致性，该代价可用Sharpening Tax诊断；PTGS通过按提示难度自适应调节采样温度，能减轻该代价并同时改善pass@K与pass@1，为智能体RL后训练提供实用改进。

title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models
summary: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction: as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity, where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State, where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira, an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira

AI.tldr: Oneira 是一个交互式视频世界模型，通过由编码智能体管理的显式可扩展世界状态，闭合生成与交互的循环，实现开放世界交互性与持久状态。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频世界模型虽能合成开放式环境，但"开放式生成"并不等于"完整交互"：新生成的内容未纳入可操作范围，交互结果仅为短暂视觉特效而非持久环境改变。论文将此归纳为两项需求——开放世界交互性（新实体纳入可操作世界）与持久状态（交互结果写入世界状态并持续影响后续观测）。
AI.method: Oneira 采用编码智能体维护显式、可扩展的世界状态：给定当前观测与动作/高层目标，智能体读取世界状态、定位相关实体、规划交互，并将结果写回世界状态表。探索中发现新物体时，智能体从生成观测中将其纳入，使交互空间随生成世界扩展；先前的状态变化跨视频片段传递。更新后的世界状态沿相机动作轨迹渲染为粗糙条件视频，再由视频生成器补全状态中未表示的外观、运动与交互细节。
AI.result: 实验表明，Oneira 能够对新生成物体进行直接且一致的交互，同时可在长时间跨度上保留先前交互的效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式世界状态与编码智能体的读写闭环，Oneira 将生成与交互耦合，验证了开放世界交互性与持久状态作为交互式视频世界模型关键设计原则的有效性。

title: Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.

AI.tldr: 本文将测试时训练(TTT)框架引入离线强化学习，提出Decision Titan（在决策Transformer上增加TTT层），在X-Maze环境中验证其长程记忆能力并分析其记忆机制。
AI.motivation: 序列决策中的长期依赖仍是AI核心难题：RNN受梯度消失与向量隐状态表达能力限制，Transformer受注意力二次复杂度制约。TTT框架通过梯度下降在参数中存储情景记忆，已在NLP中成功，但尚未应用于强化学习，也缺乏对其记忆机制的实证分析。
AI.method: 在离线RL中，将TTT层增强到Decision Transformer上，构建Decision Titan模型；在X-Maze环境（T-Maze的扩展，用于测试序列记忆）中评估性能；通过可视化门控值随时间的变化，分析记忆机制的学习过程。
AI.result: Decision Titan能够学习比上下文窗口长20倍范围的长程依赖，并可泛化到训练数据长度1.7倍的序列；但时间泛化能力依赖于所使用的时间嵌入，而学习长程依赖的能力取决于相关信息如何被编码。
AI.conclusion: TTT框架在离线RL中具有潜力，可显著扩展有效记忆范围；但其时间泛化与长程依赖学习受时间嵌入设计和信息编码方式的制约，二者是后续设计的关键因素。

title: Beyond Domain-Level Adaptation: Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction for Personalized Federated Vision-Language Models
summary: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables distributed clients to adapt pretrained vision-language models without sharing raw data or updating the full backbone. Its effectiveness, however, is limited by domain heterogeneity across clients. Existing personalized methods separate globally shared knowledge from client-specific style, but they largely treat each domain as a class-agnostic transformation. We show that this abstraction is insufficient: the cross-domain displacement associated with a fixed domain varies across semantic classes, and only a subset of these class-domain residuals damages the image-text decision margin. We therefore propose Margin-Oriented Semantic-Appearance Interaction Correction (MOSAIC), which first constructs a decision-aware harmfulness score that measures whether a training-derived class-domain residual favors a competing text prototype over the true class. It then models fine-grained class-domain interactions with a low-rank residual adapter whose class factors and residual basis are globally shared while domain factors remain client-private. An image-conditioned gate further controls candidate-wise correction, and harmful-pair-aware reweighting prioritizes decision-relevant residuals during local optimization. Extensive experiments on Office31, OfficeHome, and DomainNet100 demonstrate that MOSAIC consistently improves macro-client top-1 accuracy across all evaluated domain-shift and joint domain-label-shift settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOSAIC，通过建模类别-域细粒度交互并聚焦损害图文决策边界的残差，改善联邦参数高效微调在域异构下的个性化性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦参数高效微调可在不共享原始数据、不更新完整骨干的前提下适配预训练视觉-语言模型，但客户端间域异构限制其效果。现有方法将全局共享知识与客户端特定风格分离，却大多把每个域视为与类别无关的变换；作者指出该抽象不足：固定域对应的跨域位移随语义类别变化，且仅部分类别-域残差损害图文决策边界。
AI.method: MOSAIC首先构造决策感知的危害性评分，衡量由训练得到的类别-域残差是否使竞争文本原型优于真实类别；随后用低秩残差适配器建模细粒度类别-域交互，其中类别因子与残差基全局共享，域因子保持客户端私有；再用图像条件门控控制候选修正，并通过有害对感知重加权在本地优化中优先处理与决策相关的残差。
AI.result: 在Office31、OfficeHome和DomainNet100上的大量实验表明，MOSAIC在所有评估的域偏移及联合域-标签偏移设置下均持续提升宏客户端top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将域视为类别无关变换不足以刻画域异构；显式建模类别-域交互并针对损害决策边界的残差进行修正，可有效提升联邦参数高效微调的个性化性能。

title: Towards Reliable Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) are increasingly being explored in autonomous driving for tasks such as scene understanding, driving reasoning, decision-making, and end-to-end driving. As their role becomes more prominent, ensuring their robustness and reliability is increasingly important. In real-world conditions, visual inputs may be degraded by sensor imperfections and environmental conditions, potentially affecting both model predictions and their associated confidence. Such degradation is especially concerning in autonomous driving, where safety-critical decisions require models to make accurate predictions and recognize when their predictions may be unreliable. In this work, we evaluate five VLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-E4B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B, and NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B) across four driving-related QA datasets with different visual input settings, including single-frame, multi-view, multi-frame, and monocular inputs. Our results show that the effects of visual corruption vary across models, datasets, and input settings, with changes in accuracy and confidence reliability and also differing across conditions. We then apply Visual Evidence Augmentation ($\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$), a recent inference-time method to examine whether it can improve model reliability under degraded visual conditions. We find that $\mathrm{V}{\scriptstyle \mathrm{EA}}$ improves performance for some models and datasets, although the gains are not consistent across all settings.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了五种视觉语言模型（VLM）在自动驾驶场景下、视觉输入退化时的鲁棒性与置信度可靠性，并检验了推理时方法 VEA 的改善效果。
AI.motivation: VLM 在自动驾驶中被广泛用于场景理解、驾驶推理、决策和端到端驾驶，其鲁棒性与可靠性日益关键。真实环境中传感器缺陷与环境条件会退化视觉输入，可能同时影响预测结果与其置信度；在安全攸关的自动驾驶中，模型不仅要预测准确，还需识别自身预测何时不可靠。
AI.method: 在四个驾驶相关问答数据集上，设置单帧、多视角、多帧和单目等不同视觉输入方式，评估五个 VLM（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-E4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、DriveFusion/DriveFusionQA-4B、NVIDIA Alpamayo-1.5-10B）；随后应用推理时方法 Visual Evidence Augmentation（VEA），检验其在视觉退化条件下能否提升模型可靠性。
AI.result: 视觉损坏的影响因模型、数据集和输入设置而异；准确率与置信度可靠性的变化在不同条件下也各不相同。VEA 对部分模型和数据集有性能提升，但增益并非在所有设置下都一致。
AI.conclusion: VLM 在退化视觉条件下的鲁棒性与置信度可靠性表现高度依赖具体模型、数据集和输入配置；VEA 可带来局部改善，但尚不能提供稳定一致的可靠性提升。

title: Fusing Visual and Textual Representations via Multi-layer Fusing Transformers for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
summary: In recent decades, artificial intelligence has made significant progress in understanding and interacting with images. One of the important applications of this technology is Visual Question Answering (VQA), a research field that requires computers to understand and answer questions about images in a natural manner. Despite extensive research and development in VQA for English, there have been very few similar efforts made for other languages, especially Vietnamese. This gap presents a significant challenge and opportunity for the advancement of VQA technology in the Vietnamese language context. By bridging this gap, the field of Vietnamese VQA not only enriches the diversity of research in artificial intelligence but also enables practical applications in various domains, such as education, healthcare, and entertainment, catering to Vietnamese-speaking populations worldwide. Thus, the exploration and development of Vietnamese VQA systems hold immense potential for advancing both research and practical applications in the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing. In this paper, we propose a Multi-layer Fusing Transformer model utilizing a cross attention module to combine multiple modality features of images and texts from different layers in an aggregated representation. Our architecture allows us extract information from low level to high level. Through detailed experiments and ablation studies, our model achieves promising results against the competitive baselines in ViVQA dataset for Vietnamese language.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种多层融合Transformer模型，通过交叉注意力模块聚合图像与文本不同层的多模态特征，在越南语ViVQA数据集上取得优于基线的结果。
AI.motivation: 视觉问答（VQA）在英语领域已有大量研究，但针对其他语言（尤其是越南语）的工作非常少。填补越南语VQA的空白既能丰富人工智能研究的多样性，也能推动教育、医疗、娱乐等领域的实际应用，服务全球越南语人群。
AI.method: 提出多层融合Transformer（Multi-layer Fusing Transformer）模型，利用交叉注意力（cross attention）模块，将图像与文本在多个不同层级的特征进行融合，形成聚合表示，从而能够从低层到高层提取信息。
AI.result: 在越南语ViVQA数据集上，通过详细实验与消融研究，模型取得了优于竞争性基线的良好结果。
AI.conclusion: 越南语VQA系统的探索具有重要研究与实用价值，所提出的多层融合Transformer架构能够有效整合多模态多层特征，在越南语VQA任务上表现优异。

title: Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)
summary: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

AI.tldr: 本文将语义ID构建重新定义为递归图聚类问题，提出统一框架GrIS，把RQ-VAE/RQ-KMeans视为图为空时的特例，并实例化RecDMoN与RQ-GAE，在多个真实数据集上相对CF-aware SOTA最高提升+52% Hit@10。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐的语义ID（SID）研究将SID构建视为表示学习问题：把物品编码到量化隐空间再读取码字。作者认为这一视角是偶然的，忽略了SID构建本质上是递归聚类问题，从而限制了设计空间与对图结构（内容语义+协同信号）的利用。
AI.method: 将SID构建形式化为递归聚类：聚类对象是节点带语义内容、边带协同信号的图，SID分配即层次化图划分，进而提出统一框架GrIS。该框架把SID构建拆解为两个此前被混淆的轴：图构建与递归划分算法。两个实例：RecDMoN通过可微图池化实现层次化分配；RQ-GAE在RQ-VAE基础上引入图感知物品表示与图重构目标。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上，GrIS相比CF-aware的SOTA方法持续取得提升，Hit@10最高提升+52%。
AI.conclusion: RQ-VAE与RQ-KMeans被证明是图为空时的特例，内容量化仅是大设计空间的一个角落。由于图构建与划分是显式、可独立配置的组件，两个轴上的改进可以组合并系统评估，GrIS提供了一个包纳而非取代既有方法的统一视角。

title: Not All Error Yields to Scale: Where Scaling Stops in Vision-Language Inference
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) face a fixed-budget trade-off between processing more visual information for fine-grained perception and using a larger language backbone for complex reasoning. Existing studies do not tell us which combination of backbone size and input resolution to deploy, especially in high-resolution deployments. To address this gap, we propose the Separable Law that describes how VLM performance changes with language backbone size and visual token count. We fit the law to measurements from 26 InternVL and QwenVL models, with language backbone sizes from 1B to 72B, on four high-resolution benchmarks with image sizes from 224 pixels to 8K. We find that the questions responding to scaling can be predicted from the skill they require, while a substantial fraction never responds at all. We also find that the two model families gain similarly from a larger backbone, while their gains from more visual tokens differ sharply. Combined with a cost law, the Separable Law gives a closed-form rule for allocating compute between backbone size and visual tokens. When deployment is limited to available configurations, the law identifies model and image sizes that perform close to the best feasible choice under the same budget. We hope our work offers a principled way to decide how much a model should be allowed to see at high resolution, given what it must reason about.

AI.tldr: 提出"可分离定律"，刻画VLM性能随语言主干规模与视觉token数量的变化关系，并据此给出预算分配规则。
AI.motivation: VLM在固定算力预算下需权衡：增加视觉信息以提升细粒度感知，还是扩大语言主干以增强复杂推理。现有研究未能说明在高分辨率部署场景中应如何搭配主干规模与输入分辨率。
AI.method: 提出可分离定律（Separable Law），在26个InternVL与QwenVL模型（语言主干1B至72B）、四个高分辨率基准（图像尺寸224像素至8K）的测量数据上拟合该定律；并结合成本定律推导闭式分配规则。
AI.result: 可扩展性问题可由其所需技能预测，而相当比例的问题始终不随规模响应；两个模型族从更大主干中获益相近，但从更多视觉token中获益差异显著。结合成本定律后，可得在主干规模与视觉token之间分配算力的闭式规则；在受限配置下也能识别接近同预算最优的模型与图像尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为"在给定推理需求下，模型在高分辨率下应被允许看到多少"提供了有原则的决策依据。

title: The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
summary: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act requires all Member States to establish AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS) by August 2027: supervised environments bringing together national Competent Authorities, technical experts, and the organisations under assessment. When AIRS engagements include structured technical testing, running such testing at scale demands dedicated infrastructure, yet the tooling ecosystem remains structurally fragmented, with heterogeneous tools producing outputs that are difficult to compare, trace, and reuse. From the procedural conditions of AIRS engagements and the AI Act obligations for high-risk systems, we derive 11 architectural and governance requirements for the infrastructure that operationalises technical testing within an AIRS. In response to these requirements, we introduce the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator, an open-source framework combining a curated Catalogue of tests and controls accessed through a stable plug-in API, a shared data model that harmonises heterogeneous outputs, role-specific dashboards for multi-disciplinary interpretation, and audience-segmented reporting. We describe the architecture and current release, and report an early-stage pilot that exercised the harmonisation and reporting layers within a live AIRS engagement and contributed to an official Exit Report. We discuss the roadmap, the governance questions raised by the Catalogue's tiered contribution model, and the institutional pathways through which an open-source assessment ecosystem could emerge across Member States.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欧盟《人工智能法案》要求各成员国在2027年前建立AI监管沙盒（AIRS）的背景，提出11项架构与治理需求，并开发了开源框架"AI评估沙盒配置器"，以支持AIRS内的结构化技术测试。
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》要求成员国在2027年8月前建立AI监管沙盒（AIRS），但支撑大规模结构化技术测试的工具生态呈结构性碎片化：工具异构，输出难以比较、追溯和复用，缺乏统一的基础设施来承载AIRS中的技术测试。
AI.method: 作者从AIRS参与的程序性条件与《人工智能法案》对高风险系统的义务出发，推导出11项架构与治理需求；据此设计了开源框架"AI评估沙盒配置器"，包含：通过稳定插件API访问的测试与控制目录（Catalogue）、统一异构输出的共享数据模型、面向多学科解读的角色化仪表盘，以及按受众分层的报告功能。并通过一次在真实AIRS参与中的早期试点，验证其协调与报告层。
AI.result: 该框架架构与当前版本已实现；早期试点在真实AIRS参与中运行了数据协调与报告层，并为一份官方退出报告（Exit Report）做出了贡献。
AI.conclusion: 论文讨论了后续路线图、目录分层贡献模型所引发的治理问题，以及开源评估生态在成员国间形成的制度路径，表明该框架可为AIRS技术测试的标准化与可复用性提供基础设施支撑。

title: DiVid: Diagnosing Dimension-Specific Diversity Collapse in Video Generation Models
summary: Despite remarkable progress, video generation models often produce highly similar outputs when repeatedly sampled from the same prompt, limiting their usefulness for creative exploration. Existing diversity evaluations primarily rely on global scalar metrics, which obscure where diversity collapses in the spatiotemporal space of videos. We introduce DiVid, a dimension-level diagnostic framework that decomposes video generation diversity into six interpretable dimensions: Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera. Each dimension is measured through a reproducible computer-vision pipeline and analyzed alongside quality and instruction faithfulness to examine potential trade-offs. Systematic evaluation of representative video generation models reveals that diversity is highly dimension-specific: models with strong global diversity scores still collapse on specific factors, particularly Motion and Camera. These rankings persist after filtering unfaithful generations, indicating genuine capability differences rather than off-prompt outputs. Beyond measurement, controlled prompt interventions identify two fundamental bottlenecks: default mode convergence, where models fall back to dominant patterns under open-ended prompts; and realization gaps, where models fail to faithfully realize diverse, explicitly requested alternatives, particularly for temporal factors. The larger faithfulness losses for temporal factors highlight the difficulty of controlling motion and camera variation through text alone. DiVid thus shifts the study of diversity from measuring whether it exists to diagnosing where and why it collapses, and provides actionable directions for dimension-aware training objectives and control signals. The framework will be released to facilitate future research on diverse and controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出DiVid，一个维度级视频生成多样性诊断框架，将多样性分解为语义、风格、主体、场景、运动、镜头六个维度，揭示多样性坍塌的具体位置与原因。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型对同一提示重复采样时输出高度相似，限制创意探索；而现有多样性评估主要依赖全局标量指标，无法定位多样性在时空维度上的坍塌位置。
AI.method: DiVid将视频生成多样性分解为六个可解释维度（Semantic、Style、Subject、Scene、Motion、Camera），每个维度通过可复现的计算机视觉流水线度量，并与质量和指令忠实度联合分析；同时通过受控提示干预进行诊断。
AI.result: 多样性高度维度特异：全局多样性得分高的模型在特定因素（尤其Motion与Camera）上仍会坍塌；过滤不忠实生成后排名保持一致，表明是真实能力差异；识别出两种瓶颈——默认模式收敛与实现鸿沟，且时序因素的忠实度损失更大。
AI.conclusion: DiVid将多样性研究从"是否存在"转向"何处及为何坍塌"，为维度感知的训练目标与控制信号提供可行方向，框架将开源以促进多样且可控的视频生成研究。

title: Evaluating Physical Consistency and Plausibility in Generative Scenario Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Generative AI models are increasingly used for scenario generation in autonomous driving. While they can generate realistic-looking scenarios, they often provide limited transparency into learned representations and consistency with real-world vehicle dynamics. This lack of formal assurance limits their use in safety-critical validation and certification workflows. To address this aspect, we introduce a layered evaluation protocol that complements existing methods by assessing models across five layers. The first four layers inspect internal representations and network layers through kinematic alignment, statistical baseline comparison, latent controllability, and activation analysis. The fifth layer evaluates model outputs against vehicle dynamics constraints such as lateral jerk thresholds. We demonstrate the protocol on a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based scenario generator. Although standard output-level metrics and visualizations suggest that the generated scenarios are realistic, our protocol provides deeper insight into the extent to which the model's latent space aligns with kinematic features and whether visually plausible trajectories satisfy vehicle-dynamics constraints. We further apply the protocol to additional generative models, demonstrating its applicability beyond the VAE architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出一种五层级评估协议，从内部表征到车辆动力学约束系统评估自动驾驶场景生成模型，揭示输出级指标难以发现的模型局限。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI被广泛用于自动驾驶场景生成，但模型内部表征透明度低、与真实车辆动力学一致性不足，缺乏形式化保证，限制了其在安全关键验证与认证流程中的应用。
AI.method: 构建分层评估协议，共五层：前四层针对内部表征与网络层，分别进行运动学对齐、统计基线对比、潜空间可控性与激活分析；第五层将模型输出与车辆动力学约束（如横向加加速度阈值）进行比对。以基于VAE的场景生成器为对象进行验证，并将协议应用于其他生成模型以检验其通用性。
AI.result: 尽管标准输出级指标与可视化显示生成场景逼真，该协议仍能深入揭示潜空间与运动学特征的对齐程度，以及视觉上合理的轨迹是否满足车辆动力学约束。
AI.conclusion: 该分层协议补充了现有评估方法，可提升生成式场景模型的可解释性与形式化保证程度；并在VAE之外的生成模型上验证了适用性，为安全关键的自动驾驶验证与认证提供支持。

title: Do MLLM Judges Judge the Edit? Auditing Bias in Image Editing Evaluation with Verified Quality Preservation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for instruction-based image editing and as reward signals for model training. However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality. To address this challenge, we introduce EditJudgeBias, a counterfactual benchmark with verified quality preservation, comprising 1,196 real editing samples and 13 cues injected across four evaluation sites. We verify quality preservation for the requested edit using calibrated multimodal validators, controls, and human inspection. We then audit five MLLM judges along three complementary dimensions: invariance to quality-preserving cues, agreement with human judgments, and stability of pairwise preferences. Importantly, observed shifts are evaluated against each judge's own zero-dose and re-query noise floors rather than against zero. Experiments show that quality-preserving cues move every judge beyond its own noise. Fabricated majority opinions increase ratings, irrelevant visual elements cause larger shifts than whole-image manipulations, and swapping candidate order reverses up to 60.9% of pairwise decisions. Edit-region cues also tend to reduce human agreement. The three measures characterize judges differently, showing that robustness cannot be captured by a single metric.

AI.tldr: 提出 EditJudgeBias 反事实基准，通过经验证的质量保持型视觉干预，系统审计多模态大模型图像编辑评判中的偏差。
AI.motivation: MLLM 被广泛用作图像编辑的自动评判器与训练奖励信号，但视觉干预本身可能改变编辑质量，导致无法判断评分偏移是源于偏差还是真实质量变化，因此缺乏系统审计手段。
AI.method: 构建含 1,196 个真实编辑样本、4 个评估位点、13 类注入线索的反事实基准；用校准的多模态验证器、对照实验与人工检查验证质量保持性；沿三个维度审计五个 MLLM 评判器：对质量保持线索的不变性、与人类判断的一致性、成对偏好的稳定性；并将观测偏移与各评判器自身的零剂量及重复查询噪声底线对比。
AI.result: 质量保持型线索使所有评判器的评分偏移均超出其自身噪声底线；伪造的多数意见会提高评分；无关视觉元素造成的偏移大于整图操纵；交换候选顺序可逆转高达 60.9% 的成对判断；编辑区域相关线索往往降低与人类判断的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 三个维度对评判器的刻画各不相同，说明鲁棒性无法用单一指标衡量；所提基准为审计 MLLM 编辑评判偏差提供了可验证质量保持的反事实范式。

title: Agents Are Systems, Not Models: Rethinking Agentic Evaluation
summary: Agent evaluations increasingly go beyond a single success rate, reporting metrics such as cost, consistency, and robustness. Yet they typically treat the agent itself as fixed. In practice, an agent is a configurable system: users decide what to tell it, how long to let it run, and which model to use, and each of these choices can change how well and how consistently it performs. We study these choices on a new benchmark of four scientific tasks, where a coding agent must find and correctly operate a published specialist model. We investigate five parts of the agent's configuration: task information, reasoning, self-verification, time budget, and backbone model. We find substantial run-to-run variability, with approximately 54% of the outcome variance coming from repeating the same configuration rather than changing it. Across configurations, the information provided to the agent has the largest effect, exceeding both time budget and model size, while also reducing cost and improving calibration. Configuration choices also interact: additional time helps only when the agent has sufficient information or a capable enough model to use it. Finally, a trajectory-based taxonomy of agent behavior reveals that prompting an agent to verify its answer has little effect on its verification behavior, whereas providing a dedicated verification tool changes that behavior substantially. These results suggest that agents should be evaluated as configurable systems themselves, and that some desired behaviors are more effectively implemented in the system than requested through prompting. We release the benchmark and more than 18,000 agent trajectories.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将智能体视为可配置系统进行评估，在四个科学任务上考察五类配置维度，发现重复同一配置即贡献约54%的结果方差，任务信息影响最大，且配置间存在交互作用。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估多报告成本、一致性、鲁棒性等指标，但通常将智能体本身视为固定不变，忽视了它实际是由用户配置决定的系统，而这些配置选择会显著影响性能与稳定性。
AI.method: 构建包含四个科学任务的新基准，要求编码智能体找到并正确操作已发表的专用模型；系统考察五类配置：任务信息、推理、自我验证、时间预算与骨干模型；并基于轨迹对智能体行为进行分类分析。
AI.result: 存在显著的运行间波动，约54%的结果方差来自重复相同配置而非改变配置；跨配置比较中，提供给智能体的信息影响最大，超过时间预算和模型规模，同时降低成本并改善校准；配置间存在交互，额外时间仅在信息充足或模型足够强时才有帮助；基于轨迹的分类显示，提示自我验证对验证行为影响甚微，而提供专用验证工具则显著改变该行为。
AI.conclusion: 智能体应被作为可配置系统本身加以评估；某些期望行为通过系统设计实现比通过提示请求更有效；作者发布了该基准及超过18,000条智能体轨迹。

title: When Text-to-Image Helps Editing: The Effects of Conditioning During Denoising
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Unified models are trained for both instruction-based image editing and text-to-image (T2I) generation, but standard editing pipelines keep source-image conditioning throughout denoising. We ask whether editing can benefit from T2I, and study how the effects of conditioning vary across edits and denoising stages. In pure editing, source attention declines for some edits over the sampling trajectory. This observation led us to task switching, which lets the model draw on its T2I capabilities. Across three unified editors and four benchmarks, switching to the T2I task for bounded intervals improves edit quality, while mean perceptual preservation remains close to pure editing across all three models. Unified editors therefore benefit from using both conditioning modes they are trained for, and the timing of the switch sets the balance between quality and preservation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究统一图像编辑与T2I生成模型中的条件机制，提出"任务切换"策略：在去噪过程的有限区间内切换到T2I任务，从而提升编辑质量，同时保持较好的感知保留度。
AI.motivation: 统一模型同时针对基于指令的图像编辑和文本到图像（T2I）生成进行训练，但标准编辑流程在整个去噪过程中持续保留源图像条件。作者希望探究编辑任务能否从T2I能力中获益，并研究条件作用在不同编辑类型和去噪阶段的差异。
AI.method: 作者观察到在纯编辑中，部分编辑的源注意力会随采样轨迹下降。基于此提出"任务切换"方法，在有限的去噪区间内让模型切换到T2I任务，从而利用其T2I生成能力。研究在三种统一编辑器和四个基准上进行了验证。
AI.result: 在三种统一编辑器和四个基准上，有限区间内切换到T2I任务可提升编辑质量，同时三种模型的平均感知保留度均接近纯编辑水平。切换的时机决定了质量与保留度之间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 统一编辑器可以从其训练的两种条件模式（编辑条件与T2I生成）中同时获益，任务切换策略有效且切换时机可调控质量与感知保留度的权衡。

title: FedLore: Communication and Memory Efficient Federated Learning via Shared Gradient Low-Rank Projection
summary: Federated training of foundation models is constrained by client memory and communication costs. LoRA-based methods reduce these costs through low-rank adapters, but their fixed rank budget can limit adaptation. Gradient low-rank optimization offers greater flexibility, yet independently chosen client subspaces create a problem we term \emph{subspace fragmentation}: local projections interact with data heterogeneity to bias aggregated directions, while aggregation can increase update rank and communication cost. Thus, accurate local gradient compression need not preserve global descent. We propose \texttt{FedLore}, which shares a low-rank optimization basis within each round and refreshes it across rounds. The shared basis enables exact aggregation in low-rank coordinates and eliminates the identified projection bias. Subspace refresh allows the accumulated model update to exceed the per-round rank budget. We characterize the aggregation bias and establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound for the projected-SGD variant under a global-gradient coverage condition and standard smoothness and variance assumptions, with bounded gradient heterogeneity. Experiments on vision and language tasks, including federated pre-training, show that \texttt{FedLore} outperforms the evaluated low-rank adapter baselines and matches or exceeds full-parameter training, while reducing communication and optimizer-state memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedLore，通过在每轮内共享低秩优化基并在轮间刷新，解决联邦低秩优化中的子空间碎片化问题，实现精确聚合并允许累积更新超出单轮秩预算，理论上给出 O(T^{-1/2}) 平稳性界，实验上优于低秩适配基线并媲美全参数训练。
AI.motivation: 联邦基础模型训练受客户端内存与通信成本限制。基于 LoRA 的方法通过低秩适配器降低开销，但固定秩预算限制了适配能力；梯度低秩优化虽更灵活，但各客户端独立选择子空间会引发“子空间碎片化”：局部投影与数据异构相互作用会偏置聚合方向，且聚合可能提升更新秩与通信成本。因此，准确的局部梯度压缩未必能保证全局下降。
AI.method: 提出 FedLore：在每一轮内共享一个低秩优化基，并在轮间刷新该基。共享基使低秩坐标下的聚合变为精确聚合，从而消除已识别的投影偏置；子空间刷新使累积的模型更新能够超过每轮秩预算。作者刻画了聚合偏置，并在全局梯度覆盖条件、标准光滑性与方差假设以及有界梯度异构下，为投影-SGD 变体建立了 O(T^{-1/2}) 平稳性界。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言任务（含联邦预训练）上的实验表明，FedLore 优于所评估的低秩适配器基线，达到或超过全参数训练的效果，同时减少通信量与优化器状态内存。
AI.conclusion: FedLore 通过轮内共享、轮间刷新的低秩优化基，消除了子空间碎片化带来的投影偏置，兼顾精确聚合与超越单轮秩预算的累积更新能力，并在理论与实验上验证了其有效性与效率优势。

title: Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxiliary parameters. Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks, architectural sampling improves pass@9 over standard-path temperature sampling by 6.58 percentage points on average at the same nine-candidate budget. Reusing early layers yields the strongest gains, and the improvement in candidate coverage persists even under greedy decoding. The resulting candidates show lower lexical overlap and improve accuracy when used as rollouts for label-free test-time reinforcement learning. These findings extend the benefits of our architectural sampling beyond candidate coverage, demonstrating more effective learning from a model's own outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出"架构采样"：通过复用解码器层块，在同一冻结模型内沿不同前向计算路径生成候选，无需训练或额外参数，在相同候选预算下提升pass@9。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展通常依赖对冻结模型进行温度采样来获得多候选，但温度采样让所有候选沿同一条固定的计算路径生成，候选间的计算多样性不足，限制了候选覆盖度与后续利用效果。
AI.method: 免训练的架构采样：复用解码器中选定的层块，通过改变层块的位置与重复次数，使不同候选经历不同的前向计算，从而在不更新权重、不引入辅助参数的前提下注入计算多样性。在5个Qwen检查点、12个多模态基准上评估，并与标准路径温度采样在同等9候选预算下对比。
AI.result: 同等9候选预算下，pass@9平均提升6.58个百分点；复用早期层收益最大；即使贪心解码，候选覆盖度也有提升；候选项间词汇重叠更低，作为无标签测试时强化学习的rollout可提高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 计算路径层面的多样性是温度采样所缺乏的补充信号，架构采样以零训练代价改善候选覆盖，并能提升模型从自身输出中学习的效率，其收益超出单纯的候选覆盖范畴。

title: Measuring the Stability Assumption Behind Action Chunking
summary: Action chunking improves the performance of policies learned by behavioural cloning, and several mechanisms have been proposed to explain why, including temporal consistency, horizon reduction, representation learning, and reduced error compounding. We instead study what happens to an action error once it enters the system. At each state, we inject a small action error and measure how fast it grows or shrinks under two execution regimes: open-loop, where the rest of the chunk is replayed without replanning, and closed-loop, where the policy replans after the perturbation. The fitted rate labels each state as contracting, expanding, or unresolved. Across twelve manipulation tasks from three benchmark suites, we find that confidently stable states are rare, while error amplification is common among states whose propagation rate can be resolved. We further find that the measured propagation rate depends strongly on the fitting horizon: amplification is typically front-loaded, so short windows can overestimate longer-horizon propagation. Finally, we train predictors on these labels and find that a state's open-loop regime can be recovered from camera frames and proprioception alone, while its closed-loop propagation is only partially recoverable because it also depends on how the policy acts after the perturbation. These results suggest that error-compounding arguments alone do not provide a complete account of action chunking: neither passive open-loop dynamics nor policy replanning consistently contracts an injected error, and replanning rarely turns open-loop amplification into confident contraction. This suggests that closed-loop reactivity should be trained explicitly, using perturbation- and tree-coverage-oriented training to expose policies to deviations they must recover from, rather than expected to emerge reliably from standard imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 该文通过注入扰动实验测量动作误差在开环与闭环执行下的传播速率，发现稳定收缩状态罕见、误差放大普遍，且闭环重规划很少能把开环放大转为稳定收缩，据此主张误差复合并非动作分块的全部解释，需显式训练闭环反应性。
AI.motivation: 动作分块（action chunking）能提升行为克隆策略性能，已有解释包括时间一致性、缩短决策时域、表征学习与减少误差复合，但这些机制缺乏对"动作误差进入系统后如何演化"的直接刻画，尤其缺少对开环与闭环两种执行方式的对比验证。
AI.method: 在每个状态注入小幅动作误差，分别在两种执行机制下测量误差的增长或收缩速度：开环（块内剩余动作不重规划直接回放）与闭环（扰动后策略重新规划）。按拟合速率将每个状态标注为收缩、放大或不可判定。在三个基准套件的十二个操作任务上统计标签分布，并考察拟合时域对速率估计的影响；最后用相机图像与本体感知训练预测器来预测这些标签。
AI.result: 在十二个操作任务中，置信的稳定（收缩）状态很少，而误差放大在可解析传播速率的状态中很常见。传播速率对拟合时域高度敏感：放大通常集中在前期，短窗口会高估长时域的传播程度。预测器可从相机帧与本体感知恢复状态的开环机制标签，但闭环传播只能部分恢复，因为它还取决于策略在扰动后的行为方式。
AI.conclusion: 误差复合论证不足以完整解释动作分块的收益：无论是被动的开环动力学还是策略重规划，都不能稳定地收缩注入误差，且重规划很少把开环放大变为稳定的收缩。因此闭环反应性应被显式训练，通过面向扰动与树覆盖（tree-coverage）的训练让策略暴露于必须恢复的偏差，而不应指望其从标准模仿学习中可靠涌现。

title: MEGA: Object-Level Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting via Spatial Visual Distillation
summary: Mesh extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to endow 3D Gaussians with accurate geometric structures, enabling explicit and precise 3D occupancy. However, existing methods primarily focus on scene-level mesh extraction, making them unable to represent object-level occupancy and often resulting in non-watertight surfaces. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textbf{MEGA} (\underline{M}esh \underline{E}xtraction from \underline{GA}ussians), a ``segment-then-mesh'' framework for extracting object-level, watertight meshes from complex 3DGS scenes. At the core of MEGA are \textbf{Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD)} and a mask-guided neural surface reconstruction module. SVD treats the 3DGS model as a teacher, sampling diverse camera poses and rendering the corresponding views of each segmented object. These observations are then used to train a mesh reconstruction model through photometric supervision. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks demonstrate that MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering accurate object-level 3D occupancy. Moreover, MEGA enables complex physical interactions by combining high-quality object-level meshes for geometric occupancy with 3DGS representations for photorealistic rendering.

AI.tldr: 提出MEGA，一个"先分割后网格化"框架，从复杂3DGS场景中提取物体级、水密网格，实现精确物体级3D占用。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS网格提取方法主要针对场景级，无法表示物体级占用，且常产生非水密表面。
AI.method: 核心为空间视觉蒸馏（SVD）与掩码引导的神经表面重建模块。SVD将3DGS模型作为教师，采样多样相机位姿并渲染每个分割物体的对应视图，通过光度监督训练网格重建模型。
AI.result: 在多个广泛使用的基准上，MEGA在恢复准确物体级3D占用方面达到最先进性能；结合高质量物体级网格（几何占用）与3DGS表示（逼真渲染），支持复杂物理交互。
AI.conclusion: MEGA通过"先分割后网格化"范式，弥补了3DGS在物体级、水密网格提取上的不足，兼顾几何精度与渲染真实感。

title: CoEvolve: Construct-to-Edit Visual Grounding with Bidirectional State Refinement
summary: Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box. We introduce CoEvolve, a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic--spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) treats the reasoning text as fixed semantic context and refines the trajectory's coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry- and behavior-level objectives provide target geometry and edit-preference signals for consolidating reliable candidates, preserving accurate inputs, or correcting toward annotations. Evaluations cover natural-image and remote-sensing grounding. With a 9B backbone, CoEvolve rivals models up to 241B parameters in grounding accuracy. Under controlled corruption, a single BDR pass improves mean box overlap by over 27 percentage points, demonstrating strong recovery from substantial localization errors. State-source comparisons further support the complementarity of explicit state construction and source-matched editing. The project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoEvolve 框架，将视觉定位解耦为显式状态构建与状态编辑，通过区域演化强化与双向去噪精炼器提升定位精度与错误恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态定位模型将目标识别、空间推理与边界估计压缩进单一终端预测。自由形式的推理链虽使推理显式化，却未必暴露可度量、可编辑的空间状态，导致中间定位错误难以诊断与纠正，错误区域选择与不精确边界会持续残留于最终框。
AI.method: CoEvolve 将定位拆分为显式的状态构建与状态编辑。Region-Evolution Reinforcement（RER）把定位分析组织为渐进式语义—空间轨迹，每步推理都提交一个显式候选区域；Bidirectional Denoising Refiner（BDR）将推理文本视为固定语义上下文，通过双向同位置重建精炼轨迹的坐标场；并引入几何级与行为级目标，提供目标几何与编辑偏好信号，用于巩固可靠候选、保留准确输入或向标注纠正。
AI.result: 评测涵盖自然图像与遥感定位。以 9B 骨干网络，CoEvolve 的定位精度可比肩多达 241B 参数的模型。在受控损坏条件下，单次 BDR 处理使平均框重叠率提升超过 27 个百分点，显示出对大幅定位错误的强恢复能力。状态来源对比进一步支持显式状态构建与来源匹配编辑的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉定位显式分解为可度量、可编辑的空间状态构建与编辑，能有效诊断并纠正中间定位错误，在较小参数规模下取得强定位性能与鲁棒恢复能力，显式状态构建与来源匹配编辑具有互补性。

title: Rethinking Memorization Mitigation in Diffusion Models: Reinforcing Text Conditioning
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image synthesis, yet can exhibit memorization by closely reproducing individual training examples. Effective mitigation must preserve useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions. We introduce a training-free method that redistributes cross-attention with Gaussian smoothing before reinforcing content-token contributions and attenuating padding contributions, without additional denoiser evaluations. With this intervention, stronger content conditioning can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. A local analysis identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass. On Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.0, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus both prompt alignment and image preference. A configuration selected on Stable Diffusion reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. These findings support jointly controlling conditioning allocation and strength to generate prompt-consistent alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练方法，通过高斯平滑重分配交叉注意力并强化内容Token、削弱填充Token，在不增加去噪器评估的情况下缓解文生图扩散模型的记忆问题，同时保持提示对齐。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型虽在图像合成上取得进展，但会记忆并近乎复现单条训练样本，而有效缓解需保留有用提示信息以引导生成替代性描述。
AI.method: 免训练方法：在强化内容Token贡献、衰减填充贡献之前，对交叉注意力进行高斯平滑重分配，且不增加额外的去噪器评估；并通过局部分析识别强化在何种条件下保留共享value信息、重分配如何降低局部注意力质量。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.4和v2.0上，所有评估的平滑宽度均处于训练图像相似度对提示对齐与图像偏好的经验Pareto前沿上；在Stable Diffusion上选定的配置无需再调参即可减少DeepFloyd IF中的模板复现。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持联合控制条件分配与强度，以生成与提示一致的替代图像。

title: vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning
summary: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出vFedProtoQNAS，通过类级原型共享实现量子联邦学习中的个性化神经架构搜索，避免异构QNN参数聚合导致的操作语义混淆。
AI.motivation: 量子联邦学习中设备能力差异大，单一共享QNN架构难以适配所有客户端；个性化QNAS虽允许各客户端选择设备特定QNN，但结构不同的架构间平均参数会混合语义不一致的电路操作。
AI.method: 不跨客户端聚合模型参数，改为类级原型共享实现联邦协作：各客户端独立搜索并训练自身QNN，从潜在表示计算类级局部原型，并利用服务器全局原型作为联邦语义锚点进行精炼。
AI.result: 实验表明vFedProtoQNAS相比FedAvg准确率提升3.70%，并增强类一致表示对齐。
AI.conclusion: 原型引导的个性化QNAS为异构量子设备上的分布式协作训练提供了避免参数聚合冲突的有效方案。

title: ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection
summary: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATI-VLA，一个以动作为中心的预测式视觉-语言-动作框架，通过"先可操作对齐、后自适应注入"的两步设计解决模态错位与联合优化冲突问题，在仿真与真实机器人任务上取得最优性能并加快收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有预测式VLA模型虽试图通过预测未来观测或世界动态来提升机器人操作能力，但实际效果常不如直接动作预测模型。作者认为其根源在于观测与动作之间的模态错位，以及联合优化冲突使学习偏离以动作为中心的目标。
AI.method: ATI-VLA采用两步设计：1）基于共享码本的可操作表征对齐，将预测观测与动作表征映射到统一的离散隐空间，使预测观测隐变量可直接用于动作生成，缓解模态错位；2）以动作为中心的自适应预测隐变量注入，通过轻量级自适应侧路径将预测观测隐变量作为显式预测先验注入动作解码过程，在单一以动作为中心的目标下实现自适应预测引导。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实机器人任务上的大量实验表明，ATI-VLA达到当前最优性能，且收敛速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享码本对齐观测与动作表征并以自适应侧路径注入预测先验，ATI-VLA在保持以动作为中心优化的同时有效利用了预测信息，验证了该设计对预测式VLA性能提升的有效性。

title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent projection compute as WINA, with the largest gains at high sparsity. Ablations show that both components provide complementary improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练激活稀疏方法TopK-Guided，结合token级稀疏自适应与block级敏感度预算分配，在Llama-2/3上优于TEAL和WINA。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练激活稀疏方法存在权衡：TEAL等阈值法能按token自适应稀疏度但无法严格控制实际稀疏率；WINA等TopK法保证固定稀疏率但对每个token使用相同预算；且二者都在所有transformer block上用同一预算，忽略了block间敏感度差异。因此需要同时解决token级控制与block级分配两个问题。
AI.method: 提出TopK-Guided，一种免训练方法：将受限的token级稀疏自适应与敏感度感知的block级预算分配相结合，兼顾稀疏率的可控性与对block差异的适应。
AI.result: 在Llama-2与Llama-3模型上，TopK-Guided在困惑度和下游准确率上均稳定优于TEAL和WINA，同时保持与WINA基本相同的稀疏度相关投影计算量，高稀疏率下增益最大。消融实验表明两个组件均带来互补提升。
AI.conclusion: TopK-Guided通过融合token级稀疏自适应与block级敏感度预算分配，在不增加投影计算量的前提下，实现更优的困惑度和下游性能，验证了组件互补性与方法的有效性。

title: 3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability
summary: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world. To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision. However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable. We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace. Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics. Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID

AI.tldr: 论文研究了前馈3DGS中外参可靠性与位姿条件的作用，提出标定感知流程将重建场景锚定到机器人度量工作空间，并发布带场景级可靠性信息的可渲染数据集。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作模型主要在2D观测下推理，却需在3D物理世界中行动。近期工作引入深度、点云、3D轨迹等几何先验，可渲染的3D高斯表示（3DGS）是另一有前景的3D监督形式。但3DGS主要面向光度保真设计，在相机外参不可靠时可能不保持真实世界的度量尺度，因此需要研究外参可靠性与位姿条件的影响。
AI.method: 研究外参可靠性与位姿条件对前馈3DGS的影响，提出标定感知（calibration-aware）流程，将重建场景锚定到机器人的度量工作空间；并基于该流程构建数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，位姿条件能提升新视角的保真度，但其几何收益取决于所注入外参的可靠性。基于该流程发布了可渲染、度量位姿锚定、含场景级可靠性信息的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 位姿条件对3DGS新视角保真度有正向作用，但几何精度受外参可靠性制约；所提标定感知流程可实现度量尺度锚定，并产出面向机器人操作研究的带可靠性标注数据集。

title: VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoEvolve 框架，自动进化视频时序定位的 agent harness，在多基准上提升定位性能。
AI.motivation: 针对冻结的视频-语言模型构建的 agent，其 harness 决定了查询如何引导时序预测及预测如何被细化；人工精炼 harness 需诊断定位失败并协同修改 agent 工作流与指令，成本高。
AI.method: VideoEvolve 包含两个核心设计：Cloze-Structured Harness Representation，保留各阶段接口，同时让 agent 工作流与指令开放进化；Branch-Guided Harness Evolution，保留有潜力的代码分支持续细化，利用执行反馈引导局部编辑，并通过验证决定哪些改进被采纳。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得定位性能提升。组件分析表明，指令精炼是稳定增益来源，而进化代码的收益在不同评测设置下存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持自动化 harness 进化是提升视频时序定位的有效途径。代码已开源。

title: FFBL-Coop: Association-Decoupled Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking
comment: 9 pages (main content), 21 pages total including references and appendix; 11 figures; under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Cooperative 3D tracking must integrate complementary observations across agents and time while maintaining consistent identities. When evidence integration and identity inheritance share a matching decision, errors arising from cross-view appearance differences and spatial misalignment can compromise both feature fusion and track continuity. We propose FFBL-Coop, a fuse first, bind later framework that separates instance admission from identity management. Confidence-ranked Slot Admission (CSA) allocates cooperative queries to available ego slots using confidence and spatial proximity. Unified Representation Aggregation (URA) uses cooperative semantic features and aligned anchors to guide ego-feature retrieval, refining the augmented query bank within a shared transformer decoder. After refinement, Cooperative-Priority Identity Anchoring (CPIA) combines learned association with persistent mappings to establish accepted identity assignments across frames. A shared codebook reduces transmitted payload while retaining AP and AMOTA close to the uncompressed variant. FFBL-Coop achieves AMOTA/AP of 0.611/0.548 on V2X-Seq and 0.688/0.653 on Griffin-25M. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FFBL-Coop框架，通过"先融合、后绑定"将实例准入与身份管理解耦，在协同3D跟踪中提升特征融合与轨迹连续性。
AI.motivation: 协同3D跟踪需跨智能体与时序整合互补观测并保持一致身份。当证据融合与身份继承共享匹配决策时，跨视角外观差异与空间错位会同时损害特征融合与轨迹连续性。
AI.method: 提出FFBL-Coop：1）置信度排序槽位准入（CSA）依据置信度与空间邻近为ego槽位分配协同查询；2）统一表示聚合（URA）用协同语义特征与对齐锚点引导ego特征检索，在共享transformer解码器中细化增强查询库；3）协同优先身份锚定（CPIA）结合学习关联与持久映射建立跨帧身份分配；共享码本降低传输负载。
AI.result: 在V2X-Seq上AMOTA/AP为0.611/0.548，在Griffin-25M上为0.688/0.653；共享码本在保持AP与AMOTA接近未压缩版本的同时降低传输负载。
AI.conclusion: 将实例准入与身份管理分离的"先融合、后绑定"范式能有效缓解协同跟踪中的融合与身份继承耦合问题，兼顾精度与通信效率。代码将开源。

title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
summary: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person's record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat ground truth and a question set, each citing the messages it rests on. Every chat label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked stage by stage against the conversation. Three findings follow. First, the past is rarely needed and far away. Pooled measures mislead: a recency window finds the required message for 95.9\% of probes and 2.2\% of those that need memory, and at the natural rate 96\% of the gain from supplying recorded evidence comes from messages that need none. Second, no detector we tried can tell when memory is needed on real messages, authored questions over the same histories leak the cue, and labeling the same messages as memories raises their use by ten to fourteen points. Third, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost.

AI.tldr: 论文发布BENCH基准，包含10段真实的人与AI伴侣关系（27,218条消息，最长120天），以及由其衍生的画像、人设、对话真值与问题集四类文件，每条标签附带可逐阶段核查的推理链。基于该基准得出三项发现：(1)记忆需求稀少且距离远；(2)现有检测器无法判断真实消息是否需要记忆，人工编写的问题会泄漏线索；(3)三种智能体系统以31倍成本差异取得相同的人设重建F1。
AI.motivation: 长期陪伴型AI应记住用户所述、推断其身份，并判断历史是否与当前消息相关。但真实的人类-AI关系记录属于隐私数据，无法公开，因此现有基准只能人工合成人或问题，并预先规定什么内容重要，这偏离了真实分布。作者希望用真实的长期陪伴对话记录来检验长期记忆能力，避免合成基准带来的偏差。
AI.method: 发布BENCH数据集：10段真实的人与AI伴侣关系，共27,218条消息、时间跨度最长120天，以原始对话加四类派生文件（profile画像、persona人设、chat ground truth对话真值、question set问题集）形式发布，每个文件均引用其所依据的消息。每条对话标签都附带生成它的推理链，并对照原始对话进行分阶段核验。在此基础上评测记忆需求检测器与三种智能体系统的人设重建性能。
AI.result: 第一，记忆需求稀少且距离远：合并统计会产生误导——近期窗口可为95.9%的探针找到所需消息，但实际需要记忆的探针仅占2.2%；在自然发生率下，提供历史证据所带来的收益中96%来自本就不需要记忆的消息。第二，在所尝试的检测器中，没有一个能判断真实消息是否需要记忆；而基于相同历史编写的问题会泄漏这一线索；将相同消息标注为记忆后，其使用率提升10至14个百分点。第三，三种智能体系统以相差31倍的成本取得相同的人设重建F1。
AI.conclusion: 现有长期记忆评测范式存在系统性缺陷：合成问题泄漏线索、合并指标掩盖真实分布、记忆需求检测器在真实消息上失效。真实场景中需要记忆的情形既稀少又久远，而大幅提高成本并不能换来人设重建质量的提升。BENCH通过真实关系数据与可核验的推理链，为长期陪伴记忆评测提供了更贴近实际的基准。

title: Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. 39 pages
summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU introduces Chain-of- Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP), which unrolls an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments. By propagating structured rationales over time, the model maintains implicit temporal memory, enabling robust discrimination between com- plex anomalies and high-motion normal activities. To improve reliability, we further design a cross-modal re-ranking stage that aligns textual rationales with visual embeddings, enforcing semantic consistency and temporal coherence for refined and stable predictions. Extensive experiments on multiple public VAD benchmarks demonstrate that Cog-VADU achieves competitive zero-shot performance. Moreover, cross-model evaluations show that CoADTP consistently enhances reasoning-based anomaly detection in a model-agnostic manner, pro- viding interpretable and generalizable anomaly understanding for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cog-VADU，一个完全免训练的视频异常检测框架，将VAD重构为序列化认知推理任务，通过链式异常检测思维提示（CoADTP）和跨模态重排序实现零样本异常定位。
AI.motivation: 现有VAD方法依赖特定数据集训练和人工标注，泛化性受限；近期基于LVLM的零样本方法虽缓解了该依赖，但缺乏时间连续性和结构化推理能力。
AI.method: 提出Cog-VADU：1）Chain-of-Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting（CoADTP），将LVLM展开为跨视频片段的递归推理链，通过随时间传播结构化推理依据维持隐式时间记忆；2）跨模态重排序阶段，对齐文本推理依据与视觉嵌入，保证语义一致性和时间连贯性以精炼预测。整个框架无需训练。
AI.result: 在多个公开VAD基准上取得有竞争力的零样本性能；跨模型评估显示CoADTP能以模型无关方式持续提升基于推理的异常检测。
AI.conclusion: Cog-VADU为真实应用提供了可解释、可泛化的异常理解能力，验证了结构化推理与跨模态对齐在零样本VAD中的有效性。

title: Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Quasar——首个在无非终端极大端分量(MEC-free)MDP片段上具有渐近保证的无模型强化学习算法，用于可达性(reachability)规约，避免了显式估计转移概率，将内存从O(|S|²|A|)降至O(|S||A|)，并在标准基准上以数量级更少的样本收敛到最优策略。
AI.motivation: 可达性规约在序贯决策中极为基础，但已有工作仅通过基于模型的方法（必须显式估计MDP转移概率）实现最优策略的渐近收敛，模型依赖导致计算与内存开销大，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出Quasar算法，采用经典Q-learning框架，利用时序差分(temporal-difference)更新直接学习最优策略，无需学习转移概率。理论保证针对无非终端极大端分量(non-terminal MEC-free)的MDP片段——任何MDP经标准MEC商缩都可归约到该片段，从而为一般MDP提供构建基石。
AI.result: 内存占用由基于模型方法的O(|S|²|A|)降至O(|S||A|)；在标准化定量验证基准集(Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set)上，相较此前基于模型的最优方法，收敛到最优策略所需样本数少数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Quasar是首个针对可达性、具有渐近保证的无模型算法，是迈向可达性学习实际部署以及规格引导强化学习(specification-guided RL)落地的重要一步。

title: GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking
summary: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种合成到真实（Syn2Real）泛化的类别级物体位姿估计方法，通过2D/3D语义一致性约束与端到端位姿回归，仅用合成数据训练即可在真实场景泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有类别级位姿估计（COPE）方法在面向新类别时仍需耗费大量人力采集真实训练数据，可扩展性差。作者希望实现仅用渲染合成数据训练、直接泛化到真实部署（Syn2Real）的COPE。核心难点在于合成与真实数据之间存在显著域差，尤其是纹理外观差异。
AI.method: 1）引入2D与3D语义一致性约束，促使特征编码器学习域不变表示、捕捉同类别物体的语义共性，降低对域特有特征的敏感度；2）提出端到端位姿回归框架，进行2D-3D跨一致性学习，利用密集跨模态融合进一步精化位姿；3）模型仅基于全局特征运行，架构轻量高效，便于真实机器人部署。
AI.result: 在REAL275和Wild6D基准以及真实机器人操作场景上的大量实验表明，该范式具有优越的Syn2Real泛化性能。代码与演示已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义一致性约束与跨模态一致性学习实现域不变表示，可在仅用合成数据训练的条件下取得良好的真实场景泛化，且轻量高效，适合实际机器人应用。

title: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
summary: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer-consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 自改进GUI智能体将轨迹用于微调（写入权重）或检索（写入上下文）时结论不一致，根源在于"经验单元"混淆；论文提出按组件路由：定位符与经验教训入权重、流程与状态事实入上下文，并用训练前可测的"复现性/状态条件性"规则预测目的地。
AI.motivation: 现有自改进GUI智能体把轨迹回灌给智能体，但微调与检索两种去向的比较研究结论互相矛盾。作者认为矛盾源于"经验单元"划分不当：一条轨迹捆绑了性质不同的条目，因此对整束轨迹的结论取决于其内部配比，无法得出稳定结论。
AI.method: (i) 提出组件路由（component routing）：将经验拆分为定位符（locators）、流程（procedures）、状态事实（state facts）与经验教训（lessons），在同一批条目上跨三个骨干模型家族、两个环境、三个随机种子比较"入上下文"与"入权重"两种去向。(ii) 用训练前测得的两个属性——复现性（recurrence）与状态条件性（state-conditionality）——拟合一条规则来预测目的地，并进行两项干预实验检验边界，同时与整条轨迹基线和各骨干最佳单一目的地比较。(iii) 分析训练与生产者—消费者差异如何改变两种去向的价值。
AI.result: 单个经验池具有两种目的地：定位符与经验教训在权重中更优，流程与状态事实在上下文中更优。规则在留出的骨干家族上24/24格全部命中目的地；两项干预可将组件推向边界；按规则路由优于所有整条轨迹基线，并比各骨干的最佳单一目的地平均高出3.5个点。此外，同一组件写入权重后其读出（note readout）下降，复现性最高的条目下降最多；上下文增益随信息差距增大而增加；权重增益随策略差距增大而减小。
AI.conclusion: 结论是自改进GUI智能体的经验不应按整条轨迹笼统路由，而应按组件分别送入上下文或权重；目的地在训练前即可由复现性与状态条件性预测，且路由效果稳定优于整条轨迹基线和单一目的地基线。代码与数据将公开。

title: PhysDEM: Physics-Defined Energy-Matching Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Field Generation under Scarce Measurements
summary: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM, a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.

AI.tldr: PhysDEM是一个物理定义的扩散框架，结合控制方程与稀疏观测生成多组合理的时空物理场，首次实现无需预组装全场数据集的摊销式时空场推断。
