AI.motivation: 从稀疏测量生成和预测时空物理场很困难，因为观测不足以刻画完整场的分布，这限制了依赖全场数据的传统数据驱动扩散模型。
AI.method: 首先，通过用PDE残差能量对测量条件高斯参考进行重加权，构造Gibbs目标分布；其次，推导精确的条件均值恒等式，将去噪简化为对标准化能量诱导均值修正的监督学习；最后，引入物理位移概率流，抵消高斯参考项，并通过高斯条件化实现随测量变化的摊销采样，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在合成PDE系统和真实世界启发的应用上的实验表明，PhysDEM支持连贯的场恢复和高效采样，同时在测试噪声水平下保持稳定的诊断性能。
AI.conclusion: PhysDEM是首个无需预组装全场数据集即可实现摊销式时空场推断的物理定义扩散模型，展示了其在物理场评估中的实用价值。

title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification
summary: Time series captioning is a fundamental step in time series understanding and can also serve as the bridge between signal and natural language. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies on a larger model's captions and cannot exceed their quality. Reinforcement learning (RL) can, but its rewards were designed for other modalities and other tasks, and they transfer poorly to open-ended generation in the time series domain. We address this by proposing LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline whose reward is caption-to-series identification. The reward model is a frozen large language model (LLM) verifier that reads the generated caption and the candidate time series as raw values, never the chart, and must pick the described time series from multiple distractors. Matching is a far lighter demand on the verifier than writing questions or judging a caption, so an off-the-shelf LLM can supply the reward. Across two captioning benchmarks, and on forecasting and reconstruction where the predictor sees only the caption, LineupRL outperforms SFT and RL baselines on every metric. The 3B vision language model (VLM) trained by LineupRL also outperforms, at 1/24 of the parameters, the 72B VLM whose captions the SFT baseline is distilled from. Our case study shows that LineupRL resists reward hacking, and that the captioner it trains both traces the trend and names the values at key points.

AI.tldr: 提出LineupRL：用"描述→序列识别"作为可验证奖励的RLVR流水线，训练时间序列描述模型，在多项任务上超越SFT与RL基线。
AI.motivation: 时间序列描述（captioning）是连接信号与自然语言的关键环节。SFT依赖更大模型的描述，质量存在上限；RL虽可突破，但其奖励机制是为其他模态和任务设计的，迁移到时间序列开放生成任务上效果差。
AI.method: LineupRL采用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）流程，奖励定义为"描述到序列的识别"任务：冻结的LLM验证器仅读取生成的描述与候选时间序列的原始数值（不看图表），需从多个干扰项中选出被描述的那条序列。相比写题或评判描述，匹配对验证器的要求更低，因此可直接使用现成LLM作为奖励模型。
AI.result: 在两个描述基准，以及预测和重建任务（预测器仅看到描述）上，LineupRL在所有指标上均优于SFT和RL基线。经LineupRL训练的3B VLM以1/24的参数规模，超过了SFT基线所蒸馏的72B VLM。
AI.conclusion: LineupRL能抵抗奖励攻击（reward hacking）；其训练出的描述器既能刻画趋势，也能指出关键点的具体数值。

title: OneStreamer: Unifying Perception, Memory, and Proactive Response in Streaming Video Interaction
comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://mcg-nju.github.io/OneStreamer
summary: Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available. The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception. We introduce OneStreamer, which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process. Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events. Streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes during training. At inference, model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing reusable factual context without revisiting historical visual features. Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) reduces the dominance of repeated waiting states by preserving supervision at all output anchors and selecting representative state-change and state-persistence tokens. We further develop a streaming data synthesis pipeline that aligns output content and timing with available evidence. Combining the resulting streaming captions and QA with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M, a broad-coverage streaming video interaction dataset with over one million records spanning diverse tasks. Our 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight evaluated streaming video understanding benchmarks. Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception. PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens. Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared learning interface connecting perception, memory formation, and timely response in streaming video interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 OneStreamer，通过共享的主动生成过程统一查询无关的证据记录与任务响应，在流式视频理解中兼顾可复用记忆与实时感知，4B 模型在八个基准上均最优。
AI.motivation: 流式视频 LLM 需在相关性未知时保留证据并在证据充分时及时响应，核心难点在于构建可复用的客观事实记忆而不损害实时感知。
AI.method: 提出 OneStreamer：1) Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) 生成带时间锚点的局部细节字幕与已完成事件摘要，以流式字幕目标监督训练；推理时模型生成记录补充近期视觉窗口，避免回看历史视觉特征。2) Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) 在所有输出锚点保留监督并挑选代表性状态变化/持续 token，缓解重复等待状态的主导。3) 构建流式数据合成流水线对齐内容与时机，结合流式字幕与 QA 及清洗开源数据形成 OneStreamer-1M 数据集。
AI.result: 4B 模型在全部八个流式视频理解基准上优于对比方法；消融显示保留生成字幕可提升历史 QA 且不降低实时感知；PSTL 仅监督 27.5% 的状态 token 即优于稠密状态监督。
AI.conclusion: 主动生成可作为连接感知、记忆形成与及时响应的共享学习接口，支撑流式视频交互。

title: AI-assisted mitotic counting improves reproducibility and efficiency across multiple tumour types
summary: Mitotic counting is an important component of tumour grading, diagnosis and prognostic assessment across several tumour types, but manual assessment is time-consuming and subject to inter-pathologist variability. To help address these challenges, we developed MitPro, an AI tool designed to improve consistency and efficiency by directing pathologists towards regions with the highest predicted mitotic activity and highlighting mitotic figures for review, while retaining pathologist control over region selection and the final count. We evaluated its effect on the reproducibility and efficiency of mitotic counting in a retrospective, non-interventional, paired reader study comprising 385 whole-slide images from 3 centres in 3 countries and 7 tumour types using 3 different scanners. 13 pathologists participated, with each slide assessed independently by 3 pathologists without AI assistance and again with AI assistance after a minimum 2 week washout period. Across all slides, AI-assisted counting increased the intraclass correlation coefficient from 0.589 to 0.949. Mean pathologist-level median assessment time decreased from 286.4 to 127.8 seconds, corresponding to an average saving of 151.8 seconds per assessment. Improvements in agreement and efficiency were also observed in supporting analyses using HALO AP and Sectra image management systems and in 2 additional tumour types outside the main study population. AI-assisted assessment was associated with a subtle shift towards higher mitotic counts and scores, consistent with identification of more active mitotic hotspots and fewer missed mitotic figures. The frequency of score change between unassisted and AI-assisted assessment was comparable with inter-pathologist variation during routine counting. These findings support the use of MitPro as an assistive tool for more consistent and efficient mitotic assessment in routine practice.

AI.tldr: MitPro是一款AI辅助有丝分裂计数工具，在385张全切片图像、13位病理学家的配对阅读研究中，将其组内相关系数从0.589提升至0.949，并将平均评估时间从286.4秒降至127.8秒。
AI.motivation: 有丝分裂计数是肿瘤分级、诊断和预后评估的重要环节，但人工评估耗时长且存在病理学家间变异，因此需要工具提升一致性与效率。
AI.method: 开发MitPro：引导病理学家关注预测有丝分裂活性最高的区域并高亮有丝分裂象，同时保留病理学家对区域选择和最终计数的控制。采用回顾性、非干预性配对阅读研究，纳入3国3中心、7种肿瘤类型、3种扫描仪的385张全切片图像，13位病理学家参与，每张切片由3位病理学家分别独立在无AI与有AI辅助下评估，洗脱期至少2周。
AI.result: AI辅助使组内相关系数由0.589升至0.949；病理学家层面中位评估时间由286.4秒降至127.8秒，平均每次评估节省151.8秒。在HALO AP与Sectra图像管理系统及2种额外肿瘤类型的支持性分析中亦观察到一致性与效率提升。AI辅助与更高的有丝分裂计数和评分略有偏移相关，符合识别更活跃热点和减少漏检。评分变化频率与常规计数中病理学家间变异相当。
AI.conclusion: MitPro可作为辅助工具，在常规实践中实现更一致、更高效的有丝分裂评估。

title: GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design
summary: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench, a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets. Training representative localizers on GIFTBench consistently improves their aggregate transfer to external datasets, showing that the benchmark serves not only as an evaluation tool but also as an effective training resource for cross-domain localization. Guided by the diagnostic findings, we further develop ForenScope, a detection and localization framework combining classification-adapted representations with multi-depth, multi-scale spatial features, learned layer fusion, and selective coarse-scale conditioning. Experiments show improved cross-dataset localization while retaining image-level detection capability. The GIFTBench dataset showcase page is available at https://giftbench-preview.doudoudouya337.chatgpt.site.

AI.tldr: 提出多轴基准 GIFTBench（115,013 张篡改图，像素级标注，覆盖篡改来源、语义目标、编辑操作、合成复杂度四个维度），支持轴向迁移分析与 12 个外部数据集评测；诊断出非对称跨源迁移、召回主导的失败与异构退化；该基准同时可作为训练资源提升跨域定位性能；据此提出 ForenScope 框架，在保持图像级检测能力的同时改善跨数据集定位。
AI.motivation: 现有图像篡改定位（IFL）基准覆盖的篡改条件有限，或在跨数据集评测中把多个因素纠缠在一起，导致聚合性能无法完整反映定位模型的泛化能力；因此需要能够在受控条件下分离并诊断不同分布变化的评测体系。
AI.method: 构建多轴基准 GIFTBench：115,013 张带像素级标注的篡改图像，按篡改来源、语义目标、编辑操作、合成复杂度四轴组织，支持轴向特定迁移分析与 12 个外部数据集评测；基于诊断结论设计 ForenScope 框架，融合分类适配表征与多深度、多尺度空间特征，采用可学习层融合与选择性粗尺度条件调制。
AI.result: 诊断研究揭示三类现象：跨源迁移呈非对称性、失败以召回不足为主导、语义/操作/合成变化下的性能退化呈异构模式。使用 GIFTBench 训练代表性定位器可一致提升其对外部数据集的聚合迁移性能。ForenScope 在实验中改善了跨数据集定位效果，并保留图像级检测能力。
AI.conclusion: GIFTBench 兼具评测与训练资源双重价值：既能细粒度诊断 IFL 泛化瓶颈，又能通过更广的训练分布提升跨域定位；在其诊断结论指导下设计的 ForenScope 验证了"诊断驱动设计"的有效性，为后续跨域篡改定位研究提供了可复用基准与方法参考。

title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills
comment: Accepted to Workshop on Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool selection, arguments, execution order, and database integrity through programmatic checks and a narrowly scoped LLM judge. We evaluate 240 trials across two skills, two specification variants, two agent harnesses, and three models. Of 175 trials passing all applicable final numerical checks, 162 (92.6 percent; Wilson 95 percent CI: 87.7-95.6 percent) contained another evaluator-detected deviation. Under a broader seven-check final-state definition, 151 of 164 passing runs (92.1 percent; 95 percent CI: 86.9-95.3 percent) still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution reduced a mean of 6.34 failed checks per run to 2.65 roots. Specification sensitivity varied by model and harness, with exploratory bootstrap interaction intervals excluding zero for all three Revenue comparisons and one of three Productivity comparisons. Runtime-resolved templates provided reusable regression coverage across the evaluated configurations; longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合结果层与过程层检查的企业AI智能体持续评估框架，发现仅靠最终输出评估会严重遗漏过程层面的行为漂移。
AI.motivation: 企业AI智能体的技能会随工具API、模型和规范变化而演化，而仅评估最终输出可能遗漏过程层面的行为漂移，因此需要一种同时覆盖结果与过程层面的持续评估方法。
AI.method: 框架独立计算每次运行的真值，物化可复用模板测试，并通过程序化检查与范围受控的LLM评判器评估工具选择、参数、执行顺序与数据库完整性。作者在企业价值感知韧性系统中，针对业务价值判定技能的营收与生产力两个变体，跨两种技能、两种规范变体、两种智能体运行框架和三个模型共进行240次试验。
AI.result: 在175次通过所有适用最终数值检查的试验中，162次（92.6%，Wilson 95%置信区间87.7-95.6%）仍存在其他评估器检测到的偏差；在更宽的七项检查最终状态定义下，164次通过运行中仍有151次（92.1%，95%置信区间86.9-95.3%）违反轨迹检查。依赖归因将平均每次运行6.34项失败检查缩减为2.65个根因。规范敏感性因模型与运行框架而异，探索性自助法交互区间在三个营收比较和一个生产力比较中排除零。
AI.conclusion: 运行时解析的模板提供了跨评估配置可复用的回归覆盖，表明过程层评估对捕捉智能体行为漂移至关重要；在实际API演化下的纵向验证仍属未来工作。

title: VETO: Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision Language Models
summary: Processing long videos with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of visual tokens, making long-form inference prohibitively expensive. While single-axis compression methods mitigate this, they hit a hard efficiency floor because they treat spatial and temporal redundancy independently. We present VETO (Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision-Language Models), a training-optional plug-in that eliminates this bottleneck through dual-axis compression: (i) an intra-frame compressor that merges semantically similar tokens within each frame via optimal-transport inspired matching, and (ii) an inter-frame compressor that identifies and merges temporally redundant frames. The key design insight is hierarchical ordering: by first compressing spatial dimensions, VETO drastically reduces the cost of subsequent global temporal matching, bypassing the efficiency wall of single-axis approaches, with an advantage that grows with modern fully-fused attention infrastructure. Empirically, VETO achieves up to 45% faster inference (e.g., on LLaVA-OneVision-7B) while preserving or improving accuracy. Under extreme token starvation (10% budget), VETO outperforms VFlowOpt (54.9%), VisionZip (52.6%), and FastV (47.9%) with 55.7% accuracy. We demonstrate universal applicability across LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL-2.5, and LongVA, with zero-shot accuracy preserved or improved in all cases.

AI.tldr: VETO是面向视觉语言模型长视频处理的双轴（帧内+帧间）token压缩即插即用方法，通过分层压缩顺序突破单轴压缩的效率瓶颈，实现最高45%推理加速且保持或提升精度。
AI.motivation: 长视频输入视觉语言模型的可视token开销随长度呈二次增长，导致长时推理成本极高。现有单轴压缩方法仅单独处理空间或时间冗余，无法协同利用二者，因而遭遇效率下限（效率墙），亟需能同时压缩空间与时间冗余的高效方案。
AI.method: VETO为训练可选（training-optional）的插件式方法，采用双轴压缩：(1) 帧内压缩器基于最优传输（optimal transport）启发的匹配，合并单帧内语义相近的token；(2) 帧间压缩器识别并合并时间上冗余的帧。关键设计是分层顺序：先压缩空间维度，大幅降低后续全局时间匹配的开销，从而绕过单轴方法的效率墙，该优势在现代全融合注意力（fully-fused attention）基础设施下进一步放大。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上推理速度最高提升45%，精度保持或提升；在极端token预算（10%）下，VETO以55.7%准确率优于VFlowOpt（54.9%）、VisionZip（52.6%）和FastV（47.9%）；在LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL-2.5、LongVA上均验证了通用性，零样本精度全部保持或提升。
AI.conclusion: 双轴分层压缩可有效打破单轴压缩的效率瓶颈，在显著加速长视频VLM推理的同时保持甚至提升精度，且具备跨模型的普适性与插件式易用性。

title: Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation
comment: 10 pages main text, 20 pages total with appendix; 6 figures, 7 tables. Preprint
summary: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试了判断模型（如JEV）作为决策层的能力边界：它擅长"评估"（从已描述的信息中判断选项），但在需要"模拟"（预测输入中未给出的信息，如对手行动或前置子目标）时失败；将模拟交给代码后，JEV可成为专家级控制器。
AI.motivation: 判断模型单次调用、无需推理文本即可为每个选项输出概率，适合作为智能体的动作选择层，但其可被信任的决策范围尚不明确，因此需要系统性地界定其能力边界。
AI.method: 在反思测试（CRT）、单次矩阵博弈、文本游戏ALFWorld和机器人控制四类任务上测试JEV；并设计对照实验，将模拟与评估分离（单独询问模型对手行动、或在给定行动后让其判断），以及用代码提供前瞻或物理模拟。
AI.result: JEV在可凭输入直接判断的"评估"情形下表现优异，解决99%的反直觉CRT问题；但在需要"模拟"的情形下失败：博弈中把理性对手当作随机行动而次优，ALFWorld中优先选择提及任务对象的命令（如直接把未洗的刀放入抽屉而不先去水槽清洗）。这些失败并非知识缺失——单独询问对手行动时它通常回答正确，给定对手行动后也能良好响应；失败源于单次调用同时进行模拟与评估。当代码提供前瞻（ALFWorld）和物理模拟（机器人控制）后，JEV凭借其通用评估能力成为专家级控制器。
AI.conclusion: 判断模型的可靠边界在于"评估"而非"模拟"：单次调用中难以同时完成模拟与评估。应将预测/模拟交由代码完成，模型专注评估，从而在ALFWorld和机器人控制中达到专家级控制水平。

title: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
comment: Presented at IROS WORLDS Workshop 2026. Four main pages double-column format plus references and appendices
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.

AI.tldr: 该文验证了VLA模型除语言外还可利用其他模态进行任务条件化：提出肌电条件化模型EC-VLA与视觉标注条件化模型VA-VLA，在杂乱、分布外场景中显著优于语言提示基线。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽具多模态输入，却严重依赖语言描述任务信息；作者假设状态空间中其他模态可提供补充性任务条件，尤其在杂乱或存在歧义的场景中可能更有用。
AI.method: 构建两个微调模型：(1) EC-VLA，将8通道肌电包络作为连续条件输入，与本体感受向量拼接；(2) VA-VLA，将视觉分割标注加入图像输入。在三名参与者上执行方块选择任务，与语言提示基线对比。
AI.result: EC-VLA在非杂乱、分布内条件下与语言提示基线持平，在杂乱、分布外场景中大幅优于基线；VA-VLA在分布内场景有小幅提升，在杂乱、分布外试验中提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果有力表明，超出语言的任务条件化（如生理信号与视觉标注）对VLA模型具有潜在收益，尤其在杂乱和分布外场景中。

title: On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models
summary: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间序列世界模型（TSWM）的形式化框架与基准，引入机制一致性指标，发现预测误差与机制一致性存在背离，并给出兼顾精度与一致性的设计配方。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型以动作为协变量，仅在已执行计划下按预测误差训练和评估，却忽视了世界模型的核心用途——比较未执行的计划；因此其响应计划变更的能力未经检验，需要明确哪些设计选择真正关键，以及高精度预测器是否能像真实系统一样响应计划变更。
AI.method: 提出形式化框架，区分状态、动作与外生输入，区分连续动作、模式动作与事件动作；引入机制一致性（mechanism consistency）指标，依据已知方向的声明式动作—状态关系（如升压药升高血压），检验动作偏移是否使预测朝声明方向移动。构建基准，整合八个来自工程基础设施与临床护理、含真实动作的公开数据集，在七种骨干网络和五个随机种子上变化预测空间、计划融合与计划编码。此外提出方向性监督（directional supervision）损失，惩罚对动作偏移响应中符号错误的部分。
AI.result: 第一，冻结的潜在预测空间相比观测空间平均降低MAE 9.9%，门控输出融合相比输入拼接平均降低12.7%，且两者在全部八个数据集上均有改善；时间计划编码对平均MAE的影响至多2.2%。第二，预测误差与机制一致性出现背离：误差最低的配置在五个含声明机制数据集中的四个上，一致性处于或低于随机水平，且没有任何设计选择能避免这一点。第三，方向性监督在有惩罚机制上显著提高一致性，同时MAE不变。
AI.conclusion: TSWM应遵循的配方是：以冻结潜在空间与输出端融合保证精度，以训练目标（方向性监督）保证机制一致性；预测精度高并不意味着对计划变更的响应机制正确，二者需分别设计与评估。

title: PhaseAT: Fourier Phase Adversarial Training for Medical Image Domain Generalization
comment: The paper is accepted in MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable clinical deployment of deep medical image models is hindered by distribution shifts across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols. Existing domain generalization (DG) methods often focus on style or intensity diversification, but they can still leave networks dependent on domain-specific texture correlations. Inspired by evidence that Fourier phase encodes semantic structure, we introduce PhaseAT, a phase-aware adversarial training framework for medical DG. PhaseAT forms phase-perturbed training views in the Fourier domain by iteratively updating a bounded phase perturbation while keeping the amplitude spectrum unchanged, thereby stressing spatial organization under matched appearance statistics. Perturbations are applied only to the luminance channel in YCbCr color space to avoid chromatic artifacts. Additionally, a simple phase-saliency mask concentrates updates on the most influential frequencies. The model is trained with a weighted combination of losses on clean and phase-perturbed samples, supporting both single-source and multi-source DG. We validate our method on two challenging medical datasets and demonstrate that PhaseAT achieves over 20% improvement in single-source domain generalization, outperforming several state-of-the-art DG methods. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT.

AI.tldr: 提出PhaseAT，一种在傅里叶相位域施加对抗扰动的医学图像域泛化框架，通过保留幅度谱、仅扰动亮度通道相位的对抗训练，迫使模型摆脱域相关纹理依赖，在单源与多源域泛化任务上取得显著提升（单源场景超20%）。
AI.motivation: 深度医学图像模型在跨扫描仪、跨机构、跨采集协议部署时受分布偏移影响，可靠性不足。现有域泛化方法多聚焦风格或强度多样化，但网络仍可能依赖域特有的纹理相关性，泛化能力受限。受傅里叶相位编码语义结构这一证据启发，作者希望在保持外观统计一致的条件下强化对空间组织（语义结构）的学习。
AI.method: PhaseAT为相位感知对抗训练框架。在傅里叶域中，固定幅度谱不变，迭代更新有界相位扰动，构造相位扰动的训练视图；扰动仅施加于YCbCr颜色空间的亮度通道，以避免色度伪影；引入简单的相位显著性掩码，将更新集中在最具影响力的频率上。训练时采用干净样本与相位扰动样本上的加权损失组合，支持单源与多源域泛化。
AI.result: 在两个具挑战性的医学数据集上验证，PhaseAT在单源域泛化中取得超过20%的提升，优于多种当前最先进的域泛化方法。代码已开源（https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT）。
AI.conclusion: 通过在傅里叶相位域进行有界对抗扰动并保持外观统计匹配，PhaseAT有效降低模型对域特有纹理的依赖，强化语义结构学习，是一种简洁且有效的医学域泛化方案；消融与开源实现进一步支持其可复现性与实用性。

title: Temporal-Difference Learning for Dragonchess
comment: Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD(lambda), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

AI.tldr: 本研究将Dragonchess引擎从PyGame重写为C++，并在1万局带置信区间与显著性检验的循环赛中对比进化迁移学习与TD(λ)两种自适应启发式评估方法，发现二者均优于其他智能体，且彼此性能无显著差异。
AI.motivation: Dragonchess具有独特棋盘结构与极高计算负载，是研究自适应方法在陌生复杂环境中更新评估启发式的理想平台；原PyGame实现效率低，仅能支撑单次小规模锦标赛，难以获得统计上可靠的结论。
AI.method: 将Dragonchess引擎由PyGame重新实现为C++以加速对局；采用进化迁移学习与TD(λ)两种自适应方法更新评估启发式；开展1万局循环赛，并引入置信区间与显著性检验进行统计分析。
AI.result: 两种自适应方法在循环赛中均优于所有其他智能体；进化得到的评估与学习得到的评估在性能上无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了自适应方法在结构复杂、新颖的博弈领域中的有效性，并为进化式与学习式评估在该类环境中的等效性提供了实证支持。

title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/

AI.tldr: LiteReality-Agent 将室内 3D 重建建模为编码任务，通过编码智能体迭代编辑 Python 脚本 Room.py，并结合 observe-edit-verify 流程，从 RGB-D 扫描生成真实、可关节化、可仿真的 3D 场景。
AI.motivation: 为真实室内环境构建高质量、可用于仿真与具身 AI 下游任务的 3D 数字孪生是一项重要但困难的任务，现有前沿模型（如 Astra、Fable）在几何精度、视觉真实感和仿真兼容性上仍不足。
AI.method: 提出 LiteReality-Agent 智能体系统，把 3D 重建形式化为编码问题：编码智能体使用专用工具收集证据，迭代编辑可执行的 Python 脚本 Room.py 以生成房间 3D 数字孪生；并设计 observe-edit-verify 机制，覆盖证据收集、测量、验证、布局优化、仿真就绪与质量控制。同时将其定位为面向未来智能体的编排框架，提供专用工具、结构化工作流和稳健验证机制。
AI.result: LiteReality-Agent 生成的 3D 重建在几何精度、视觉真实感和仿真兼容性方面优于近期前沿模型 Astra 和 Fable，适用于仿真及下游具身 AI 任务。
AI.conclusion: LiteReality-Agent 是稳健 real-to-sim 系统的实用且重要的构建模块；随着智能体能力提升，该系统的编排框架仍将持续有效。源代码与数据采集应用已公开。

title: AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes
summary: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AVSD-Scenes，一个面向城市环境的配对音视频场景描述数据集，包含 12,291 条描述，并通过多种基准任务验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 自然语言可为音视频城市场景提供丰富语义表示，但联合描述听觉与视觉信息的数据集仍然稀缺，因此需要构建配对音视频场景描述数据集并评估其质量。
AI.method: 基于 TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes 数据集，先用 Qwen2-Audio-7B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 分别生成音频与视觉描述，再用 Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 和 Gemma-3-27B-it 等大语言模型融合为多模态描述；随后采用语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge 及人工主观评估进行基准测试。
AI.result: 多模态描述在语义对齐和跨模态检索上优于单模态描述，同时保留较强场景判别信息；生成描述在城市场景分类中最高达 94.5% 准确率，融合音频、视觉与描述嵌入后提升至 95.4%；移除提示中的场景标签后仍具高度判别性。
AI.conclusion: AVSD-Scenes 能有效提供配对音视频场景描述，多模态描述兼具互补语义与场景判别力，并反映音视频内容本身的语义信息而非仅依赖标签。

title: From Pixels to Policy: A Multi-Agent System for Intervention and Geo-Spatial Decision Support
summary: Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical. Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators. Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image. We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses. We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies. We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery. Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2X higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"干预发现"新问题，并构建多智能体系统VIDA-Geo，通过分割、扩散修复与指标评分的协同，在航拍与街景图像上生成既真实又符合政策的城市干预方案。
AI.motivation: 城市设计决策对健康、安全与生活质量具有长期影响，但评估拟议干预成本高、耗时长且常不切实际。现有地理空间视觉方法多侧重于从航拍与街景图像中监测城市指标，而非提出干预并估计其对指标的影响，因此需要新的问题设定与方法。
AI.method: 作者提出"干预发现"问题：针对给定航拍或街景图像，寻找能改善目标指标的干预方案。核心思路是将黑盒指标模型与生成式编辑模型结合，作为隐式数字孪生以检验干预假设。具体实现为多智能体系统VIDA-Geo，协调分割、基于扩散的图像修复与指标评分模型，探索干预空间，生成感知真实且符合现实政策的干预方案。
AI.result: 在航拍与街景图像上针对8项指标（如感知安全性与绿化度等变化）进行评估，该方法在多数情况下优于现有基线，感知质量与政策对齐分数最高提升2倍。此外，模型可提供多个候选干预方案。
AI.conclusion: VIDA-Geo验证了以生成式编辑加黑盒指标模型作为隐式数字孪生来测试城市干预假设的可行性，并提供多候选方案以支持"专家城市规划师在环"的工作流程。

title: Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores broader challenges and capabilities that extend beyond these foundational designs. This survey provides a consolidated and structured examination of contemporary RAG developments, organizing the field into a four axis taxonomy: improving retrieval efficiency, strengthening robustness and security, supporting user driven and interactive workflows, and enabling multi step or complex reasoning. We formalize key components of the RAG framework and review methods spanning dense and sparse retrieval, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies, highlighting how these advances influence practical deployment and system design. We also synthesize evaluation practices, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naive, Advanced, and Modular RAG. Finally, we outline persistent challenges related to retrieval quality, reliability, domain adaptation, scalability, and explainability, and identify opportunities for building RAG systems that are more reliable, adaptable, and transparent.

AI.tldr: 本文综述当代检索增强生成（RAG）研究进展，提出四轴分类法，梳理关键组件、评估实践、领域应用与架构变体，并指出检索质量、可靠性、领域适配、可扩展性与可解释性等挑战及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）受限于静态参数化知识，易产生幻觉。RAG通过引入外部检索，将生成结果锚定在可验证、最新的来源上，从而缓解上述问题。既有综述多聚焦核心架构与标准流程，缺少对近期更广泛挑战与能力的系统梳理，本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用结构化综述方法：构建四轴分类法（提升检索效率、增强鲁棒性与安全性、支持用户驱动与交互式工作流、实现多步或复杂推理）；形式化RAG框架的关键组件；综述稠密与稀疏检索、融合策略、嵌入优化、基于强化学习的检索策略等方法。
AI.result: 系统梳理了各方法对实际部署与系统设计的影响，综合评估实践、领域特定应用，以及Naive、Advanced、Modular等RAG架构变体，形成对当代RAG发展的整合性认识。
AI.conclusion: RAG领域仍面临检索质量、可靠性、领域适配、可扩展性与可解释性等持续挑战；未来应着力构建更可靠、可适配、可透明的RAG系统。

title: MoLE: Mixture of Latent Experts for Complementary Visual Reasoning
summary: Latent visual reasoning equips vision--language models with continuous intermediate states that can process visual evidence without explicit textual reasoning traces or repeated image operations. However, existing methods often allow multiple latent tokens to access the same visual evidence through shared value projections, providing no mechanism for them to extract complementary visual information; simply increasing the latent budget can therefore yield redundant latent representations. We argue that effective latent reasoning should encourage different latent tokens to extract complementary visual information, and thereby act as specialized visual experts. Based on this insight, we propose MoLE, a Mixture of Latent Experts framework that controls both what visual evidence each latent visual expert observes and how it transforms that evidence. MoLE isolates latent visual experts during evidence extraction and uses dedicated latent summary experts to aggregate the complementary representations of latent visual experts. A two-stage training pipeline first forces visual evidence through this latent pathway and then restores direct visual access, requiring neither predefined expert roles nor intermediate visual targets. Across five visual reasoning benchmarks, MoLE achieves an average score of 78.6, outperforming data-matched supervised fine-tuning by 4.9 and the strongest evaluated latent visual reasoning baseline at the same latent budget by 3.6. Representation analyses show lower latent-state similarity and more diverse visual attention, while masking the latent pathway reduces average performance by 9.2. These results demonstrate that specializing latent computation is more effective than merely increasing the number of latent tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoLE，用“潜在视觉专家混合”框架让不同 latent token 抽取互补视觉信息，在五个视觉推理基准上平均 78.6 分，优于数据匹配的监督微调 4.9 分、最强同预算 latent 基线 3.6 分，证明专门化潜在计算优于单纯增加 latent token 数量。
AI.motivation: 现有潜视觉推理方法中，多个 latent token 常通过共享 value 投影访问同一视觉证据，缺乏抽取互补视觉信息的机制，导致增加 latent 预算只带来冗余表征。作者认为有效的潜在推理应促使不同 latent token 抽取互补视觉信息，充当专门的视觉专家。
AI.method: MoLE 控制每个 latent 视觉专家观察哪些视觉证据以及如何变换证据：在证据抽取阶段隔离各 latent 视觉专家，并用专用 latent summary experts 聚合其互补表征。训练采用两阶段流程，先强制视觉证据经由该 latent 通路，再恢复直接视觉访问，无需预定义专家角色或中间视觉目标。
AI.result: 在五个视觉推理基准上平均得分 78.6，分别超过数据匹配的监督微调 4.9 分、同 latent 预算下最强评估基线 3.6 分；表征分析显示 latent 状态相似度更低、视觉注意力更多样；掩蔽 latent 通路使平均性能下降 9.2。
AI.conclusion: 专门化潜在计算比单纯增加 latent token 数量更有效，MoLE 通过互补专家分工提升了潜视觉推理的性能与表征多样性。

title: EvenSplat: Coupled 2D-3D Decomposition for Gaussian Splatting under Exposure and Illumination Variation
summary: A surface photographed under even light presents nearly the same appearance from every angle; the same surface under uneven light does not. Exposure changes between views, illumination varies within a single image, and locally strong light sources leave one region bright and its neighbor in shadow. Multi-view reconstruction methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting treat these lighting artifacts as if they were properties of the scene, entangling capture-specific illumination with the geometry and color they recover. We present EvenSplat, a framework that separates the two. EvenSplat couples an image-space illumination decomposition with an illumination field carried by the Gaussians, so that the same explanation of the lighting is shared between the two-dimensional and three-dimensional views of the scene; a camera-response network and a local exposure-compensation module absorb the global and residual differences that remain across training images. Through extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse forms of uneven illumination (cross-view exposure, spatial illumination variation, and high-contrast lighting) on both real-world captured and simulated benchmarks, EvenSplat generally outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under high-contrast illumination.

AI.tldr: EvenSplat 通过在三维高斯上携带光照场并与图像空间光照分解耦合，将光照从几何与颜色中解耦，从而在多视图重建中消除不均匀光照造成的伪影。
AI.motivation: 在均匀光照下拍摄的物体从各角度外观一致，但不均匀光照下则不然：不同视图曝光会变化、单张图像内部光照不均、局部强光源会导致亮暗并存。现有方法（如 3D Gaussian Splatting）把这些光照伪影当作场景本身的属性，将拍摄相关的光照与所恢复的几何和颜色纠缠在一起，造成重建质量下降。
AI.method: EvenSplat 将图像空间的光照分解与由高斯基元携带的光照场耦合，使二维图像与三维场景对光照的解释保持共享/一致；同时引入相机响应网络与局部曝光补偿模块，分别吸收跨训练图像的全局差异与残余差异。
AI.result: 在多个数据集以及多种不均匀光照形式（跨视图曝光、空间光照变化、高对比度光照）上，对真实拍摄与仿真基准进行了大量实验，EvenSplat 总体优于当前最先进方法，尤其在高对比度光照条件下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式地将光照与场景几何、颜色解耦，EvenSplat 能有效应对多视图重建中的不均匀光照问题，验证了光照建模在提升重建鲁棒性与质量方面的有效性。

title: Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage
summary: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文对十个开源大语言模型进行反事实审计，评估其在儿科急诊分诊（ESI）预测中的人口学、社会经济及系统语境偏见。发现反事实敏感性差异显著，且不随模型规模或医学预训练而降低；微调后的Qwen2.5-7B敏感性最低（any-shift率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534），而部分更大或医学领域模型偏移更明显。
AI.motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险的优先级排序任务，人口学、社会经济和系统语境信息可能不当影响病情分级。开源LLM日益被考虑用于本地化、隐私保护的临床决策支持，但反事实偏见在不同模型家族、规模、医学领域模型及领域自适应模型间的差异尚不明确。
AI.method: 对十个开源LLM进行儿科ESI预测的对比反事实审计。以真实及手册式临床情景为起点，构建成对反事实变体：仅改变一个注入的人口学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统语境变量，保持临床表现不变。模型包括Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma变体、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B和GPT-OSS-120B。测量指标包括任何反事实偏移、分诊不足、分诊过度、偏移大于一个ESI级别、平均偏移和平均绝对偏移。
AI.result: 反事实敏感性差异较大，且未随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而一致下降。微调后的Qwen2.5-7B总体敏感性最低：any-shift率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534，而基座模型分别为16.02%和0.1706。若干更大或医学领域模型表现出更显著的偏移。分层与相关性分析进一步揭示了聚合比率所掩盖的具有临床重要性的方向性及共同失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 反事实审计可作为轻量、临床可解释的框架，用于在临床部署前比较开源LLM的公平性风险。

title: Memory-Guided B-Roll Generation from User Video Collections
summary: We introduce an approach for collection-grounded B-roll sequence generation. Given a user's video collection, a directive given in natural language, and a target duration, the goal is to produce a multi-shot sequence that complements the user's primary footage (A-roll) while preserving the collection's characters, settings, objects, and style. This task is challenging as one must choose the visual evidence from hours of captured footage that should guide the generation of each shot in the sequence. We address this challenge with MemComposer, a three-stage system that turns raw footage into a structured memory with visual references (characters, settings, objects, and style) and uses it to plan, retrieve, and generate grounded B-roll sequences. First, in a one-time offline stage, MemComposer constructs an entity-centric memory from raw video. Second, it uses the memory and user directive to plan a grounded sequence and retrieve conditioning frames for each shot. Third, it iteratively generates and critiques the sequence to enforce identity, setting, and sequence-level consistency. We evaluate MemComposer in a user preference study along two dimensions: prompt adherence and visual alignment to the user's collection. Against an ungrounded text-to-video planner, MemComposer wins 60.0\% of prompt-adherence and 92.8\% of visual-alignment comparisons, showing the grounding benefit of collection memory and reference retrieval. Against retrieval-only sequences assembled from captured footage, MemComposer wins 94.5\% of prompt-adherence comparisons, showing the value of generating missing shots, while retrieval-only sequences are preferred for visual alignment in 58.2\% of comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出MemComposer三阶段系统，利用用户视频集构建实体中心记忆，实现有依据的B-roll序列生成，在提示遵循和视觉对齐上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 传统B-roll生成缺乏与用户原始素材的关联，难以在长达数小时的视频中选取恰当的视觉证据来指导每个镜头的生成，同时需保持角色、场景、物体与风格的一致性。
AI.method: MemComposer分三阶段：(1)一次性离线阶段从原始视频构建实体中心的记忆（角色、场景、物体、风格）；(2)结合记忆与用户指令规划有依据的序列，并为每个镜头检索条件帧；(3)迭代生成并批判序列，以强化身份、场景及序列级一致性。
AI.result: 用户偏好研究中，对比无依据的文本到视频规划器，MemComposer在提示遵循胜出60.0%、视觉对齐胜出92.8%；对比仅检索式序列，在提示遵循上胜出94.5%，而仅检索序列在58.2%的视觉对齐比较中更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 集合记忆与参考检索带来显著的接地收益；生成缺失镜头对提示遵循至关重要，但纯检索序列在视觉对齐上仍具优势。

title: Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?
summary:
AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output.
  We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight.
  On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带预言机计算的零知识交互论证：证明一般情况下不可能，但在预言机对答案签名时可用抗碰撞哈希实现高效零知识验证。
AI.motivation: AI系统常基于机密数据（如医疗记录、药物结构）产生输出，需要在不泄露底层数据的前提下验证输出正确性。已有工作通过交互证明与辩论实现预言机辅助计算的验证，但依赖验证者远快于计算等额外假设；而高效验证对一般预言机计算不可能。本文转而关注隐私，允许验证者以计算的多项式时间运行，追问此类交互论证能否为零知识。
AI.method: 在随机预言机模型下研究预言机辅助计算的零知识交互论证，考虑证明者与验证者均可远超计算本身的时间运行；并将不可能性结果推广至辩论（debate）模型。正面方向则引入带密码学签名的预言机，构造基于抗碰撞哈希函数的零知识验证协议。
AI.result: 不可能性：随机预言机模型下不存在覆盖所有预言机辅助计算的零知识证明，即使证明者与验证者运行时间远超计算本身；该不可能性也适用于辩论这一可扩展监督的典型模型。正面结果：若预言机对每个答案附加密码学签名，则每个预言机辅助计算都可在零知识下验证，且证明者与验证者均高效，仅需假设抗碰撞哈希函数。
AI.conclusion: 一般情形下零知识验证不可行，但签名预言机使零知识高效验证成为可能；这除隐私外，还提供了一种不依赖辩论中诚实对手、也不依赖先前单证明者协议所要求的计算稳健性的可扩展监督新路径。

title: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks
comment: 44 pages, 9 figures. Code, benchmark protocol, scoring code, and all 288 per-cell results: https://github.com/Mingbird/Mingbird-agent
summary: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出本地优先的小模型智能体执行框架 Mingbird，通过十项针对性机制补偿小模型的失败模式，并在 LRAB 与 τ²-bench 上显著优于现有框架。
AI.motivation: 小规模开源权重模型（2-9B）能在普通笔记本上运行，但在云端规模的 agent harness（智能体执行框架）下几乎无法完成真实任务：工具预填充溢出上下文、自我纠错发散、工具演示陷入循环、任务被静默放弃。作者希望论证这些失败很大一部分归因于框架而非模型本身。
AI.method: 通过受控的单机对比实验与一个第三方基准测试提供证据；提出 Mingbird——面向 Windows 与 Ollama 的本地优先 agent harness，其十项机制逐点对应小模型失败形式，三项代表性机制为：字节级净零预填充预算（byte-level net-zero prefill budget）、在接收完成前重新读取任务的完成门控（finish gate）、签名级循环检测（signature-level loop detection）。评测采用 LRAB（控制机器、模型、预算与评分，4 框架 × 4 开源模型（2B-35B）× 18 个真实任务，确定性产物评分）与 τ²-bench（278 任务，三组，同一协议），并附前沿模型探针与留一机制消融。
AI.result: LRAB 上 Mingbird 总体 0.886，对比 goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，全部 288 个单元格均已公开；τ²-bench 上总计 0.856，对比 0.791 与 0.737；同 18 个任务的前沿模型探针跨框架从 0.997 到 0.478，结构良好的脚手架之间差距在 0.072 以内。留一机制消融仅作方向性参考：同一组合同夜复现可使均值变动至多 0.069（相当于每个名义单次试验增量的大小）；唯一批次匹配对比（完整机制栈 vs 仅文本重读）给出可执行完成守卫配对 +0.10（三次复现）。
AI.conclusion: 相当一部分小模型在 agent 任务中的失败可归因于 harness 而非模型本身；针对性的框架机制设计能显著提升小模型完成真实任务的能力。证据存在明确局限：自建基准、单机环境、单次试验评分。

title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Enhanced Radiometer Image Precipitation Estimation using Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Deep generative networks have recently achieved unprecedented performance in precise image and video editing using sophisticated textual prompts. However, the effectiveness of such models heavily depends on access to very large supervised and annotated image datasets, which can be very difficult to obtain. This is particularly true for satellite instruments, which very rarely overlap with labelled data, and suffer from domain shifts in the rare occasions they do. In this paper, we investigate the potential of flow matching models for unsupervised domain adaptation of satellite radiometer images. Our main contribution is a novel unsupervised method that achieves precise domain alignment by leveraging parts of the deterministic ordinary differential equations in flow matching models, conditioned on different satellite instruments. A key strength of our approach is its ability to preserve essential information while adapting across any domains since the perturbations are in theory bijective. Extensive experiments conducted on the GPM-Core constellation show the benefit of our conditional domain adaptation, particularly in improving rain precipitation estimation from radiometer imagery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用 Flow Matching 模型实现卫星辐射计图像的无监督域适应，通过条件化确定性 ODE 进行域对齐，在 GPM-Core 星座上验证了对降水估计的改进。
AI.motivation: 深度生成网络在图像与视频编辑上表现优异，但依赖大规模有标注数据。卫星辐射计领域尤其困难：仪器间极少有标注重叠，且在少数重叠情况下仍存在域偏移。因此需要一种不依赖标注的域适应方法。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的无监督域适应方法，基于 Flow Matching 模型，利用其确定性常微分方程（ODE）的部分环节，以不同卫星仪器为条件实现精确的域对齐。由于扰动在理论上具有双射性，该方法能在跨域适应时保留关键信息。
AI.result: 在 GPM-Core 星座上的大量实验表明，条件域适应方法具有明显优势，尤其体现在利用辐射计图像改进降水估计方面。
AI.conclusion: Flow Matching 模型的确定性 ODE 可有效用于无监督卫星图像域适应，条件化设计兼顾域对齐与信息保留，为跨仪器辐射计数据融合与降水反演提供了可行路径。

title: A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification
summary: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种比较性可解释性框架，用于审计DeBERTa-v3在医学摘要零样本分类中的表现，通过五种归因方法的Jaccard一致性量化揭示解释分歧问题。
AI.motivation: 针对可解释人工智能中的"分歧问题"，即不同归因方法对同一输入与预测产生差异解释，作者希望在医学文本分类这一高风险领域中系统审计Transformer模型的可解释性与可靠性。
AI.method: 在Medical Abstracts语料上构建自然语言推理引擎，每个诊断类别配五个增强假设，每类均衡采样一千篇文本。比较五类解释方法：模型无关的SHAP与LIME、深度学习专属的遮挡法与Input x Gradient、Transformer专属的Attention x Gradient；以top-token归因标准化解释，并用Jaccard指数量化成对一致性。
AI.result: 在界定清晰的临床领域取得高预测准确率，语义高度歧义时性能下降。解释稳定性与预测确定性直接对应：单义类别中高度收敛，诊断不确定时显著下降。定性错误审计发现三种系统性失效机制：词汇过敏、语义重叠与归因连贯性丧失。
AI.conclusion: 建议在审计Transformer医学文本分类模型时组合使用多种解释方法并引入定量一致性指标，并优先针对具体临床本体而非宽泛诊断标签进行建模与评估。

title: MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens
summary: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 MapLightning，用紧凑的 1D 可学习地图 token 取代稠密 BEV 网格作为中间表示，通过自注意力实现图像与地图 token 的联合交互，在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上同时实现 SOTA 精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 在线矢量化 HD 地图构建对自动驾驶扩展性与安全性至关重要，需要兼顾精度与实时推理。现有方法多以稠密 BEV 网格作为中间表示，存在 token 数量多、显存占用高、推理慢的问题，且依赖相机投影参数（含相机外参），对外参扰动不鲁棒。
AI.method: MapLightning 以一组紧凑的 1D 可学习地图 token 替代稠密 BEV 网格。构建地图 token 时选用自注意力而非普通交叉注意力，以支持图像 token 与地图 token 的联合交互与上下文聚合：transformer mapper 将地图 token 与图像 token 拼接，执行完整自注意力后丢弃图像 token，仅保留更新后的地图 token 用于解码。该设计使地图解码器可采用完整（而非可变形）交叉注意力以获得更好的全局上下文，且不使用相机投影参数。
AI.result: 中间 token 数量最多减少 16.7 倍；在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上取得精度与效率的 SOTA。轻量版本相较 MapTRv2 在 nuScenes 提升 +10.1 mAP、Argoverse 2 提升 +16.2 mAP，同时推理快 1.73 倍（40+ FPS）、显存减少 53%。此外在不确定性感知地图构建与下游轨迹预测任务上也有改进。
AI.conclusion: 以 1D 地图 token 替代稠密 BEV 网格的自注意力式 transformer mapper，可在显著降低 token 数与显存的同时提升精度和速度，并对相机外参扰动更鲁棒，且可扩展至不确定性建模与下游轨迹预测。代码与模型将开源。

title: Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries
summary: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council's \emph{typed} moves---who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer---as observations of a classical annotator model with \emph{per-agent} reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA），将多LLM议会的类型化发言视为对具有每智能体可靠度的标注者模型的观测，从而把多智能体审议重构为可靠度估计问题，输出校准的后验概率，并能反转持续不可靠的智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有多LLM议会聚合方法存在两个缺陷：其置信度衡量的是决断性而非正确性，无法给出校准的"正确概率"；且无法识别并折扣持续不可靠的智能体，在存在持续对抗性行为时决策不稳健。随着此类系统被越来越多用于推理任务，这两个问题变得关键。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA）。将议会中类型化的动作（谁提出、质疑或让步于哪个答案）建模为经典标注者模型的观测，并为每个智能体引入可靠度参数。基于审议轨迹推断智能体可靠度，据此对证据加权，得到候选答案上的校准后验概率；持续不可靠的智能体可被反转而非仅被多数票压制。
AI.result: 在二分类与多分类基准上，BDA在零额外成本（无需额外LLM调用）的议会聚合方法中取得最佳校准；在持续对抗联盟下稳健性提升，同时在干净设置下保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体审议表述为带每智能体可靠度的可靠度估计问题，可同时解决置信度校准与对抗鲁棒性两个问题；BDA以零额外LLM调用代价实现了更优的校准与鲁棒性。

title: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes
summary: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information. Its application to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, remains largely unexplored. Recent approaches use privileged visual information, such as image crops corresponding to a question, to improve fine-grained perception, but their gains are confined to tasks that benefit from such visual zooming and require either human-annotated grounding data or external teacher models. We introduce a different form of on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs that provides the teacher with textual, spatially grounded guidance identifying the visual elements relevant to a query. We use procedurally generated scenes with automatically available object identities and spatial coordinates, enabling scalable and annotation-free post-training. The teacher uses this spatial guidance to locate and integrate evidence from multiple relevant image regions, while the student learns to reproduce the resulting behavior from the image and question alone. Our approach consistently improves performance on counting, document and chart understanding benchmarks across multiple models. Importantly, although post-training uses only synthetic scenes, the resulting improvements transfer to real-world perception benchmarks, yielding a 3.23-point gain in average performance across CVBench, V*, ZoomBench, BLINK, HR-Bench, and MME-RealWorld. These results show that spatially grounded privileged information can induce broader perceptual capabilities through on-policy self-distillation, enabling substantial synthetic-to-real transfer beyond the task and data distribution used for post-training. Project page: https://github.com/sirkosophia/Where-OPD

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向多模态大模型（MLLM）的on-policy自蒸馏方法：教师接收文本化的空间定位指引，学生在仅有图像和问题的条件下学习复现教师的定位与证据整合行为；训练数据由程序化生成的合成场景提供，无需人工标注或外部教师模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM的on-policy自蒸馏多依赖特权视觉信息（如问题对应的图像裁剪）来提升细粒度感知，但收益局限于需要视觉放大的任务，且依赖人工标注的grounding数据或外部教师模型，难以规模化、无标注地后训练。作者希望探索一种不同的特权信息形式，实现可扩展、免标注的后训练。
AI.method: 为教师提供文本化、空间定位的指引，明确指出与查询相关的视觉元素；训练场景由程序化生成，物体身份与空间坐标自动可得。教师利用这些空间指引定位并整合多个相关图像区域的证据，学生则仅凭图像与问题学习复现教师的这一行为，从而通过on-policy自蒸馏获得更广的感知能力。
AI.result: 在计数、文档理解与图表理解等基准上，多个模型性能均获一致提升。尽管后训练仅使用合成场景，改进仍迁移到真实世界感知基准：在CVBench、V*、ZoomBench、BLINK、HR-Bench和MME-RealWorld上平均提升3.23分。
AI.conclusion: 文本化、空间定位的特权信息可通过on-policy自蒸馏诱导更广泛的感知能力，实现超出后训练任务与数据分布的显著合成到真实迁移，为MLLM的免标注可扩展后训练提供了新路径。

title: DecomVoxel: Harnessing 3D-Native Priors with Guided In-situ Denoising Optimization for Decompositional Scene Reconstruction
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 - Journal Track (TOG). Project page: https://decomvoxel.github.io/DecomVoxel-Webpage/
summary: Decompositional scene reconstruction aims to reconstruct high-quality objects and background, yet existing methods still struggle with the level of quality under heavy occlusions. While generative priors offer a potential solution, 2D image-based priors often suffer from multi-view inconsistency due to a lack of 3D awareness. Conversely, 3D-native priors provide stronger structural inductive biases but frequently lead to spatial drift and misalignment within complex scenes. To address these issues, we propose DecomVoxel, formulating object completion as a guided in-situ denoising optimization that bridges 3D-native priors with neural scene reconstruction. Our framework introduces a reformulated epsilon-based distillation loss to ensure stable latent refinement, alongside adaptive spatial guidance that utilizes occupied and vacant anchors with temporal annealing to suppress generative hallucinations and mitigate spatial drift. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ show that DecomVoxel significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while faithfully preserving the original spatial layout, structural fidelity, and style-consistent texture. Our method pushes the boundary of decompositional reconstruction by delivering high-quality textured meshes with clean topology, geometry, and appearance, providing a robust solution for the decompositional reconstruction of complex real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel.

AI.tldr: 提出 DecomVoxel，将物体补全建模为受引导的原位去噪优化，桥接 3D 原生先验与神经场景重建，在 Replica 和 ScanNet++ 上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 分解式场景重建需同时重建高质量物体与背景，但在严重遮挡下质量仍不足。2D 图像先验缺乏 3D 感知，导致多视图不一致；3D 原生先验虽有结构归纳偏置，却在复杂场景中产生空间漂移与错位。
AI.method: 提出 DecomVoxel，将物体补全表述为受引导的原位（in-situ）去噪优化，连接 3D 原生先验与神经场景重建。框架引入重表述的基于 epsilon 的蒸馏损失以保证潜变量细化的稳定性，并采用自适应空间引导，利用已占据与空置锚点结合时间退火，抑制生成幻觉并缓解空间漂移。
AI.result: 在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 数据集上，DecomVoxel 显著优于当前最先进方法，同时忠实保持原始空间布局、结构保真度与风格一致的纹理，生成具有干净拓扑、几何与外观的高质量纹理网格。
AI.conclusion: 该方法拓展了分解式重建的边界，为复杂真实场景的分解式重建提供了鲁棒解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering
summary: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws, thermodynamic consistency, and known structural constraints. These approaches not only improve robustness and reliability, but also enable meaningful human-AI collaboration by providing information at an appropriate level of abstraction for the task and decision context. We conclude that AI and ML are not replacing the core principles of chemical engineering; rather, they are amplifying them. As the field advances toward increasingly autonomous, adaptive, and sustainable systems, the thoughtful integration of AI/ML with first-principles understanding and domain expertise will be essential to realizing their full potential across both research and industrial practice.

AI.tldr: 该文综述AI/ML在化学工程各领域的应用，核心趋势是从纯黑箱模型转向融合物理先验的混合/物理信息框架，AI/ML并非取代而是放大化学工程基本原理。
AI.motivation: AI与ML的快速成熟改变了化学工程问题的建模与求解方式，但应用面临预测精度、数据稀缺、外推能力、可解释性及模型生命周期管理等挑战，亟需明确AI/ML与第一性原理模型如何协同。
AI.method: 以perspective/综述形式，梳理近年来AI/ML在原子尺度模拟、材料与催化剂发现、传递与热力学、分离、过程系统工程及工业运行等领域的方法学进展与代表性应用，重点分析其与第一性原理模型的整合方式。
AI.result: 发现跨领域统一趋势：由纯黑箱方法转向显式遵循守恒定律、热力学一致性与结构约束的混合及物理信息框架，此类方法提升了鲁棒性与可靠性，并在合适抽象层级上支持人机协作。
AI.conclusion: AI/ML不取代化学工程核心原理，而是对其的增强；面向自主、自适应与可持续系统的发展，需将AI/ML与第一性原理理解及领域专业知识审慎结合，方能充分释放其研究与工业潜力。

title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
summary: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ScholarCatalyst，通过184位作者对207篇近期计算机科学论文的候选文献标注，构建了一个基于作者判断的检索任务。结果显示，智能体搜索（0.42 R@20）不及嵌入检索（0.48 R@20），即便用Claude Fable 5.1的智能体也仅达0.51 R@20，凸显模型缺乏在广博语料中检索所需的专家直觉。
AI.motivation: 科学家在"感知某个新问题需要哪一先前想法"这一能力上仍远超AI，即使AI开始攻克开放问题。作者希望研究这种"专家直觉"，因为现有AI系统难以从不断增长的文献库中精准定位对新问题真正有推动作用的前期研究。
AI.method: 利用自动化流水线实现可扩展的作者标注：让207篇近期计算机科学论文的184位主要作者，标注哪些候选文献曾推动（或本可推动）其项目，并附详细理由。基于此构建ScholarCatalyst数据集，并提出一个检索任务：给定初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时可获得的文献中检索相关论文。同时对比嵌入检索与智能体搜索的表现。
AI.result: 智能体搜索表现不优于嵌入检索（0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20），尽管其调用了同一检索器作为工具。即便使用Claude Fable 5.1构建、可能在训练中见过这些已完成论文的智能体，也仅达0.51 R@20。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明需要新的训练方法，使模型具备在广博语料中搜索的专家直觉。作者设想ScholarCatalyst是迈向科学智能体的一步，使其能够从一个半成形的想法出发，指向其所需要的前期研究。

title: SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE

AI.tldr: SPHERE 是一个自适应 VR 生成框架，通过捕获用户持久空间偏好，将孤立的 3D 室内场景合成转变为连续的人机协同创作。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 室内场景合成流水线无法跨会话保留用户特定偏好，导致沉浸式创作过程重复且造成身体疲劳。
AI.method: 从语音与控制器编辑等自然多模态交互中提取持久空间偏好；将原始编辑抽象为同时建模局部功能与全局拓扑上下文的层次化约束，以保证几何鲁棒性；并采用人在回路强化学习机制，依据用户最终编辑的场景动态更新检索策略。
AI.result: 混合设计用户研究（N=42）与离线消融表明，SPHERE 显著减少纠正性编辑与身体负荷，避免偏向浅层物体级特征，生成几何鲁棒且与用户画像对齐的布局。
AI.conclusion: SPHERE 证明捕获用户示范的空间逻辑可实现可控的空间自适应，为沉浸式创作建立可靠、可治理的人机协作框架。

title: CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction
comment: Authors contributed equally to this work. Author order is interchangeable
summary: Feedforward foundation models have recently shown remarkable 3D reconstruction capabilities. However, existing models exhibit large tracking drift in long-context streaming reconstruction due to error accumulation. In this paper, we revisit loop closure with streaming reconstruction foundation models to enable accurate, drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction. Specifically, our method detects loop candidates through global descriptor retrieval, and constructs loop-conditioned windows to estimate the relative poses between looped frames. Given the observation that our adopted streaming reconstruction backbone produces a globally consistent scale, we optimize all frame poses on the SE(3) manifold with sequential and loop closure constraints, avoiding the pose graph optimization on the Sim(3) or higher-dimensional SL(4) manifolds employed in prior works. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces drift and produces consistent geometry on kilometer-scale sequences, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLoSeR.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对前馈基础模型在长序列流式重建中的漂移累积问题，引入回环闭合，实现公里级无漂移重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈基础模型虽具备出色的3D重建能力，但在长上下文流式重建中因误差累积会产生严重的跟踪漂移，现有方法难以实现公里级精确重建。
AI.method: 通过全局描述子检索检测回环候选帧，构建回环条件窗口估计回环帧间相对位姿；利用所用流式重建骨干网络产生全局一致尺度的特性，在SE(3)流形上以序列约束和回环约束优化所有帧位姿，避免先前工作在Sim(3)或更高维SL(4)流形上的位姿图优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在公里级序列上减少了漂移并产生一致的几何结构，显著优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将回环闭合与流式重建基础模型结合，并在SE(3)流形上执行位姿优化，可有效消除长序列重建的漂移，实现公里级无漂移重建。

title: Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary:
AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence.
  Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it.
  We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit.
  Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"全局一致性"问题：AI智能体各自做出局部有效决策，却共同产生无效结果；其根源是共享状态缺失而非模型智能不足。作者用"观察混淆不可能性定理"刻画可保证有效动作的精确边界，并提出局部到全局的运行时语义 X=(H,C,G,F;D)，主张模型负责提议、harness 拥有共享状态并管控提交。九项研究验证了该失败及其边界：隐藏决定性事件时前沿模型接近随机水平，恢复唯一权威事实后即恢复满分；团队超预算、并发计数违规均可由提交强制执行消除。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中，各智能体在自身上下文内都能做出局部合理的决策，但联合结果却可能无效。作者认为这并非模型智能不够，而是共享状态失效所致，即"全局一致性"问题。既有方法多寄望于更强的模型、更多推理、角色分工或消息传递，但缺少对"何时期望可保证有效动作"的理论边界，也缺少能统一描述共享状态、提交与局部视图胶合问题的运行时框架。
AI.method: 理论层面，论文给出"观察混淆不可能性定理"：当且仅当所有产生同一观察的世界共享某个可采纳动作时，策略才能保证有效动作；若 k 个不可区分世界需要两两不相交的动作，最优随机化最坏成功率为 1/k，更多推理、角色、消息或样本都无法恢复缺失的区分。随后提出局部到全局运行时语义 X=(H,C,G,F;D)：拓扑 H 记录重叠作用域，范畴 C 管控改变状态的动作，群胚 G 保留可逆变换，层 F 检验局部视图能否胶合成一个世界，最小历史 D 只保留会改变合法未来的区分；模型中只负责提议，harness 拥有共享状态并管控提交。实证方面设计九项研究，涵盖受控修订基准、TeamBench 与 tau2-bench Telecom，通过可见/隐藏决定性事件、权威事实恢复、共享预算、可见实时计数、提交强制等条件对比不同处理方式。
AI.result: 受控修订基准中，同一前沿模型在决定性事件可见时得 40/40；事件隐藏时各测试组仅 12–17/40，与随机水平（1/3）一致；恢复一个权威事实后回到 40/40。TeamBench 中普通团队 5/5 次超出共享预算，提供可见实时计数仍有 4/5 次违规，而提交强制将违规降为 0/5。tau2-bench Telecom 中，静默回退后当前状态检查得 0.07，而 harness 得 1.00。当传统求解器已掌握完整相关状态时，其表现与 harness 持平，符合理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 论文的反直觉结论是：局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。保证全局一致性所需的关键条件，是所有产生同一观察的世界共享可采纳动作；一旦这一条件被破坏，任何额外的模型能力、推理、角色或通信都无法弥补。因此架构上应让模型负责提议、由 harness 集中持有共享状态并执行提交管制，从而以运行时机制而非模型智能来保障全局一致性。

title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
summary: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

AI.tldr: PyRUA-Lean：交互式代码执行框架，耦合反馈驱动的图元组合与选择性观测，降低VLM智能体控制机器人的token开销并提升成功率。
AI.motivation: VLM智能体虽可通过视觉反馈与动作原语控制机器人，但重复的模型调用与冗余观测带来大量token开销，效率低下。
AI.method: 提出PyRUA-Lean交互式代码执行框架：智能体将经典机器人原语与学习的VLA策略组合成Python单元，在其中执行条件检查与局部重试，仅返回显式请求的图像与状态反馈用于重规划。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365共700个模拟任务实例上，与使用相同GPT-6 Astra规划器和底层原语的工具调用基线相比：在相同LLM调用预算下，整体成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%；在双方均解决的实例上，LLM调用减少49%，输入token减少65%。
AI.conclusion: 通过代码执行式原语组合与选择性观测，可在不增加调用预算的前提下显著提升VLM机器人智能体的任务成功率并大幅削减token消耗。

title: Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出Mimir——基于物理约束的LLM智能体，通过快慢双时间尺度修复机制实现长周期灌溉控制，在保持物理模型与执行权限不可变的前提下，取得最低综合控制成本并减少约51%灌溉用水。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体证据多来自回合制任务，反馈即时且失败可重置；而长期物理控制中动作会改变未来状态、误差跨决策累积，且智能体必须在不改写物理规则（安全前提）的条件下从经验中自我改进。研究通过灌溉这一季节尺度的土壤-水分动力学场景考察该机制。
AI.method: Mimir围绕两个修复时间尺度组织：快尺度上，结构化物理接口与确定性模拟器将LLM输出转为候选方案，经数值校验、修订及有界确定性动作选择后执行；慢尺度上，将反复出现的失效模式固化为持久上下文原则以约束后续提议，而物理模型、评估器与执行约束保持不可变。
AI.result: 在覆盖多站点、多作物、多年份的统一回顾式评估器下，Mimir取得所评估基线中最低的综合控制成本，灌溉量较历史调度回放减少约51%。消融显示移除前向模拟、验证式修订或持久上下文均使控制成本上升；模型规模与模型族研究未显示随LLM规模增大而单调增益。
AI.conclusion: 持久性物理智能体可将语义推理与有界、证据驱动的自我改进相结合，同时把物理真实性与执行器权限保留给显式数值机制。

title: Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models
summary: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation.
